policy.notClaimed: Structure checks and successful retries do not establish psychometric validity or resistance to memorization.

sections.title: 描述核心 AI 概念并定义术语

learnerGoals.zh: AI范围不是是否从样本学习的同义词
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish broad AI from evidence of learning

learnerGoals.zh: 为学习型方案补齐数据、目标和验证
learnerGoals.en: Specify data, goals and validation for ML

learnerGoals.zh: 架构证据缺失时不冒认DL
learnerGoals.en: Do not assert DL without architectural evidence

learnerGoals.zh: 辨认可学习连接计算结构
learnerGoals.en: Recognize learnable connected computation

learnerGoals.zh: 按语言任务输出分流
learnerGoals.en: Route language tasks by their output

learnerGoals.zh: 依据图像任务识别视觉需求
learnerGoals.en: Identify visual tasks from image requirements

learnerGoals.zh: 核验生成内容而不依赖流畅度
learnerGoals.en: Verify generated content beyond fluency

learnerGoals.zh: 构造可执行方法
learnerGoals.en: Construct an executable method

learnerGoals.zh: 区分业务输入、估计输出与下游行动
learnerGoals.en: Separate inputs, estimates and downstream actions

learnerGoals.zh: 用参数变化识别训练并独立验证
learnerGoals.en: Identify training by parameter change and validate independently

learnerGoals.zh: 用参数证据判断推理并保留未知
learnerGoals.en: Identify inference from parameter evidence and retain uncertainty

learnerGoals.zh: 计算预测差额并区分后果
learnerGoals.en: Calculate prediction differences and distinguish impacts

learnerGoals.zh: 核查本任务目标标签
learnerGoals.en: Check task-specific target labels

learnerGoals.zh: 探索无目标标签结构而不当结论
learnerGoals.en: Explore unlabeled structure without overclaiming

learnerGoals.zh: 以累计回报评价行动策略
learnerGoals.en: Evaluate policies by cumulative return

learnerGoals.zh: 把结构与事实准确分开
learnerGoals.en: Separate schema from value accuracy

learnerGoals.zh: 按用途提取组织非结构化信息
learnerGoals.en: Extract and organize unstructured information

learnerGoals.zh: 按用途核验并修复质量
learnerGoals.en: Check and repair fitness for use

learnerGoals.zh: 从数据使用记录判断泛化证据范围
learnerGoals.en: Judge generalization evidence from data-use records

learnerGoals.zh: 保留未参与学习的检验资料
learnerGoals.en: Preserve data not used in learning

learnerGoals.zh: 以实际工作统一术语
learnerGoals.en: Align terms with actual work

learnerGoals.zh: 分清系统框架与管理体系的范围
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish system framework and management scope

scenario.zh: 示范：客服模型收到新投诉后用已有参数起草答复，属于推理；用核验过的示例调整参数是训练。
scenario.en: Demonstration: using existing parameters to draft a new complaint reply is inference; adjusting parameters from verified examples is training.

workedReasoning.zh: 关键是参数是否改变，不是是否出现新文字或新输入。流畅答复还需来源核验。
workedReasoning.en: The distinction is parameter change, not new wording or inputs. Fluent answers still need source checks.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：分类两次系统操作：A只使用现有模型给图片打分；B用已标注图片优化权重。
prompt.en: Guided practice: classify A, scoring images using the existing model, and B, optimizing weights from labeled images.

text.zh: 调整参数
text.en: Parameter adjustment

text.zh: 使用已有参数
text.en: Use of existing parameters

text.zh: 给新图片打分而未改权重
text.en: Score a new image without changing weights

text.zh: 用标注图片优化权重
text.en: Optimize weights from labeled images

reason.zh: B包含参数学习，A只是使用模型；新图片不能独自证明发生训练。
reason.en: B learns parameters; A only uses the model. A new image alone does not establish training.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

learnerDecision.zh: 区分改变模型与使用模型
learnerDecision.en: Distinguish changing from using the model
Do not judge from output change alone

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 矩阵判断正确且指出独立新录音证据
训练/推理/证据不足三类日志分清
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: Separate training, inference and insufficient evidence

text.zh: 区分改变模型与使用模型；不能只看输出变没变
text.en: Distinguish changing from using the model; Do not judge from output change alone

text.zh: B包含参数学习，A只是使用模型；新图片不能独自证明发生训练。
text.en: B learns parameters; A only uses the model. A new image alone does not establish training.

explanation.zh: B包含参数学习，A只是使用模型；新图片不能独自证明发生训练。
explanation.en: B learns parameters; A only uses the model. A new image alone does not establish training.

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 给新图片打分而未改权重 → 使用已有参数；用标注图片优化权重 → 调整参数
workedAnswer.en: Score a new image without changing weights → Use of existing parameters; Optimize weights from labeled images → Parameter adjustment

title.en: Understand AI foundations through business evidence

brief.zh: 你将解释数据从哪里来、模型结果用来做什么，以及何时参数真的发生学习变化。知识随时可回看；示范和提示练习不计掌握。以下是不同情境的独立应用，整章完成后才进入90%正式测验。先在场景找到物件才能收藏，预览不登记发现；入柜后去素材箱回看，应用通过才完成学习。
brief.en: Explain where data comes from, how model results are used and when parameters actually change through learning. Knowledge remains available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery. These are independent applications in different situations; formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows completion of the chapter. Discover objects in the scene before collecting; previewing is not discovery. Filed objects can be revisited in the material box; passing applications completes learning.

prompt.zh: 门店需要给本批最大金额订单加优先复核标记。尚未读取这批记录，也不知道最大金额是谁。请用这些工作卡构造一个真正能完成任务的方法，而不是直接猜订单。
prompt.en: A store needs to mark the highest-value order in this batch for priority review. The batch has not been read and the highest-value order is unknown. Construct a method that can actually perform the task rather than guessing an order.

text.zh: 给已找到的订单写入标记
text.en: Mark the identified order

text.zh: 读取本批订单记录
text.en: Read the current batch

text.zh: 从读取记录中找最大金额订单
text.en: Identify the maximum in the read records

reason.zh: 找最大值需要先有订单记录，写标记需要先知道目标订单；顺序来自信息依赖。算法是可执行方法，不是训练得到的模型。若先写标记，就是把尚未得到的信息当成已知。回看“算法、模型”。
reason.en: Finding the maximum requires the records; marking requires the identified order. Information dependencies determine order. An algorithm is an executable method, not a trained model. Marking first assumes unavailable information. Revisit Algorithm and Model.

prompt.zh: 维修团队先观测设备振动和温度，用一个已训练模型估计剩余工作小时；后台另一项工作用已知维修结果与估计的差异改变权重。核对四份记录的实际职责。每行只勾选直接描述该记录的一项，不用输入代码。
prompt.en: A maintenance team measures vibration and temperature and uses an existing model to estimate remaining operating hours. A separate background job uses differences from known maintenance outcomes to change weights. Identify the role of each record. Select one directly supported role per row; no code entry is needed.

text.zh: 本次测得的振动与温度
text.en: Current vibration and temperature measurements

text.zh: 预计还可运行18小时
text.en: Estimated 18 operating hours remaining

text.zh: 利用已知结果误差改变权重
text.en: Changing weights from errors against known outcomes

text.zh: 锁定权重处理另一台设备的新读数
text.en: Processing another device’s new readings with locked weights

text.zh: 业务提供给模型的资料
text.en: Business information supplied to the model

text.zh: 模型产生的估计结果
text.en: Estimate produced by the model

text.zh: 发生参数学习调整
text.en: Parameter adjustment through learning

text.zh: 使用已有参数处理输入
text.en: Using existing parameters on input

reason.zh: 观测值提供资料，小时数是估计，误差驱动的权重改变才是训练，锁定参数处理新输入属于推理。产生新结果不等于训练；估计也不能当作已发生事实。回看“模型、训练、推理”。
reason.en: Measurements supply inputs; hours are an estimate; error-driven weight changes are training; locked parameters on new inputs are inference. A new result does not imply training, and an estimate is not an observed outcome. Revisit Model, Training and Inference.

prompt.zh: 采购评审收到三份方案材料：甲只执行人工写定的审批条件；乙从样本调整参数但未说明网络结构；丙用相连节点和可学习权重构成多层网络，从数据学习表示。选择材料能支持的全部判断。
prompt.en: A procurement review has three proposals: A executes manually specified approval conditions; B adjusts parameters from examples without describing a network; C uses connected nodes with learnable weights in a multilayer network to learn representations. Select every conclusion supported by the materials.

text.zh: 乙有机器学习证据，但现有材料不足以断言是深度学习
text.en: B supports ML, but the material does not establish deep learning

text.zh: 丙支持神经网络及深度学习方法，而且仍在ML与AI范围内
text.en: C supports a neural network and deep learning within ML and AI

text.zh: 甲的描述没有证明从数据学习，但不能据此排除它属于更广AI范畴
text.en: A does not establish learning from data, but that alone does not exclude broader AI

text.zh: 任何会自动审批的系统都必然是深度学习
text.en: Every automated approval system is necessarily deep learning

text.zh: 甲、乙、丙是所有AI都必须依次经过的时间阶段
text.en: A, B and C are universal temporal stages for AI

reason.zh: 从材料推断的是方法证据与包含关系，不是靠“智能”宣传词或自动执行判断。乙缺结构证据应保留未知；丙的多层学习结构支持DL，DL仍属于ML。回看“AI、ML、DL、神经网络”。
reason.en: Infer method evidence and inclusion, not intelligence marketing or mere automation. B lacks architectural evidence for DL; C supplies it, while DL remains within ML. Revisit AI, ML, DL and Neural networks.

prompt.zh: 门店要整理客户请求。四份原料分别是固定字段订单表、长篇投诉邮件、货架照片和电话录音。把它们交给最直接需要的加工工作；加工结果仍要核对原始资料，表格也不保证数值正确。
prompt.en: A store is organizing customer requests from an order table, a long complaint email, a shelf photo and a call recording. Route each to the most directly required preparation work. Verify processed results against sources; tabular values are not automatically accurate.

text.zh: 核查字段与数值后统计
text.en: Check fields and values before aggregation

text.zh: 提取正文中的诉求和要素
text.en: Extract requests and elements from prose

text.zh: 从图像提取并解释信息
text.en: Extract and interpret image information

text.zh: 转写后核对录音并提取诉求
text.en: Transcribe, check against audio and extract requests

text.zh: 日期、商品编号、数量为固定字段的订单表
text.en: Orders with fixed date, product and quantity fields

text.zh: 包含多项诉求的投诉邮件正文
text.en: Complaint-email prose with several requests

text.zh: 需要识别缺货位置的货架照片
text.en: A shelf image needing missing-stock localization

text.zh: 客户描述问题的电话录音
text.en: A recording of a customer describing a problem

reason.zh: 来源形态和任务产物决定加工：字段统计、语言抽取、视觉解释与录音处理不是同一种操作。转写不是事实核验，统一字段也不自动修复错误。回看“结构化/非结构化数据、NLP、CV”。
reason.en: Source form and intended output determine preparation. Aggregation, language extraction, vision and audio handling differ. Transcription does not verify facts, and schemas do not repair wrong values. Revisit Structured and Unstructured Data, NLP and CV.

prompt.zh: 补货演练中负责人确认：B的两行是同一订单重复导入，其他各为一笔。记录数量A40、B30、B30、C30。期初库存为0，团队按模型预测备货80件。计算去重后的订单笔数、真实需求总量以及缺货量。所有数量仅为本演练条件。
prompt.en: In this stocking exercise the owner confirms two B rows are one order imported twice; other rows are distinct. Quantities are A40, B30, B30 and C30. Initial stock is zero and the team stocks a forecast of 80 units. Compute the deduplicated order count, actual total demand and shortage. All quantities are exercise assumptions.

reason.zh: B只计一次，3笔且40+30+30=100，100−80=20件缺货。原料重复会扭曲评价；预测是估计而非真实需求。题面未给损失价格，不能再编造损失金额。回看“数据质量、预测”。
reason.en: Count B once: three orders and 40+30+30=100 units; 100−80=20 short. Duplicate inputs distort evaluation, and forecasts are not actual demand. No loss price is given, so do not invent a monetary loss. Revisit Data Quality and Prediction.

prompt.zh: 仓库模型在参与参数调整的记录上分数很高，现在要服务条件不同的新仓库。新仓库还有一批从未用于调整参数的记录。选出能支持新用途判断的全部动作。
prompt.en: A warehouse model scores highly on records used for fitting, but will serve a new warehouse with different conditions. The new warehouse has records never used to adjust parameters. Select every action supporting a judgment about the new use.

text.zh: 保留这批独立记录用于检验新条件下表现
text.en: Keep those independent records for evaluation under the new conditions

text.zh: 调查新旧仓库条件差异及错误后果
text.en: Investigate differences between warehouses and error consequences

text.zh: 把该批答案加入本次参数调整后仍称独立检验
text.en: Fit on those answers and still call the evaluation independent

text.zh: 只重复原训练分数就证明新仓库可靠
text.en: Repeat the old training score as proof of new-warehouse reliability

reason.zh: 独立记录和环境比较提供新用途证据；把答案用于学习后再评分会污染这种证据。历史训练表现不能代替未见条件下的检验。回看“训练、历史数据与泛化、训练集与验证”。
reason.en: Independent records and environmental comparison supply new-use evidence. Fitting to the answers contaminates that evidence; past training performance does not replace evaluation on unseen conditions. Revisit Training, Generalization and Evaluation Sets.

prompt.zh: 业务组有四项请求：甲有核实过的交易欺诈结果；乙没有预设客户类别、想探索相似群体；丙机器人在模拟环境行动后获得奖励；丁要把访谈写成摘要。选出有依据的全部建议，而不是给四项一律套同一方法。
prompt.en: A business group has four requests: A has verified fraud outcomes for transactions; B has no predefined customer categories and wants similar groups; C has a robot receiving rewards after simulated actions; D wants an interview summary. Select every justified recommendation instead of forcing one method onto all four.

text.zh: 甲可评估带目标标签的映射学习
text.en: Evaluate labeled input-to-target learning for A

text.zh: 乙可探索无监督分群，但仍需解释和核验业务意义
text.en: Explore unsupervised groups for B while checking their business meaning

text.zh: 丙应关注交互策略的累计回报而非单轮奖励
text.en: For C, assess cumulative return of an interaction policy rather than one reward

text.zh: 丁可评估内容生成，但摘要需对照访谈核验
text.en: Evaluate generation for D and verify the summary against the interview

text.zh: 有标签、无标签、交互奖励和摘要任务都应只做固定类别配对
text.en: Use fixed category matching for every labeled, unlabeled, reward and summary task

reason.zh: 目标标签、无标签结构、交互累计回报与内容生成对应不同证据。分群不自动成为业务真相，单轮奖励不证明长期表现，流畅摘要不证明事实。回看“监督/无监督/强化学习、GenAI”。
reason.en: Labels, unlabeled structure, cumulative interactive return and generation involve different evidence. Clusters are not automatically business truth, one reward does not establish long-term performance, and fluent summaries do not prove facts. Revisit Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Learning and GenAI.

prompt.zh: 团队有三项待办：统一“训练完成”和“已上线运行”的沟通；查找使用ML的AI系统框架范围；查找组织AI管理责任的框架范围。负责人打算用“知道标准编号”替代模型性能验证。选择能纠正该计划的全部说明。这里不作正式合规裁定。
prompt.en: The team must align discussion of training completion versus live operation, find the scope of frameworks for AI systems using ML, and find the scope of organizational AI management responsibilities. The owner proposes knowing standard numbers instead of performance validation. Select every correction; this is not a formal compliance determination.

text.zh: 先说清参数学习、运行和上线等实际工作含义
text.en: First clarify the actual meaning of parameter learning, running and deployment

text.zh: 23053关注使用ML的AI系统框架，具体要求仍查正式标准
text.en: 23053 concerns frameworks for AI systems using ML; consult the formal standard for requirements

text.zh: 42001关注组织AI管理体系，名称本身不保证输出准确
text.en: 42001 concerns organizational AI management systems; its name does not guarantee output accuracy

text.zh: 掌握两个编号即可省略任务验证并宣称零错误
text.en: Knowing both numbers permits skipping task evaluation and claiming zero errors

reason.zh: 词汇一致帮助协作，但不能当作性能证据；系统框架与管理体系的范围不同，标准名不能代替正式要求核验或实际任务评价。回看“AI框架与统一词汇、ISO框架意识”。
reason.en: Shared vocabulary helps collaboration but is not performance evidence. System-framework and management-system scopes differ; names do not replace formal requirement checks or task evaluation. Revisit Shared AI Vocabulary and Standards Awareness.

prompt.zh: 门店需要给本批最大金额订单加优先复核标记。尚未读取这批记录，也不知道最大金额是谁。请用这些工作卡构造一个真正能完成任务的方法，而不是直接猜订单。
prompt.en: A store needs to mark the highest-value order in this batch for priority review. The batch has not been read and the highest-value order is unknown. Construct a method that can actually perform the task rather than guessing an order.

operation.zh: 阅读步骤与条件，移动步骤卡形成依赖链后提交。
operation.en: Read steps and conditions, move cards into a dependency chain, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 找最大值需要先有订单记录，写标记需要先知道目标订单；顺序来自信息依赖。算法是可执行方法，不是训练得到的模型。若先写标记，就是把尚未得到的信息当成已知。回看“算法、模型”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Finding the maximum requires the records; marking requires the identified order. Information dependencies determine order. An algorithm is an executable method, not a trained model. Marking first assumes unavailable information. Revisit Algorithm and Model.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.en: A maintenance team measures vibration and temperature and uses an existing model to estimate remaining operating hours. A separate background job uses differences from known maintenance outcomes to change weights. Identify the role of each record. Select one directly supported role per row; no code entry is needed.

operation.zh: 逐角色核对每个行动或资料格，只选允许组合后提交。
operation.en: Check each role/action or source cell and submit only permitted combinations.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 观测值提供资料，小时数是估计，误差驱动的权重改变才是训练，锁定参数处理新输入属于推理。产生新结果不等于训练；估计也不能当作已发生事实。回看“模型、训练、推理”。

completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 采购评审收到三份方案材料：甲只执行人工写定的审批条件；乙从样本调整参数但未说明网络结构；丙用相连节点和可学习权重构成多层网络，从数据学习表示。选择材料能支持的全部判断。
prompt.en: A procurement review has three proposals: A executes manually specified approval conditions; B adjusts parameters from examples without describing a network; C uses connected nodes with learnable weights in a multilayer network to learn representations. Select every conclusion supported by the materials.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 从材料推断的是方法证据与包含关系，不是靠“智能”宣传词或自动执行判断。乙缺结构证据应保留未知；丙的多层学习结构支持DL，DL仍属于ML。回看“AI、ML、DL、神经网络”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Infer method evidence and inclusion, not intelligence marketing or mere automation. B lacks architectural evidence for DL; C supplies it, while DL remains within ML. Revisit AI, ML, DL and Neural networks.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 门店要整理客户请求。四份原料分别是固定字段订单表、长篇投诉邮件、货架照片和电话录音。把它们交给最直接需要的加工工作；加工结果仍要核对原始资料，表格也不保证数值正确。
prompt.en: A store is organizing customer requests from an order table, a long complaint email, a shelf photo and a call recording. Route each to the most directly required preparation work. Verify processed results against sources; tabular values are not automatically accurate.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 来源形态和任务产物决定加工：字段统计、语言抽取、视觉解释与录音处理不是同一种操作。转写不是事实核验，统一字段也不自动修复错误。回看“结构化/非结构化数据、NLP、CV”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Source form and intended output determine preparation. Aggregation, language extraction, vision and audio handling differ. Transcription does not verify facts, and schemas do not repair wrong values. Revisit Structured and Unstructured Data, NLP and CV.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 补货演练中负责人确认：B的两行是同一订单重复导入，其他各为一笔。记录数量A40、B30、B30、C30。期初库存为0，团队按模型预测备货80件。计算去重后的订单笔数、真实需求总量以及缺货量。所有数量仅为本演练条件。
prompt.en: In this stocking exercise the owner confirms two B rows are one order imported twice; other rows are distinct. Quantities are A40, B30, B30 and C30. Initial stock is zero and the team stocks a forecast of 80 units. Compute the deduplicated order count, actual total demand and shortage. All quantities are exercise assumptions.

operation.zh: 整理输入条件，计算并填写各数值字段后提交。
operation.en: Organize inputs, calculate and fill each numeric field, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: B只计一次，3笔且40+30+30=100，100−80=20件缺货。原料重复会扭曲评价；预测是估计而非真实需求。题面未给损失价格，不能再编造损失金额。回看“数据质量、预测”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Count B once: three orders and 40+30+30=100 units; 100−80=20 short. Duplicate inputs distort evaluation, and forecasts are not actual demand. No loss price is given, so do not invent a monetary loss. Revisit Data Quality and Prediction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 仓库模型在参与参数调整的记录上分数很高，现在要服务条件不同的新仓库。新仓库还有一批从未用于调整参数的记录。选出能支持新用途判断的全部动作。
prompt.en: A warehouse model scores highly on records used for fitting, but will serve a new warehouse with different conditions. The new warehouse has records never used to adjust parameters. Select every action supporting a judgment about the new use.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 独立记录和环境比较提供新用途证据；把答案用于学习后再评分会污染这种证据。历史训练表现不能代替未见条件下的检验。回看“训练、历史数据与泛化、训练集与验证”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Independent records and environmental comparison supply new-use evidence. Fitting to the answers contaminates that evidence; past training performance does not replace evaluation on unseen conditions. Revisit Training, Generalization and Evaluation Sets.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 业务组有四项请求：甲有核实过的交易欺诈结果；乙没有预设客户类别、想探索相似群体；丙机器人在模拟环境行动后获得奖励；丁要把访谈写成摘要。选出有依据的全部建议，而不是给四项一律套同一方法。
prompt.en: A business group has four requests: A has verified fraud outcomes for transactions; B has no predefined customer categories and wants similar groups; C has a robot receiving rewards after simulated actions; D wants an interview summary. Select every justified recommendation instead of forcing one method onto all four.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 目标标签、无标签结构、交互累计回报与内容生成对应不同证据。分群不自动成为业务真相，单轮奖励不证明长期表现，流畅摘要不证明事实。回看“监督/无监督/强化学习、GenAI”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Labels, unlabeled structure, cumulative interactive return and generation involve different evidence. Clusters are not automatically business truth, one reward does not establish long-term performance, and fluent summaries do not prove facts. Revisit Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Learning and GenAI.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 团队有三项待办：统一“训练完成”和“已上线运行”的沟通；查找使用ML的AI系统框架范围；查找组织AI管理责任的框架范围。负责人打算用“知道标准编号”替代模型性能验证。选择能纠正该计划的全部说明。这里不作正式合规裁定。
prompt.en: The team must align discussion of training completion versus live operation, find the scope of frameworks for AI systems using ML, and find the scope of organizational AI management responsibilities. The owner proposes knowing standard numbers instead of performance validation. Select every correction; this is not a formal compliance determination.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 词汇一致帮助协作，但不能当作性能证据；系统框架与管理体系的范围不同，标准名不能代替正式要求核验或实际任务评价。回看“AI框架与统一词汇、ISO框架意识”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Shared vocabulary helps collaboration but is not performance evidence. System-framework and management-system scopes differ; names do not replace formal requirement checks or task evaluation. Revisit Shared AI Vocabulary and Standards Awareness.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

audit.reason: Replace the prior workshop with reviewed goal-linked independent tasks; move worked solutions out of the completion path.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFoundAll.zh: 本节物件已找到。可收藏想保留的物件，读完后整理入柜，再进入学习示范与练习。
afterFoundAll.en: This section’s objects are found. Favorite items you want to keep, read and file them, then enter the worked example and practice.

afterFiled.zh: 本节基础已整理。先看示范，再做引导练习，最后在新情境中独立应用。
afterFiled.en: Foundations are organized. View the worked example, try guided practice, then apply the ideas in a new situation.

sections.title: 确定并选择适当的 AI 解决方案类型

learnerGoals.zh: 按任务与价值选择规则或学习型方法
learnerGoals.en: Choose rules or learning by task and value

learnerGoals.zh: 设计有界代理行动
learnerGoals.en: Design bounded agent actions

learnerGoals.zh: 依据依赖分工与交接
learnerGoals.en: Assign work and handoffs by dependencies

learnerGoals.zh: 发现表现变化需调查原因
learnerGoals.en: Detect performance change and investigate causes

learnerGoals.zh: 按数据用途理解工具批准
learnerGoals.en: Interpret tool approval by data use

learnerGoals.zh: 同版规则可重复执行
learnerGoals.en: Execute a fixed-version rule reproducibly

learnerGoals.zh: 区分预测、内容和行动验收
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish prediction, content and action evaluation

learnerGoals.zh: 按实际失败类型决定重试或停止
learnerGoals.en: Decide retry versus stopping from failure evidence

learnerGoals.zh: 工具契约要约束副作用
learnerGoals.en: Constrain tool side effects with contracts

learnerGoals.zh: 按证据依赖安排交接
learnerGoals.en: Schedule handoff by evidence dependency

learnerGoals.zh: 区分输入漂移与关系变化证据
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish input and relationship change

learnerGoals.zh: 未触发紧急条件时先查因并独立验证修复
learnerGoals.en: Investigate and independently validate when no urgent trigger is present

learnerGoals.zh: 用批准范围和需求反馈治理影子AI
learnerGoals.en: Govern shadow AI through approved scope and feedback

scenario.zh: 示范：天气查询工具返回观测资料；会议预约工具会修改日历。接入两者时，都说明输入、输出和失败状态，预约还需明确外部状态变化及对应授权。
scenario.en: Demonstration: a weather query returns observations; a booking tool changes a calendar. Define inputs, outputs and failure states for both, plus external changes and authority for booking.

workedReasoning.zh: 相似的调用按钮可能有不同副作用；工具契约让调用者知道成功意味着什么、失败交给谁处理。这里是在解释契约，不记作学习者通过。
workedReasoning.en: Similar call buttons can have different side effects. Contracts explain what success means and who handles failure. This explains the contract rather than crediting learner mastery.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：报告撰写员只收到结论，没有来源和失败状态。应怎样补交接？
prompt.en: Guided practice: a writer receives conclusions but no sources or failure status. What should the handoff add?

text.zh: 补来源证据、当前状态和负责接手的人
text.en: Add source evidence, current status and the human response owner

text.zh: 让撰写员凭结论补造来源
text.en: Ask the writer to invent sources from the conclusion

reason.zh: 交接保留证据与责任，不能靠猜测补齐来源。
reason.en: Handoffs preserve evidence and accountability; guessing cannot supply missing sources.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 区分可先准备与必须等证据

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 识别可并行工作和被阻塞的结论
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: Identify independent work and blocked conclusions

text.zh: 区分可先准备与必须等证据
text.en: Separate preparations from evidence-dependent work

text.zh: 交接保留证据与责任，不能靠猜测补齐来源。
text.en: Handoffs preserve evidence and accountability; guessing cannot supply missing sources.

explanation.zh: 交接保留证据与责任，不能靠猜测补齐来源。
explanation.en: Handoffs preserve evidence and accountability; guessing cannot supply missing sources.

misconceptions.zh: 独立任务不需交接状态
misconceptions.en: Independent work needs no state handoff

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 补来源证据、当前状态和负责接手的人
workedAnswer.en: Add source evidence, current status and the human response owner

title.zh: 确定并选择适当的 AI 解决方案类型

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练：审批条件明确稳定，异常识别模式复杂难穷举。哪份建议更合理？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Approval conditions are stable, while anomaly patterns are complex. Which recommendation fits?

reason.zh: 规则系统也可能属于AI。这里比较确定性规则与学习型方法；按条件可表达性、价值、错误后果和维护成本选型。 常见误判：两个场景都必须上最复杂代理 回看相关知识与题面条件。
reason.en: Rule-based systems can also be AI. This comparison concerns deterministic rules and learning-based methods; choose according to how readily conditions can be expressed, value, error consequences and maintenance costs. Common error: Both require the most complex agent Revisit the linked knowledge and stated case conditions.

text.zh: 选AI时无需考虑维护成本
text.en: AI selection needs no maintenance assessment

text.zh: 审批先考虑确定性规则；异常识别评估学习型AI，并比较价值、错误后果与维护成本。
text.en: Consider deterministic rules for approval; evaluate learning-based AI for anomaly detection, comparing value, error consequences and maintenance costs.

text.zh: 两个场景都必须上最复杂代理
text.en: Both require the most complex agent

prompt.zh: 本演练：代理可查订单并拟定退款建议，团队准备开放真实退款工具。下一步应先补什么设计？
prompt.en: In this exercise: An agent can look up orders and draft refund advice. The team wants live refund access. What design is needed first?

reason.zh: 目标协调与外部行动权限不同，工具能力不能自动等于授权。 回看“AI代理与工具”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Goal coordination differs from external action authority; capability does not imply permission. Revisit AI agents and tools and check the evidence.

text.zh: 给代理目标后无需监督设计
text.en: A goal removes the need for oversight design

text.zh: 只要能聊天就默认可退款
text.en: Chat ability implies refund authority

text.zh: 明确行动权限、失败处理和人工监督
text.en: Define action permissions, failure handling and human oversight

prompt.zh: 本演练报告必须引用检索证据；已定稿报告的两种独立版式互不读取对方产物。把动作分为需等待交接或可独立开展。这里只按题面依赖判断。
prompt.en: Exercise reports must cite retrieval evidence. Two layout variants of an already finalized report do not consume one another’s output. Classify actions as waiting for handoff or independently executable, using only these dependencies.

text.zh: 需等待前置交接
text.en: Must await a prerequisite handoff

text.zh: 此题可独立开展
text.en: Independent in this case

text.zh: 证据尚未交付就准备写依证报告
text.en: Writing an evidence-grounded report before evidence arrives

text.zh: 已获定稿后制作版式A
text.en: Prepare layout A after receiving the finalized report

text.zh: 已获定稿后制作版式B
text.en: Prepare layout B after receiving the finalized report

reason.zh: 是否依赖对方产物决定本题等待关系；角色多不代表交接质量高，需要检查来源、状态与任务完成。 回看“代理工作依赖分流”关联知识。
reason.en: Consuming another output determines the waiting relationship here. More roles do not establish handoff quality; check sources, status and task completion. Revisit the knowledge linked to Agent-work dependency routing.

prompt.zh: 本演练同一口径下，基线100笔中错10笔，本次100笔中错18笔。填错误笔数增加多少、错误率增加多少个百分点；这里只做变化测量，不据此断言漂移根因。
prompt.en: Exercise under the same metric: baseline 10 errors in 100 cases, current 18 in 100. Enter additional errors and the increase in percentage points. Measure change only; this does not establish a drift cause.

reason.zh: 18−10=8笔，18%−10%=8个百分点；变化需结合输入、业务关系和反馈调查，不能由差值直接宣布根因或指定重训。 回看“部署变化测量台”关联知识。
reason.en: 18−10=8 errors and 18%−10%=8 percentage points. Investigate inputs, relationships and feedback; the difference alone does not establish a cause or mandate retraining. Revisit the knowledge linked to Deployment-change measurement desk.

prompt.zh: 本演练：员工因工作需求使用未批准工具，组织只有禁止名单。应补充什么？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Employees use unapproved tools to meet work needs and the organization only has a ban list. What is missing?

reason.zh: 可执行治理同时说明能用什么和怎么完成工作，不能只要求停用。 回看“工具分类与影子AI”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Actionable governance explains allowed tools and workable routes, rather than only demanding prohibition. Revisit Tool policies and shadow AI and check the evidence.

text.zh: 工具状态、数据边界和可用替代方案
text.en: Tool status, data boundaries and usable alternatives

text.zh: 公开可用就默认组织批准
text.en: Public availability implies organizational approval

text.zh: 只把禁止名单加长
text.en: Only lengthen the ban list

prompt.zh: 本演练同一版规则：金额严格大于100需复核，否则直接处理。本批金额是80、100、101、120、50。填写需复核与可直接处理的笔数；没有模型学习或规则版本变更。
prompt.en: Exercise rule version: amounts strictly greater than 100 require review; other cases proceed directly. Batch amounts are 80, 100, 101, 120 and 50. Enter the counts for review and direct handling; no learning or rule-version change occurs.

reason.zh: 101和120严格大于100；等于100仍走直接处理，所以2与3。判断依据是输入及同版明确条件，不是输入pass/review字符串。回看“确定性与可重复执行”。
reason.en: 101 and 120 are strictly above 100; equality goes to direct handling, producing counts 2 and 3. This applies an explicit rule rather than copies status codes. Revisit Deterministic execution.

prompt.zh: 本演练：把每项观察或任务放入对应类别。
prompt.en: In this exercise: put each observation or task in its matching category.

reason.zh: 输出估计、生成内容、外部行动各有不同失败方式，需分别验收。 回看“预测、生成与行动的边界”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Estimates, generated content and external actions have different failure modes and need separate acceptance. Revisit Prediction, generation and action and check the evidence.

text.zh: 预测
text.en: Prediction

text.zh: 生成
text.en: Generation

text.zh: 行动
text.en: Action

text.zh: 估计下周销量
text.en: Estimate next-week sales

text.zh: 起草采购说明
text.en: Draft procurement text

text.zh: 调用下单工具
text.en: Call the ordering tool

prompt.zh: 本演练代理可在不扩大权限、且没有执行副作用的前提下，对临时连接故障最多重试2次；遇到权限边界须停止交负责人。日志甲：业务工具尚未收到请求，连接超时，已重试0次。日志乙：业务工具回复“当前角色无权执行此操作”，已重试0次。分别选择此刻允许的行动。
prompt.en: Exercise policy permits up to two retries for temporary connection failures only without broader authority or executed side effects; permission boundaries require stopping and handing over to the owner. Log A: the tool has not received the request, connection timed out, zero retries used. Log B: the tool replies that the current role cannot perform the operation, zero retries used. Select the permitted action for each log.

reason.zh: 甲符合本题限定的临时失败条件，可在额度内重试；乙缺授权，不能因次数还剩而继续或自行扩权。相同剩余次数不代表相同处置，需看失败类型与副作用。回看“自主性与停止条件”。
reason.en: A meets the stated temporary-failure conditions and may retry within the allowance. B lacks authority; remaining retries do not authorize continuing or expanding permissions. Equal remaining counts do not imply equal actions; inspect failure type and side effects. Revisit Autonomy and stop conditions.

text.zh: 日志甲：请求未到工具，连接超时
text.en: Log A: request did not reach the tool; connection timeout

text.zh: 日志乙：当前角色不能执行
text.en: Log B: current role is not authorized

text.zh: 只在既定额度和权限内重试
text.en: Retry only within existing allowance and authority

text.zh: 停止并交指定负责人处置
text.en: Stop and hand over to the designated owner

prompt.zh: 本演练：退款工具只有输入输出说明，尚无授权和错误定义。上线评审应要求什么？
prompt.en: In this exercise: A refund tool specifies inputs and outputs but lacks authorization and error definitions. What must the launch review require?

reason.zh: 外部状态改变必须靠工具契约与服务端授权，文字提醒不能替代执行边界。 回看“工具契约与最小行动权限”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: State-changing calls need tool contracts and server-side authorization; prose reminders do not enforce boundaries. Revisit Tool contracts and action permissions and check the evidence.

text.zh: 补齐错误、授权、副作用及服务端权限检查和审计
text.en: Add errors, authorization, side effects, server-side permission checks and auditing

text.zh: 只在提示里写请谨慎退款
text.en: Only tell the model to refund carefully

text.zh: 可调用就证明所有用户都获授权
text.en: Callability proves all users are authorized

prompt.zh: 一份带引用报告要引用本次检索找到的材料。当前检索员尚未产出材料，时间已经很紧。把候选安排分到“可先做”或“必须等证据与交接”。不要把赶进度当作消除依赖。
prompt.en: A referenced report must cite material found by this retrieval run. The retriever has not produced it and time is short. Route candidate arrangements to work that can start or work that must await evidence and handover. Time pressure does not remove dependencies.

reason.zh: 格式准备与检索可先开展；具体结论要用实际证据，交接还需来源、状态和人类处置负责人。能识别可并行与受阻工作，而非照给定步骤排序。回看“交接与编排”。
reason.en: Formatting and retrieval can begin; evidence-specific conclusions need actual material. Handover must retain sources, status and a human response owner. Revisit Handoffs and orchestration.

text.zh: 可先做的准备工作
text.en: Preparatory work that can start

text.zh: 必须等证据与交接
text.en: Must await evidence and handover

text.zh: 确定报告格式和交付目标
text.en: Clarify report format and delivery goal

text.zh: 检索员查找获授权资料并记录来源
text.en: Retriever searches authorized sources and records provenance

text.zh: 撰写员据本次资料写具体结论与引用
text.en: Writer states source-specific conclusions and citations

prompt.zh: 本演练：把每项观察或任务放入对应类别。
prompt.en: In this exercise: put each observation or task in its matching category.

reason.zh: 输入变化不是业务损害的充分证据，区分观察和推断避免错误发布。 回看“数据漂移与概念漂移”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Input change alone does not establish business harm; separate observation from inference. Revisit Data drift and concept drift and check the evidence.

text.zh: 输入分布变化
text.en: Input distribution change

text.zh: 输入与目标关系变化
text.en: Input-target relationship change

text.zh: 新客户用词变化
text.en: New customers use different language

text.zh: 本演练模型仅以价格为输入；调查已确认促销期间同一价格对应的需求分布改变
text.en: The exercise model uses only price as input; investigation confirms demand distributions at the same price changed during promotion

prompt.zh: 一次例行监测发现质量较基线下降，但本演练没有触发组织的紧急回退条件。团队做了一项候选修复，只在用于开发它的样本上看过结果；有人准备立即把它用于全部请求。根因尚未确认。选择目前有证据支持的全部行动。
prompt.en: Routine monitoring finds quality below its baseline, but no organizational urgent-rollback condition is triggered in this exercise. A candidate fix has been examined only on the examples used to develop it; someone proposes applying it to all requests immediately. The cause is unconfirmed. Select every action currently supported.

reason.zh: 基线下降触发调查，不能直接证明原因或处置。开发样本不是独立修复证据，扩大部署要等验证；本情境未触发紧急回退，不能把不同响应条件一律套成同一种处置。回看“监测基线与反馈闭环”。
reason.en: A baseline decline calls for investigation, not a predetermined cause or remedy. Development examples are not independent evidence for a fix; expansion requires validation. No urgent trigger is present here; different response conditions cannot be treated as one rigid procedure. Revisit Monitoring baselines and feedback.

text.zh: 在未参与开发的代表性资料上验证修复，再决定是否扩大使用
text.en: Validate the fix on representative material not used in its development before deciding expansion

text.zh: 只因开发样本表现好就立即全量替换
text.en: Replace the system everywhere because development examples look good

text.zh: 只要出现告警就认定唯一解决办法是重训
text.en: Treat any alert as proof that retraining is the only solution

text.zh: 调查输入、业务关系和相关版本变化，核实下降原因
text.en: Investigate changes in inputs, business relationships and relevant versions to establish the cause

prompt.zh: 本演练：本演练工具X仅批准处理公开资料，员工要处理敏感合同。应怎么做？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Exercise tool X is approved only for public data, but an employee needs to process a sensitive contract. What should happen?

reason.zh: 批准状态必须结合具体数据和用途，替代渠道才能让治理可执行。 回看“工具分级与影子AI”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Approval must be combined with data and purpose limits; alternatives make governance actionable. Revisit Tool classification and shadow AI and check the evidence.

text.zh: 使用获准处理敏感资料的渠道，缺渠道则反馈需求
text.en: Use an approved sensitive-data route or report the unmet need

text.zh: 换个人账号就是合规替代
text.en: A personal account is a compliant alternative

text.zh: 工具已批准就可以处理任何资料
text.en: Approval allows any data

prompt.zh: 本演练：审批条件明确稳定，异常识别模式复杂难穷举。哪份建议更合理？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Approval conditions are stable, while anomaly patterns are complex. Which recommendation fits?

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 规则系统也可能属于AI。这里比较确定性规则与学习型方法；按条件可表达性、价值、错误后果和维护成本选型。 常见误判：两个场景都必须上最复杂代理 回看相关知识与题面条件。
incorrectFeedback.en: Rule-based systems can also be AI. This comparison concerns deterministic rules and learning-based methods; choose according to how readily conditions can be expressed, value, error consequences and maintenance costs. Common error: Both require the most complex agent Revisit the linked knowledge and stated case conditions.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练：代理可查订单并拟定退款建议，团队准备开放真实退款工具。下一步应先补什么设计？
prompt.en: In this exercise: An agent can look up orders and draft refund advice. The team wants live refund access. What design is needed first?

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 目标协调与外部行动权限不同，工具能力不能自动等于授权。 回看“AI代理与工具”，按证据重新判断。
incorrectFeedback.en: Goal coordination differs from external action authority; capability does not imply permission. Revisit AI agents and tools and check the evidence.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练报告必须引用检索证据；已定稿报告的两种独立版式互不读取对方产物。把动作分为需等待交接或可独立开展。这里只按题面依赖判断。
prompt.en: Exercise reports must cite retrieval evidence. Two layout variants of an already finalized report do not consume one another’s output. Classify actions as waiting for handoff or independently executable, using only these dependencies.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 是否依赖对方产物决定本题等待关系；角色多不代表交接质量高，需要检查来源、状态与任务完成。 回看“代理工作依赖分流”关联知识。
incorrectFeedback.en: Consuming another output determines the waiting relationship here. More roles do not establish handoff quality; check sources, status and task completion. Revisit the knowledge linked to Agent-work dependency routing.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练同一口径下，基线100笔中错10笔，本次100笔中错18笔。填错误笔数增加多少、错误率增加多少个百分点；这里只做变化测量，不据此断言漂移根因。
prompt.en: Exercise under the same metric: baseline 10 errors in 100 cases, current 18 in 100. Enter additional errors and the increase in percentage points. Measure change only; this does not establish a drift cause.

operation.zh: 整理输入条件，计算并填写各数值字段后提交。
operation.en: Organize inputs, calculate and fill each numeric field, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 18−10=8笔，18%−10%=8个百分点；变化需结合输入、业务关系和反馈调查，不能由差值直接宣布根因或指定重训。 回看“部署变化测量台”关联知识。
incorrectFeedback.en: 18−10=8 errors and 18%−10%=8 percentage points. Investigate inputs, relationships and feedback; the difference alone does not establish a cause or mandate retraining. Revisit the knowledge linked to Deployment-change measurement desk.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练：员工因工作需求使用未批准工具，组织只有禁止名单。应补充什么？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Employees use unapproved tools to meet work needs and the organization only has a ban list. What is missing?

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 可执行治理同时说明能用什么和怎么完成工作，不能只要求停用。 回看“工具分类与影子AI”，按证据重新判断。
incorrectFeedback.en: Actionable governance explains allowed tools and workable routes, rather than only demanding prohibition. Revisit Tool policies and shadow AI and check the evidence.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练同一版规则：金额严格大于100需复核，否则直接处理。本批金额是80、100、101、120、50。填写需复核与可直接处理的笔数；没有模型学习或规则版本变更。
prompt.en: Exercise rule version: amounts strictly greater than 100 require review; other cases proceed directly. Batch amounts are 80, 100, 101, 120 and 50. Enter the counts for review and direct handling; no learning or rule-version change occurs.

operation.zh: 整理输入条件，计算并填写各数值字段后提交。
operation.en: Organize inputs, calculate and fill each numeric field, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 101和120严格大于100；等于100仍走直接处理，所以2与3。判断依据是输入及同版明确条件，不是输入pass/review字符串。回看“确定性与可重复执行”。
incorrectFeedback.en: 101 and 120 are strictly above 100; equality goes to direct handling, producing counts 2 and 3. This applies an explicit rule rather than copies status codes. Revisit Deterministic execution.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

incorrectFeedback.en: Estimates, generated content and external actions have different failure modes and need separate acceptance. Revisit Prediction, generation and action and check the evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练代理可在不扩大权限、且没有执行副作用的前提下，对临时连接故障最多重试2次；遇到权限边界须停止交负责人。日志甲：业务工具尚未收到请求，连接超时，已重试0次。日志乙：业务工具回复“当前角色无权执行此操作”，已重试0次。分别选择此刻允许的行动。
prompt.en: Exercise policy permits up to two retries for temporary connection failures only without broader authority or executed side effects; permission boundaries require stopping and handing over to the owner. Log A: the tool has not received the request, connection timed out, zero retries used. Log B: the tool replies that the current role cannot perform the operation, zero retries used. Select the permitted action for each log.

operation.zh: 逐角色核对每个行动或资料格，只选允许组合后提交。
operation.en: Check each role/action or source cell and submit only permitted combinations.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 甲符合本题限定的临时失败条件，可在额度内重试；乙缺授权，不能因次数还剩而继续或自行扩权。相同剩余次数不代表相同处置，需看失败类型与副作用。回看“自主性与停止条件”。
incorrectFeedback.en: A meets the stated temporary-failure conditions and may retry within the allowance. B lacks authority; remaining retries do not authorize continuing or expanding permissions. Equal remaining counts do not imply equal actions; inspect failure type and side effects. Revisit Autonomy and stop conditions.

sections.title: 应用生成式人工智能概念和技术

learnerGoals.zh: 提示明确任务并代表性测试
learnerGoals.en: Specify prompt tasks and representative tests

learnerGoals.zh: 核算输入输出共同窗口
learnerGoals.en: Budget shared input/output context

learnerGoals.zh: 从资料到回答建立可核验依赖
learnerGoals.en: Build evidence-to-answer dependencies

learnerGoals.zh: 区分参数适配和事实维护
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish parameter adaptation from source maintenance

learnerGoals.zh: 将操作指令与原始资料分隔
learnerGoals.en: Separate source text and operational instructions

learnerGoals.zh: 按行为风险选择代表性测试
learnerGoals.en: Select representative tests by behavior risks

learnerGoals.zh: 完整计入全部窗口消息与输出
learnerGoals.en: Include all messages and reserved output

learnerGoals.zh: 筛选真正支持当前问题的资料
learnerGoals.en: Select sources supporting the current question

learnerGoals.zh: 逐句核验回复是否被有效条款支持
learnerGoals.en: Check each reply claim against an effective clause

learnerGoals.zh: 按事实与行为需求安排独立工作
learnerGoals.en: Plan separate factual and behavioral work

scenario.zh: 示范：窗口1200词元，输入900且留输出400，总预算1300超出100；可缩减相关性低的输入或拆分。
scenario.en: Demonstration: a 1,200-token window with 900 input and 400 reserved output needs 1,300 tokens, exceeding it by 100. Reduce irrelevant input or split the task.

workedReasoning.zh: 输入、工具消息和输出预留共享预算；检索还需权限与依据检查。
workedReasoning.en: Input, tool messages and reserved output share the budget; retrieval also needs authority and grounding checks.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：演练窗口2000，指令300、资料1200、历史200，输出预留500。至少减少多少词元？
prompt.en: Guided practice: exercise window 2,000; instructions 300, sources 1,200, history 200, output reserve 500. What is the minimum reduction?

reason.zh: 总计2200，超出200；不能只看输入未超窗。
reason.en: The total is 2,200, exceeding the window by 200; checking input alone misses the problem.

operation.zh: 整理输入条件，计算并填写各数值字段后提交。
operation.en: Organize inputs, calculate and fill each numeric field, then submit.

text.zh: 算超额而非只看输入
text.en: Calculate overflow, not input alone

text.zh: 总计2200，超出200；不能只看输入未超窗。
text.en: The total is 2,200, exceeding the window by 200; checking input alone misses the problem.

explanation.zh: 总计2200，超出200；不能只看输入未超窗。
explanation.en: The total is 2,200, exceeding the window by 200; checking input alone misses the problem.

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

title.zh: 应用生成式人工智能概念和技术

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练：团队只有一条“帮我总结”提示和一个漂亮回答。应补哪项设计？
prompt.en: In this exercise: The team has only a summarize prompt and one impressive answer. What design should be added?

reason.zh: 提示质量来自任务明确与代表性验证，不是修辞或单次观感。 回看“提示工程”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Prompt quality comes from clear tasks and representative evaluation, not rhetoric or a single impression. Revisit Prompt engineering and check the evidence.

text.zh: 明确目标、背景、约束、输出，并用代表任务验证
text.en: Specify goal, context, constraints and output, then evaluate representative tasks

text.zh: 一条好回答证明所有场景可用
text.en: One good answer proves all scenarios work

text.zh: 只加入更多赞美模型的文字
text.en: Only add praise for the model

prompt.zh: 本演练：窗口1000；输入800、输出预留300。填写至少需要减少的词元数，所有数字均为演练假设。
prompt.en: In this exercise: Window 1,000; input 800 and reserved output 300. Enter the minimum token reduction; all numbers are exercise assumptions.

reason.zh: 输入和输出共享窗口，预算超出不能只看输入；词元数须按实际分词。 回看“词元与上下文窗口”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Input and output share the window; checking input alone misses overflow, and tokens require actual tokenization. Revisit Tokens and context windows and check the evidence.

prompt.zh: 制度助手需要回答当前退货问题，资料权限已确认，但还没有拿到支持本问题的具体片段。用这些工作卡建立可检查的答复过程。不要把尚未取得的资料当成生成依据。
prompt.en: A policy assistant must answer a current returns question. Access is confirmed, but no passage supporting this question has been retrieved. Build an inspectable answer process from the work cards without treating unavailable material as context.

reason.zh: 上下文必须来自已找到的片段，候选答复出现后才可核对具体结论。这里通过信息输入输出依赖推导顺序，不给完整箭头答案；检索成功不保证生成正确。回看“RAG”。
reason.en: Context depends on retrieved passages, and checking a concrete claim depends on a candidate answer. These information dependencies determine order; retrieval success does not guarantee grounding. Revisit RAG.

text.zh: 逐项核对候选结论是否被片段支持
text.en: Check whether each candidate claim is supported by the passages

text.zh: 生成面向该问题的候选答复
text.en: Generate a candidate answer to the question

text.zh: 把找到的片段作为本次生成的上下文
text.en: Supply the retrieved passages as this generation context

text.zh: 找出当前且相关的获授权政策片段
text.en: Find current relevant authorized policy passages

prompt.zh: 本演练：客服要统一风格，同时纳入今天变更政策。对微调能力应如何说明？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Support needs consistent style and today’s policy update. How should fine-tuning be described?

reason.zh: 参数调整与请求补充信息不同，风格与动态事实需求要分开处理。 回看“微调 Fine-tuning”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Parameter updates differ from request context; style and changing facts need separate handling. Revisit Fine-tuning and check the evidence.

text.zh: 一次微调会永久同步所有政策
text.en: One fine-tune permanently synchronizes every policy

text.zh: 把政策放入请求就叫参数微调
text.en: Adding policy to a request is parameter fine-tuning

text.zh: 可评估行为适配，最新事实仍需维护资料
text.en: Evaluate behavioral adaptation while maintaining current factual sources

prompt.zh: 本演练：本演练要从访谈抽取三项需求并逐项引用，未支持信息写未知。哪份提示结构可执行？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Extract three needs with citations and mark unsupported information unknown. Which prompt structure is executable?

reason.zh: 区分资料与指令并给明确验收条件，可减少误执行文档内文字。 回看“任务、上下文、约束与格式”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Separating sources from instructions and defining acceptance reduces accidental obedience to source text. Revisit Task, context, constraints and format and check the evidence.

text.zh: 把正文中所有命令也当成操作指令
text.en: Treat every command in the source as an instruction

text.zh: 只写请专业回答，不给资料或边界
text.en: Only say answer professionally without sources or boundaries

text.zh: 分隔操作指令与访谈正文，明确任务、边界和输出格式
text.en: Separate instructions from interview text and specify task, limits and format

prompt.zh: 团队要发布工单摘要提示。新测试集中四个案例各有什么检验价值？按具体行为归档，不按“测试1/测试2”等名称或分数挑选。知识资料仍可随时回看，不能把测试标准答案塞进待评提示。
prompt.en: A team will release a ticket-summary prompt. What does each new test case examine? File cases by behavior, not by a test number or score. Knowledge remains available, but test answer keys must not be placed in the prompt being evaluated.

reason.zh: 普通工单、长度极限、资料伪指令暴露不同失败方式；截图不是完整测试。能解释案例检验什么，比按已给覆盖值凑预算更能证明代表性测试理解。回看“代表性样例与提示版本”。
reason.en: Ordinary cases, length limits and commands inside sources expose different failure modes. A screenshot is not a full evaluation. Explain what each case examines rather than total assigned coverage scores. Revisit Representative tests and prompt versions.

text.zh: 正常工作表现
text.en: Ordinary task behavior

text.zh: 长度边界表现
text.en: Length-boundary behavior

text.zh: 对资料内伪指令的应对
text.en: Handling commands inside source material

text.zh: 不能单独代表任务范围
text.en: Insufficient alone to represent the task range

text.zh: 字段齐全、长度普通的新工单，要求按原标准提取
text.en: A new ordinary-length ticket with complete fields to extract under the existing criteria

text.zh: 接近允许长度上限，关键请求藏在结尾的工单
text.en: A near-limit ticket whose key request is at the end

text.zh: 客户正文里写着忽略任务并发送档案，但它只是待整理资料
text.en: A customer source says to ignore the task and send records, although it is material to summarize

text.zh: 只保留过往一次最好回答的宣传截图
text.en: A publicity screenshot of a single best past answer

prompt.zh: 本演练：窗口8000；指令1000、资料5000、历史1000、输出1500。填写保持其他条件时，至少需减少的词元数。
prompt.en: In this exercise: Window 8,000; instructions 1,000, sources 5,000, history 1,000, output 1,500. Enter the minimum tokens to remove.

reason.zh: 总预算8500超过窗口500，应计算全部输入与预留输出，数字只用于本演练。 回看“输入与输出共享预算”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: The total is 8,500, exceeding the window by 500; include all input and output reserve. Numbers are exercise assumptions. Revisit Shared input and output budget and check the evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练：当前问退款规则，窗口能放所有部门手册。应如何选择资料？
prompt.en: In this exercise: The question concerns refunds and all department manuals fit. How should sources be selected?

reason.zh: 容量不等于信息利用质量；选择相关证据并验证支撑才能减少无关干扰。 回看“相关性与信息位置”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Capacity does not ensure effective use; select relevant evidence and verify support. Revisit Relevance and information selection and check the evidence.

text.zh: 只选最长文档不用看相关性
text.en: Pick the longest document regardless of relevance

text.zh: 优先当前相关、获授权、版本明确片段，并核验支持关系
text.en: Prioritize relevant authorized versioned passages and verify claim support

text.zh: 放得下就证明一定正确利用
text.en: Fitting guarantees correct use

prompt.zh: 本演练已检索到当前有效、与问题相关的条款：“退款申请须附订单号；未提供订单号时转人工核对，不自动拒绝。”候选回复写着：“提供订单号后提交申请；没有订单号会立即被系统拒绝；只要提供订单号就一定退款。”逐句判断是否受到这段条款支持，不因为回复带了引用就直接通过。
prompt.en: This exercise retrieved a current, relevant clause: “A refund request must include an order number. If it is absent, refer for human checking; do not reject automatically.” The candidate reply says: “Submit a request with the order number; without one the system immediately rejects it; providing the number guarantees a refund.” Judge each sentence against this clause rather than accept the reply merely because it has a citation.

reason.zh: 条款要求订单号，但缺失时是人工核对而非自动拒绝；条款也没保证申请一定通过。相关资料已找对仍可能出现不受支持的生成结论，两道关应分别核对。回看“RAG的检索与生成两道关”。
reason.en: The clause requires an order number but routes missing numbers to human checking, not automatic rejection; it also does not guarantee approval. Correct relevant retrieval can still lead to unsupported generation, so evaluate the two gates separately. Revisit Retrieval and generation checks in RAG.

text.zh: 这段条款支持
text.en: Supported by this clause

text.zh: 这段条款不支持
text.en: Not supported by this clause

text.zh: 退款申请需要订单号
text.en: A refund request needs an order number

text.zh: 没有订单号会被系统立即拒绝
text.en: Missing an order number causes immediate system rejection

text.zh: 只要提供订单号就保证退款
text.en: An order number guarantees a refund

prompt.zh: 服务团队有三项需求：每天核对最新已授权报价；使回复持续采用组织规定语气；上线后证明答复内容和行为达标。请选择每项需求必须安排的工作。检索与微调可以组合，并不互相替代。
prompt.en: A service team needs current authorized daily prices, a consistent organizational tone, and evidence that released answers meet content and behavior goals. Select the work needed for each requirement. Retrieval and fine-tuning can combine; neither replaces the other.

reason.zh: 动态报价需要资料维护，稳定行为可评估参数适配；两种变化都需要验证。只安排训练不能保证最新事实，只有资料更新也不能证明风格合格。回看“微调与外部知识更新”。
reason.en: Changing prices need source maintenance; stable behavior may call for adaptation evaluation. Both need validation. Training alone does not keep facts current; source updates alone do not establish tone quality. Revisit Fine-tuning versus external updates.

text.zh: 每天变化的报价
text.en: Daily changing prices

text.zh: 持续一致的语气
text.en: Consistent tone

text.zh: 证明上线答复达标
text.en: Evidence of release quality

text.zh: 维护当前资料及检索需求
text.en: Maintain current sources and retrieval needs

text.zh: 评估行为适配方案
text.en: Evaluate behavioral adaptation

text.zh: 按目标核验表现
text.en: Validate against objectives

prompt.zh: 本演练已检索到当前有效、与问题相关的条款：“退款申请须附订单号；未提供订单号时转人工核对，不自动拒绝。”候选回复写着：“提供订单号后提交申请；没有订单号会立即被系统拒绝；只要提供订单号就一定退款。”逐句判断是否受到这段条款支持，不因为回复带了引用就直接通过。
prompt.en: This exercise retrieved a current, relevant clause: “A refund request must include an order number. If it is absent, refer for human checking; do not reject automatically.” The candidate reply says: “Submit a request with the order number; without one the system immediately rejects it; providing the number guarantees a refund.” Judge each sentence against this clause rather than accept the reply merely because it has a citation.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 条款要求订单号，但缺失时是人工核对而非自动拒绝；条款也没保证申请一定通过。相关资料已找对仍可能出现不受支持的生成结论，两道关应分别核对。回看“RAG的检索与生成两道关”。
incorrectFeedback.en: The clause requires an order number but routes missing numbers to human checking, not automatic rejection; it also does not guarantee approval. Correct relevant retrieval can still lead to unsupported generation, so evaluate the two gates separately. Revisit Retrieval and generation checks in RAG.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 服务团队有三项需求：每天核对最新已授权报价；使回复持续采用组织规定语气；上线后证明答复内容和行为达标。请选择每项需求必须安排的工作。检索与微调可以组合，并不互相替代。
prompt.en: A service team needs current authorized daily prices, a consistent organizational tone, and evidence that released answers meet content and behavior goals. Select the work needed for each requirement. Retrieval and fine-tuning can combine; neither replaces the other.

operation.zh: 逐角色核对每个行动或资料格，只选允许组合后提交。
operation.en: Check each role/action or source cell and submit only permitted combinations.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 动态报价需要资料维护，稳定行为可评估参数适配；两种变化都需要验证。只安排训练不能保证最新事实，只有资料更新也不能证明风格合格。回看“微调与外部知识更新”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Changing prices need source maintenance; stable behavior may call for adaptation evaluation. Both need validation. Training alone does not keep facts current; source updates alone do not establish tone quality. Revisit Fine-tuning versus external updates.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

audit.reason: Replace the prior workshop with reviewed goal-linked independent tasks; move worked solutions out of the completion path.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFoundAll.zh: 本节物件已找到。可收藏想保留的物件，读完后整理入柜，再进入学习示范与练习。
afterFoundAll.en: This section’s objects are found. Favorite items you want to keep, read and file them, then enter the worked example and practice.

afterFiled.zh: 本节基础已整理。先看示范，再做引导练习，最后在新情境中独立应用。
afterFiled.en: Foundations are organized. View the worked example, try guided practice, then apply the ideas in a new situation.

sections.title: 制定符合业务目标的 AI 战略

learnerGoals.zh: 能先说明业务问题和可测结果，再评估技术。
learnerGoals.en: Define a business problem and observable result before evaluating technology.

learnerGoals.zh: 比较自建与购买时不漏持续成本。
learnerGoals.en: Include ongoing costs when comparing build and buy.

learnerGoals.zh: 项目排序须先过硬门槛，不能只看预期收益。
learnerGoals.en: Project ranking must respect hard gates rather than expected value alone.

learnerGoals.zh: 能判断明确规则已经足够时不必增加学习型方案。
learnerGoals.en: Recognize when explicit rules already meet the objective.

learnerGoals.zh: 知道演示可用不等于关键流程可安全切换。
learnerGoals.en: Know that a working demo does not establish safe critical-process cutover.

learnerGoals.zh: 写清受益者、基线与可测结果。
learnerGoals.en: Specify beneficiaries, baseline and measurable outcomes.

learnerGoals.zh: 按实际能力、交期、条款与退出需求比较交付路径。
learnerGoals.en: Compare delivery paths against capabilities, timing, terms and exit needs.

learnerGoals.zh: 高预期收益不能抵消未授权或缺失硬约束。
learnerGoals.en: Expected value cannot offset missing authorization or mandatory controls.

learnerGoals.zh: 能够为非AI替代或停止AI方案给出具体依据。
learnerGoals.en: Give specific evidence for a non-AI alternative or stopping an AI proposal.

learnerGoals.zh: 根据切换证据和接手条件决定谁能执行哪些连续性行动。
learnerGoals.en: Use cutover evidence and takeover conditions to determine who can perform continuity actions.

scenario.zh: 示范：先说明客服查资料慢及质量要求，再比较购买或自建；许可证相同不代表完整成本相同。
scenario.en: Demonstration: define slow policy lookup and quality requirements before comparing buy/build; equal license fees do not mean equal full costs.

workedReasoning.zh: 业务问题、结果和实现手段不可混淆。
workedReasoning.en: Business problems, outcomes and implementation means are distinct.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：把便笺归入现状、结果或手段。
prompt.en: Guided practice: sort notes into current state, outcome or means.

text.zh: 现状
text.en: Current state

text.zh: 期望结果
text.en: Desired outcome

text.zh: 实现手段
text.en: Implementation means

text.zh: 客户等待时间很长
text.en: Customers wait a long time

text.zh: 缩短等待并保持答复质量
text.en: Reduce waiting while preserving answer quality

text.zh: 购买助手工具
text.en: Purchase an assistant tool

reason.zh: 采购不是业务结果，现状与目标使技术选择可评估。
reason.en: Procurement is not a business outcome; baseline and goals make technology evaluable.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

learnerDecision.zh: 哪些记录说明当前问题、哪些表达改变、哪些只是候选工具。
learnerDecision.en: Separate current-problem evidence, intended changes and candidate tools.

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 将三张便笺放入现状证据、预期结果和技术候选三个对应类别。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: Place the three notes into current evidence, desired outcome and technology-option categories.

text.zh: 哪些记录说明当前问题、哪些表达改变、哪些只是候选工具。
text.en: Separate current-problem evidence, intended changes and candidate tools.

text.zh: 采购不是业务结果，现状与目标使技术选择可评估。
text.en: Procurement is not a business outcome; baseline and goals make technology evaluable.

explanation.zh: 采购不是业务结果，现状与目标使技术选择可评估。
explanation.en: Procurement is not a business outcome; baseline and goals make technology evaluable.

misconceptions.zh: 工具名称就是成功标准。
misconceptions.en: A tool name is a success measure.

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 客户等待时间很长 → 现状；缩短等待并保持答复质量 → 期望结果；购买助手工具 → 实现手段
workedAnswer.en: Customers wait a long time → Current state; Reduce waiting while preserving answer quality → Desired outcome; Purchase an assistant tool → Implementation means

title.zh: 制定符合业务目标的 AI 战略

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练：维修团队说“上一个AI系统”，但还不清楚延误发生在哪个环节，也没有改善口径。三张工作单最终都要完成。请按能产出下一张工作单所需依据的顺序安排；不要按卡片当前摆放排序。
prompt.en: Exercise: a maintenance team requests an AI system, but the delayed step and improvement measure are unknown. All three work orders must eventually be completed. Arrange them so each produces the evidence needed by the next, not by their current display position.

reason.zh: 未定位问题就无法确定该测什么；没有可比较结果就无法判断技术是否有用。若先试模型，得到的只是工具表现而不是业务改善证据。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Without a diagnosed problem the team cannot choose the right measure; without comparable outcomes it cannot judge technology usefulness. Trying a model first supplies tool performance, not evidence of business improvement. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 用约定的验收口径比较技术方案
text.en: Compare technology options using the agreed acceptance measures

text.zh: 查明受影响人员、维修环节和延误原因
text.en: Investigate affected people, workflow steps and causes of delay

text.zh: 依据查明的问题记录基线并约定改善口径
text.en: Record a baseline and agree improvement measures for the diagnosed problem

prompt.zh: 本演练只比较同一年、相同功能与合规条件下的成本，不据此单独决定购买。购买：许可20、集成10、运维15、退出准备5；自建：开发25、集成10、运维25、退出准备5。分别填写完整成本，单位均为万元。
prompt.en: Exercise: compare costs for the same year, functions and compliance conditions; cost alone does not decide purchasing. Buy: license 20, integration 10, operations 15, exit preparation 5. Build: development 25, integration 10, operations 25, exit preparation 5. Enter full costs in ten-thousand currency units.

reason.zh: 购买完整成本20+10+15+5=50；自建25+10+25+5=65。只看许可或开发会漏持续成本；还须另外核验能力、交期与条款。 回看“自建、购买或合作：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Full purchase cost is 20+10+15+5=50; build cost is 25+10+25+5=65. License or development alone omits continuing costs; capabilities, deadlines and terms still need separate checks. Revisit Build, buy or partner: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练只有4点试验预算，最低试验价值4点。所有数据授权已核实；A因资料尚不能取得，本轮不可执行；B资料与负责人齐备，成本3价值4；C仅为展示界面，成本1价值0；D资料齐备但成本5价值8。选出本轮可实行且满足预算/价值的组合。分值只用于比较，不表示真实收益。
prompt.en: Exercise trial budget is 4 points with minimum trial value 4. Data authorization is checked for all candidates. A has inaccessible source data and cannot run this round. B has sources and an owner, cost 3/value 4. C is a UI demonstration only, cost 1/value 0. D has sources but costs 5/value 8. Select an executable package meeting the budget and value constraints. Points are comparison assumptions, not real returns.

reason.zh: B具备试验条件且在预算内；D价值虽高但超预算，A无资料无法验证。可以加C但它不增加试验价值，不能以展示代替验证。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: B can be tested within budget; D exceeds it and A lacks the data needed for validation. C may be added but provides no trial value; a demonstration cannot replace validation. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: A：资料不可取得，成本1，价值9
text.en: A: inaccessible data, cost 1, value 9

text.zh: B：有资料与负责人，成本3，价值4
text.en: B: sources and owner ready, cost 3, value 4

text.zh: C：只做展示，成本1，价值0
text.en: C: demonstration only, cost 1, value 0

text.zh: D：成本5，价值8
text.en: D: cost 5, value 8

prompt.zh: 本演练：固定税号格式校验由明确规则完全解决；AI方案成本更高且没有额外收益。选择方案。
prompt.en: Exercise: explicit rules fully validate a fixed tax-ID format. AI costs more with no extra benefit. Choose.

reason.zh: 题设中规则已满足目标；新增AI没有证明收益。 回看「什么时候不该用AI」。
reason.en: Rules already meet the stated goal; added AI has no demonstrated benefit. Revisit “When not to use AI”.

text.zh: 必须训练模型
text.en: Train a model regardless

text.zh: 采用规则校验
text.en: Use rules validation

text.zh: 用生成文本代替校验
text.en: Replace validation with generated prose

prompt.zh: 本演练：试切换共400次请求，12次失败，旧流程仍可人工受理。填写本次失败率百分数，不输入%符号。
prompt.en: Exercise: a limited cutover handled 400 requests with 12 failures; manual processing remains available. Enter the failure percentage without the % sign.

reason.zh: 12÷400×100%=3%。失败比例是运行证据，不等于已经确定根因，也不能单靠系统能启动宣告迁移成功。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 12÷400×100%=3%. This is operating evidence, not an established cause or proof of migration success. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练：组织预先约定超过2%应停止扩大试切换；自动恢复路径尚未演练，人工受理已验证可用。选择合理处置。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise: the organization predeclared a pause on expansion above 2%; automatic recovery is untested while manual handling is verified. Select an appropriate response.

reason.zh: 3%超过预设2%门槛；先限制影响、使用已验证连续性安排，并验证缺失条件。这里不要求等待根因确认后才控制影响。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 3% exceeds the predefined 2% gate. Limit impact, use verified continuity arrangements and validate missing conditions. Impact control need not wait for root-cause confirmation. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 跳过演练直接把全部请求切到未知自动恢复路径
text.en: Move all requests to the untested automatic recovery path

text.zh: 只要能启动就继续全量替换
text.en: Continue a full replacement because the system starts

text.zh: 暂停扩大并用已验证人工路径维持服务，补齐恢复验证
text.en: Pause expansion, maintain service with verified manual handling and validate recovery

prompt.zh: 本演练收集了三张项目便笺。把现状证据、预期结果与技术选择分别归档；不能把技术名当成结果。
prompt.en: Three project notes were collected in this exercise. File current-state evidence, desired outcomes and technology choices separately; a technology name is not an outcome.

reason.zh: 现状记录提供比较基线；质量与时间的目标是可测结果；模型采购是候选手段。混淆它们就无法判断改善。 回看“问题、受益者与可观测结果：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Current-state records provide the baseline; quality and time targets define measurable outcomes; model purchasing is a possible means. Confusing them prevents improvement assessment. Revisit Problem, beneficiary and outcome: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

text.zh: 现状证据
text.en: Current-state evidence

text.zh: 预期结果
text.en: Desired outcome

text.zh: 技术候选
text.en: Technology option

text.zh: 客服查一份制度平均需8分钟
text.en: Support needs an average of 8 minutes to locate a policy

text.zh: 缩短查找时间且质量不下降
text.en: Reduce lookup time without lowering quality

text.zh: 评估购买某模型服务
text.en: Evaluate a model-service purchase

prompt.zh: 本演练：三个月上线且无运维团队；现成服务满足需求。选择合理下一步。
prompt.en: Exercise: launch in three months, no operations team, and a managed service fits needs. Choose the next step.

reason.zh: 条件使购买值得优先评估，但适配和责任仍要核验。 回看「自建、购买与合作的比较维度」。
reason.en: The conditions favor evaluating purchase, while fit and responsibilities still need checking. Revisit “Build, buy and partner criteria”.

text.zh: 购买后不再检查数据用途
text.en: Stop checking data use after purchase

text.zh: 评估购买方案的条款、集成和退出成本并保留用途责任
text.en: Evaluate purchase terms, integration and exit costs while retaining use responsibilities

text.zh: 无条件自建且不估维护
text.en: Build unconditionally without estimating maintenance

prompt.zh: 本演练：预算5，最低价值6，必须做授权审查。选项目，禁止项不可选。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 5, minimum value 6, authorization review required; blocked items cannot be selected.

reason.zh: 审查与获授权试点合计成本5价值6；禁止项即使价值高仍不可入选。 回看「价值、可行性与硬性约束」。
reason.en: Review plus authorized pilot cost 5 and yield value 6; blocked work remains ineligible despite its score. Revisit “Value, feasibility and hard constraints”.

text.zh: 授权审查，成本1，价值1
text.en: Authorization review: cost 1, value 1

text.zh: 获授权试点，成本4，价值5
text.en: Authorized pilot: cost 4, value 5

text.zh: 未授权高收益项目，禁止
text.en: Unauthorized high-return project: blocked

prompt.zh: 本演练评审两项申请：A的既有检索已满足找文件目标，新增生成器未改善结果且增加成本；B有预测价值假设，但训练资料无法取得。分别将当前主要停止/暂停理由归类，不依据已花多少钱。
prompt.en: Exercise review: A already meets its document-finding objective through search; adding a generator does not improve outcomes and increases cost. B has a predictive-value hypothesis but cannot obtain training sources. Classify the current primary stopping or pause reason, not past spending.

reason.zh: A是替代方案已达标而增量价值不足；B是验证条件缺失。两者都不能靠沉没投入或AI标签合理化，处理原因却不同。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: A lacks incremental value because an alternative already works; B lacks validation prerequisites. Neither sunk spending nor an AI label resolves either problem, and the reasons differ. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 没有可验证的新增价值
text.en: No verifiable added value

text.zh: 无法验证所需数据条件
text.en: Required data conditions cannot be validated

text.zh: A：现有检索达标，新增成本却无改善
text.en: A: search meets the goal; added cost brings no improvement

text.zh: B：预测假设待验，训练资料不可取得
text.en: B: prediction hypothesis untested; training sources unavailable

prompt.zh: 本演练：夜间试运行800次请求，24次失败。请算出失败率百分数；已批准的回退门槛为2%，门槛不因本轮结果改变。
prompt.en: Exercise: a nighttime pilot has 24 failures among 800 requests. Calculate the failure percentage. The approved rollback gate is 2% and does not change because of this result.

reason.zh: 24÷800×100%=3%；这是观测结果，不能把它写成预先政策门槛。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 24÷800×100%=3%; this is an observation, not a replacement for the predeclared policy threshold. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练。组织预案的一般授权政策是：只有当前当班且响应资格有效的团队可接手异常；执行某恢复路径还需该团队具备这条路径的有效演练记录；没人获准临时放宽门槛。角色登记：甲组响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效，但本时段不当班；乙组当前当班、响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效；丙组当前当班、响应资格有效，但尚无恢复演练记录；丁组当前当班、完成过旧流程演练，但响应资格尚未批准。新平台自动恢复尚无任何团队的有效演练记录。依据政策与角色登记交叉判断本时段允许的组合，不凭会操作或人在场就推定授权。以上为本演练政策。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise. General authorization policy: a team may take over an incident only while on duty and holding a valid response qualification. Executing a recovery route additionally requires that team to have a valid drill record for that route. Nobody may relax the threshold ad hoc. Roster: Team A has valid response qualification and an old-process recovery drill but is off duty; Team B is on duty with both qualification and that drill; Team C is on duty and qualified but has no recovery drill; Team D is on duty and has completed the old-process drill but its response qualification is not yet approved. No team has a valid new-platform recovery drill. Cross-check the roster against policy to select permitted combinations for this period; presence or ability alone does not establish authorization. This policy applies only to the exercise.

reason.zh: 甲组缺当前当班条件，丁组缺正式响应资格，两者都不能仅凭资历或会操作接手。乙组同时满足接手条件和旧流程恢复演练条件；丙组能接手但缺恢复演练，不能执行恢复。新平台无人有有效演练，且任何组都不能放宽门槛。判断来自条件交叉，而不是照抄一个给定角色名称。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Team A lacks current duty coverage; Team D lacks formal response qualification. Neither tenure nor operating skill alone permits takeover. Team B meets takeover and old-process drill conditions. Team C may take over but lacks the drill needed for recovery. Nobody has a valid new-platform drill or authority to relax the threshold. The judgment cross-checks conditions rather than copies a named role. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练：维修团队说“上一个AI系统”，但还不清楚延误发生在哪个环节，也没有改善口径。三张工作单最终都要完成。请按能产出下一张工作单所需依据的顺序安排；不要按卡片当前摆放排序。

incorrectFeedback.zh: 未定位问题就无法确定该测什么；没有可比较结果就无法判断技术是否有用。若先试模型，得到的只是工具表现而不是业务改善证据。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
incorrectFeedback.en: Without a diagnosed problem the team cannot choose the right measure; without comparable outcomes it cannot judge technology usefulness. Trying a model first supplies tool performance, not evidence of business improvement. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练只比较同一年、相同功能与合规条件下的成本，不据此单独决定购买。购买：许可20、集成10、运维15、退出准备5；自建：开发25、集成10、运维25、退出准备5。分别填写完整成本，单位均为万元。
prompt.en: Exercise: compare costs for the same year, functions and compliance conditions; cost alone does not decide purchasing. Buy: license 20, integration 10, operations 15, exit preparation 5. Build: development 25, integration 10, operations 25, exit preparation 5. Enter full costs in ten-thousand currency units.

operation.zh: 整理输入条件，计算并填写各数值字段后提交。

incorrectFeedback.zh: 购买完整成本20+10+15+5=50；自建25+10+25+5=65。只看许可或开发会漏持续成本；还须另外核验能力、交期与条款。 回看“自建、购买或合作：决策演练”和本演练条件。
incorrectFeedback.en: Full purchase cost is 20+10+15+5=50; build cost is 25+10+25+5=65. License or development alone omits continuing costs; capabilities, deadlines and terms still need separate checks. Revisit Build, buy or partner: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练。组织预案的一般授权政策是：只有当前当班且响应资格有效的团队可接手异常；执行某恢复路径还需该团队具备这条路径的有效演练记录；没人获准临时放宽门槛。角色登记：甲组响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效，但本时段不当班；乙组当前当班、响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效；丙组当前当班、响应资格有效，但尚无恢复演练记录；丁组当前当班、完成过旧流程演练，但响应资格尚未批准。新平台自动恢复尚无任何团队的有效演练记录。依据政策与角色登记交叉判断本时段允许的组合，不凭会操作或人在场就推定授权。以上为本演练政策。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise. General authorization policy: a team may take over an incident only while on duty and holding a valid response qualification. This policy applies only to the exercise.
