sections.title: 衡量和演示 AI 商业价值

learnerGoals.zh: 分开衡量现金收益与满意度等无形收益。
learnerGoals.en: Measure cash benefits separately from satisfaction and other intangible benefits.

learnerGoals.zh: 用同口径比较完整业务处理时间。
learnerGoals.en: Compare end-to-end handling time on a consistent basis.

learnerGoals.zh: 计算同期间完整成本与简单ROI。
learnerGoals.en: Calculate full same-period costs and simple ROI.

learnerGoals.zh: 知道早期信号不保证最终成功。
learnerGoals.en: Know that early signals do not guarantee final success.

learnerGoals.zh: 在质量约束内核算用量和完整运营预算。
learnerGoals.en: Account for usage and operating budgets under a quality constraint.

learnerGoals.zh: 用业务变化而非工具热度评价结果。
learnerGoals.en: Evaluate business changes rather than tool popularity.

learnerGoals.zh: 报告已实现现金和独立体验证据，不编造换算。
learnerGoals.en: Report realized cash and independent experience evidence without fabricated conversion.

learnerGoals.zh: 区分AI效果与同期其他变化。
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish AI effects from simultaneous changes.

learnerGoals.zh: 算ROI前核对期间、单位、收益实现和成本范围。
learnerGoals.en: Check period, units, benefit realization and cost scope before ROI.

learnerGoals.zh: 用实际支出变化核验已兑现现金节省，不把重复申报变成两份收益。
learnerGoals.en: Verify realized cash savings against actual expenditure without treating duplicate claims as separate benefits.

learnerGoals.zh: 检验先导信号是否真的伴随业务结果改善。
learnerGoals.en: Test whether leading signals are accompanied by improved business outcomes.

learnerGoals.zh: 预算覆盖资料、运营、人工与退出等阶段。
learnerGoals.en: Include source, operating, human and exit stages in budgets.

scenario.zh: 示范：同年收益120、完整成本80，净收益40，简单ROI为50%；总收益除成本不是净ROI。
scenario.en: Demonstration: same-year benefits 120 and full cost 80 give net benefit 40 and simple ROI 50%; gross benefit divided by cost is not net ROI.

workedReasoning.zh: 核算边界一致，活动指标与实际价值分别验证。
workedReasoning.en: Keep accounting scope consistent and distinguish activity measures from realized value.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：演练同年收益180、完整成本120。填净收益和简单ROI百分数。
prompt.en: Guided practice: same-year benefits 180 and full cost 120. Enter net benefit and simple ROI percentage.

operation.zh: 整理输入条件，计算并填写各数值字段后提交。
operation.en: Organize inputs, calculate and fill each numeric field, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 有数字不表示可相除；材料是否支持同口径比较。
learnerDecision.en: Numbers alone do not justify division; evidence must support comparable scope.

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 将同年完整资料申请放入可计算类，将期间未协调和缺复核成本的申请放入补资料类。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: Classify the complete same-year request as calculable, and requests with unreconciled periods or missing review costs as needing evidence.

text.zh: 有数字不表示可相除；材料是否支持同口径比较。
text.en: Numbers alone do not justify division; evidence must support comparable scope.

misconceptions.zh: 季度收益可以直接除全年成本，遗漏成本也照算。
misconceptions.en: Quarterly benefits can be divided by annual costs, or omitted costs ignored.

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

title.zh: 衡量和演示 AI 商业价值

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练将指标分入“可核验金额”或“单独测量的体验”；不作金额折算。
prompt.en: Exercise: classify measures as verifiable money or separately measured experience; do not convert experience into cash.

reason.zh: 已兑现金额与体验改善都可有价值，但后者没有题设支持的现金换算。 回看「有形与无形收益」。
reason.en: Realized money and experience can both matter, but no cash conversion for experience is supported here. Revisit “Tangible and intangible benefits”.

text.zh: 可核验金额
text.en: Verifiable money

text.zh: 体验指标
text.en: Experience measure

text.zh: 已兑现支出减少2万元
text.en: Realized spending reduction of 20,000

text.zh: 满意度问卷提高
text.en: Improved satisfaction survey

text.zh: 已收到新增收入
text.en: Additional revenue actually received

prompt.zh: 本演练配送异常工单旧流程每单65分钟；新流程生成初稿7分钟、核验修改18分钟，其他环节耗时不变。填写包含核验后的每单净节省分钟数，不把生成初稿当整单处理完成。
prompt.en: Exercise: the old delivery-exception workflow took 65 minutes per case. The new workflow uses 7 minutes to draft and 18 minutes to verify and correct; other steps are unchanged. Enter net minutes saved per case including review, rather than treat drafting as the whole process.

reason.zh: 新流程需7+18=25分钟，65−25=40分钟。只用生成时间会把仍需核验的工作当作已经省去；本结果是时间变化，不直接等于现金减少。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: The new workflow takes 7+18=25 minutes, so 65−25=40 minutes are saved. Using drafting time alone ignores verification work. Time change does not directly establish reduced cash expenditure. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练：同年收益180万元，部署40、调用20、培训10、维护20、复核10万元。填简单ROI百分数。
prompt.en: Exercise: same-year benefits 180; costs: deployment 40, usage 20, training 10, maintenance 20, review 10, all in the same unit. Enter simple ROI percent.

reason.zh: 完整成本100，净收益80，因此ROI=80/100=80%；不能漏复核或把收益当净收益。 回看「收益与ROI」。
reason.en: Full costs are 100 and net benefit 80, so ROI is 80%; include review and subtract costs. Revisit “Benefits and ROI”.

label.en: ROI percent (enter a number without the % sign)

prompt.zh: 本演练：将培训完成率与已实现净收益分到相应类别。
prompt.en: Exercise: classify training completion and realized net benefit.

reason.zh: 培训可能支持成功条件，但最终净收益需要另行观察。 回看「先导性指标」。
reason.en: Training may support success conditions, but final net benefit requires separate observation. Revisit “Leading indicators”.

text.zh: 先导信号
text.en: Leading signal

text.zh: 结果
text.en: Outcome

text.zh: 培训完成率
text.en: Training completion

text.zh: 已实现净收益
text.en: Realized net benefit

prompt.zh: 本演练当月已有质量验收通过，不得用降质省钱。固定运维40万元，调用20000次、每次10元，复核1000次、每次100元；月预算80万元。填写总成本和预算余量，单位万元。
prompt.en: Exercise quality acceptance has passed and may not be sacrificed for savings. Monthly fixed operations cost 40 ten-thousand units; 20,000 calls cost 10 currency units each; 1,000 reviews cost 100 each. Budget: 80 ten-thousand units. Enter total cost and remaining budget in ten-thousand units.

reason.zh: 调用20万元、复核10万元，加固定40共70，余量80−70=10。漏复核或混用元与万元会低估成本；优化仍要保持质量。 回看“成本规划与优化：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Calls cost 20 ten-thousand units and review 10; plus fixed 40 gives 70, leaving 80−70=10. Omitting review or mixing units understates cost; optimization must preserve quality. Revisit Cost planning and optimization: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：分类指标，活动是做了多少，结果是业务表现变化。
prompt.en: Exercise: classify measures; activity counts actions, outcomes capture business change.

reason.zh: 账号数记录部署活动；差错和含复核周期才反映该业务表现。 回看「结果指标与活动指标」。
reason.en: Account count records deployment; errors and review-inclusive cycle time reflect workflow performance. Revisit “Outcome and activity measures”.

text.zh: 活动
text.en: Activity

text.zh: 结果
text.en: Outcome

text.zh: 开通账号数
text.en: Accounts created

text.zh: 工单差错率
text.en: Ticket error rate

text.zh: 含复核的处理周期
text.en: Handling cycle including review

prompt.zh: 本演练：实际支出减少5万元，信任问卷提高但无货币换算依据。选择报告。
prompt.en: Exercise: spending falls by 50,000; trust surveys improve without a monetary conversion basis. Choose a report.

reason.zh: 金额已核验，信任有独立测量；不能凭空赋予现金额。 回看「有形收益与无形收益」。
reason.en: Money is verified and trust measured separately; no invented cash value is justified. Revisit “Tangible and intangible benefits”.

text.zh: 信任无需测量
text.en: Trust needs no measurement

text.zh: 分别报告5万元支出减少与信任问卷变化
text.en: Report the 50,000 reduction separately from trust survey changes

text.zh: 将信任提升记作另5万元现金
text.en: Record trust improvement as another 50,000 cash

prompt.zh: 本演练：同期工单难度下降且上线AI。选择更能区分AI效果的下一轮设计。
prompt.en: Exercise: tickets became easier while AI launched. Select the next design that better distinguishes AI effects.

reason.zh: 匹配与对照减少同期变化干扰；不同任务直接比较不能支持该归因。 回看「可比较基线与归因」。
reason.en: Matching and comparison reduce confounding; unlike tasks do not support attribution. Revisit “Comparable baselines and attribution”.

text.zh: 按难度和业务量匹配，统一含复核口径设置对照
text.en: Match difficulty and volume, use review-inclusive definitions and a comparison group

text.zh: 把所有改善都记给AI
text.en: Attribute every improvement to AI

text.zh: 只比较去年最难工单和本月最易工单
text.en: Compare last year’s hardest with this month’s easiest tickets

prompt.zh: 本演练收到三份ROI申请。将可按当前材料计算同期间简单ROI的申请，与必须补资料的申请分开。不需要算出ROI。
prompt.en: Exercise: three ROI requests arrive. Separate those whose current evidence permits a same-period simple ROI calculation from those needing more information. Do not calculate ROI.

reason.zh: 简单ROI要求收益与完整成本在同期间、同单位和明确实现范围内。两个缺口申请不是收益一定差，而是当前材料不足以计算可比较的结果。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Simple ROI needs benefits and full costs within the same period, units and realization scope. The incomplete requests do not necessarily have poor returns; their evidence is insufficient for comparable calculation. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 当前核算范围足够
text.en: Current accounting scope sufficient

text.zh: 需要补齐核算资料
text.en: Accounting information missing

text.zh: 同一年已兑现收益和该年全部数据/部署/运行/培训/复核/维护/退出成本，单位一致
text.en: Realized benefits and all data, deployment, operating, training, review, maintenance and exit costs for the same year, in common units

text.zh: 仅有本季度收益和全年成本，未说明对应关系
text.en: Only quarterly benefits and annual costs, with no period reconciliation

text.zh: 报告明确尚未纳入人工复核成本
text.en: The report explicitly excludes human-review costs

prompt.zh: 本演练只核对一项同期间、同服务质量的外包支出：旧账单12000元，新账单8500元，均已结算。甲部门把这笔减少报告为收益，乙部门也引用同一张新旧账单，汇总表把两份报告都相加。填写这项实际现金支出减少，以及汇总表因重复报告而多记的金额；不计算整个项目净收益。
prompt.en: Exercise: check one outsourced expense for the same period and service quality. The old invoice was 12,000 and the new invoice 8,500; both are settled. Department A reports this reduction as a benefit, and Department B cites the very same invoice pair. A summary adds both reports. Enter the actual cash expenditure reduction and the summary overstatement from duplication. Do not calculate the whole project net benefit.

reason.zh: 这项支出只实际减少12000−8500=3500元。两份报告指向同一账单变化，合计7000会多记3500；报告数量不增加已兑现现金。这里只验证该项支出，不能据此跳过整个项目其他成本。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: This expense fell by 12,000−8,500=3,500. Two reports concern the same invoice change; recording 7,000 overstates it by 3,500. More reports do not create more realized cash. This checks one expense, not the rest of the project costs. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

label.zh: 这项实际现金支出减少（元）
label.en: Actual cash reduction for this expense

prompt.zh: 本演练：培训完成率由50%升至95%。同口径服务记录为培训前200笔20笔差错，培训后300笔30笔差错。填写前后差错率百分数。
prompt.en: Exercise: training completion increased from 50% to 95%. Comparable service records show 20 errors in 200 cases before training and 30 in 300 after. Enter the two error percentages.

reason.zh: 20÷200与30÷300都等于10%；不同业务量必须先统一比例，不能只比差错个数。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 20÷200 and 30÷300 both equal 10%; normalize different volumes before comparing rather than use counts alone. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 根据刚才本演练的两期差错率，哪些报告表述有依据？
prompt.en: Using the two exercise error rates, which report statements are supported?

reason.zh: 早期信号提高而差错率不变，说明不能用活动代替业务结果。未观察到本指标改善也不证明培训完全无价值，仍需调查能力和其他结果。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: The signal improved while error rate stayed the same, so activity cannot replace outcomes. Lack of improvement in this metric does not prove training has no value; investigate capability and other outcomes. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 培训完成率已足以证明业务质量提高
text.en: Training completion alone proves better service quality

text.zh: 当前服务质量指标尚未显示改善，需调查联系
text.en: The current service-quality metric shows no improvement; investigate the link

text.zh: 培训完成这一早期信号提高
text.en: The early training-completion signal improved

incorrectFeedback.zh: 20÷200与30÷300都等于10%；不同业务量必须先统一比例，不能只比差错个数。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
incorrectFeedback.en: 20÷200 and 30÷300 both equal 10%; normalize different volumes before comparing rather than use counts alone. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 根据刚才本演练的两期差错率，哪些报告表述有依据？
prompt.en: Using the two exercise error rates, which report statements are supported?

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 早期信号提高而差错率不变，说明不能用活动代替业务结果。未观察到本指标改善也不证明培训完全无价值，仍需调查能力和其他结果。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
incorrectFeedback.en: The signal improved while error rate stayed the same, so activity cannot replace outcomes. Lack of improvement in this metric does not prove training has no value; investigate capability and other outcomes. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练年度预算：数据整理10、集成20、调用30、培训5、复核15、监测维护10、退出准备10（万元）。求总成本。
prompt.en: Exercise annual budget: data 10, integration 20, calls 30, training 5, review 15, monitoring/maintenance 10, exit preparation 10. Sum costs in the same unit.

operation.zh: 整理输入条件，计算并填写各数值字段后提交。
operation.en: Organize inputs, calculate and fill each numeric field, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 各项合计100；只报调用30会漏掉数据、人工与生命周期支出。 回看「全生命周期成本」。
incorrectFeedback.en: The sum is 100; reporting calls alone omits data, human and lifecycle expenses. Revisit “Lifecycle cost”.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

audit.reason: Replace the prior workshop with reviewed goal-linked independent tasks; move worked solutions out of the completion path.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFoundAll.zh: 本节物件已找到。可收藏想保留的物件，读完后整理入柜，再进入学习示范与练习。
afterFoundAll.en: This section’s objects are found. Favorite items you want to keep, read and file them, then enter the worked example and practice.

afterFiled.zh: 本节基础已整理。先看示范，再做引导练习，最后在新情境中独立应用。
afterFiled.en: Foundations are organized. View the worked example, try guided practice, then apply the ideas in a new situation.

sections.title: 确立 AI 所能带来的竞争优势

learnerGoals.zh: 把竞争变化连接到自身客户障碍。
learnerGoals.en: Connect competitive changes to local customer barriers.

learnerGoals.zh: 理解持续服务改变客户价值和运营要求。
learnerGoals.en: Understand how ongoing service changes value and operations.

learnerGoals.zh: 知道持续优势来自数据、流程、人员和反馈组合。
learnerGoals.en: Know that durable advantage depends on combined data, workflows, people and feedback.

learnerGoals.zh: 使投入与准备度、风险和验证证据相匹配。
learnerGoals.en: Match investment to readiness, risk and validation evidence.

learnerGoals.zh: 选择针对本企业客户和价值链的调查。
learnerGoals.en: Choose investigation of local customers and value-chain effects.

learnerGoals.zh: 说明提供什么价值、如何交付、怎样获得收益。
learnerGoals.en: Explain value offered, delivery and revenue logic.

learnerGoals.zh: 用授权资料、领域经验和结果反馈形成可持续改进。
learnerGoals.en: Combine authorized sources, domain expertise and outcome feedback for ongoing improvement.

learnerGoals.zh: 按预先定义的多维门槛决定扩展或暂停。
learnerGoals.en: Use predeclared multidimensional gates to decide expansion or pause.

scenario.zh: 示范：竞争者使用同一基础模型，持续优势还要看领域流程、获授权资料与反馈改进能力。
scenario.en: Demonstration: competitors share a base model; sustained advantage also depends on workflows, authorized sources and learning capabilities.

workedReasoning.zh: 标签或采购规模不等于客户价值及可持续优势。
workedReasoning.en: Branding or purchase size does not establish customer value or sustained advantage.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：互补能力演练预算4、最低能力值4。需求验证成本1值1，获授权反馈成本1值1，流程融入成本2值2；品牌贴标成本4值1。选择满足预算与能力目标的组合，分值仅供本题。
prompt.en: Guided practice: complementary-capability exercise budget 4, target 4. Need validation costs 1/value 1, authorized feedback 1/1, workflow integration 2/2, branding alone 4/1. Choose a feasible combination; scores are exercise assumptions.

text.zh: 验证客户任务
text.en: Validate customer tasks

text.zh: 获授权反馈
text.en: Authorized feedback

text.zh: 融入实际流程
text.en: Integrate into workflows

text.zh: 只贴品牌标签
text.en: Branding alone

reason.zh: 前三项合计成本4、能力值4；贴标不能替代可运行的互补条件。这里只练约束取舍，不等于证明长期优势。
reason.en: The first three total cost/value 4; branding does not replace complementary operating conditions. This practices constrained trade-offs rather than proving lasting advantage.

operation.zh: 比较候选代价与条件，组合可行工作包后提交。
operation.en: Compare costs and conditions, assemble a feasible work package, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 相同模型是否说明相同可持续能力。
learnerDecision.en: Assess whether equal models imply equal sustained capabilities.

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 选中甲有互补条件但仍需跟踪、乙账号数不足以证明优势两项有依据判断。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: Select the supported statements that A has complementary conditions requiring monitoring and B account counts do not establish advantage.

text.zh: 相同模型是否说明相同可持续能力。
text.en: Assess whether equal models imply equal sustained capabilities.

text.zh: 前三项合计成本4、能力值4；贴标不能替代可运行的互补条件。这里只练约束取舍，不等于证明长期优势。
text.en: The first three total cost/value 4; branding does not replace complementary operating conditions. This practices constrained trade-offs rather than proving lasting advantage.

explanation.zh: 前三项合计成本4、能力值4；贴标不能替代可运行的互补条件。这里只练约束取舍，不等于证明长期优势。
explanation.en: The first three total cost/value 4; branding does not replace complementary operating conditions. This practices constrained trade-offs rather than proving lasting advantage.

misconceptions.zh: 购买相同基础模型就拥有相同长期优势。
misconceptions.en: The same foundation model yields the same durable advantage.

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 验证客户任务；获授权反馈；融入实际流程
workedAnswer.en: Validate customer tasks; Authorized feedback; Integrate into workflows

title.zh: 确立 AI 所能带来的竞争优势

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练：同行上线聊天机器人，本企业投诉集中在退款等待。选择先调查的内容。
prompt.en: Exercise: a competitor launches a chatbot; your complaints concern refund delays. Choose the first investigation.

reason.zh: 投资需要连接客户问题与自身条件；复制工具无法证明能解决退款障碍。 回看「竞争格局」。
reason.en: Investment needs a link to customer problems and local conditions; imitation does not establish a refund solution. Revisit “Competitive landscape”.

text.zh: 直接复制同行采购清单
text.en: Copy the competitor purchasing list

text.zh: 同行界面的配色
text.en: Competitor interface colors

text.zh: 退款流程障碍、客户期待与自身可改善环节
text.en: Refund workflow barriers, customer expectations and improvable steps

prompt.zh: 本演练：一次性报告转为持续决策服务。选择必须重新评估的全部事项。
prompt.en: Exercise: one-off reports become continuous decision support. Select all items requiring reassessment.

reason.zh: 持续服务改变交付与维护要求；标签不能替代客户价值和运营方案。 回看「业务模式转型」。
reason.en: Continuous service changes delivery and maintenance; labels cannot replace value and operations. Revisit “Business model transformation”.

text.zh: 持续客户价值与服务交付流程
text.en: Ongoing customer value and service delivery

text.zh: 只修改产品标签
text.en: Change only the product label

text.zh: 数据维护和运营责任
text.en: Data maintenance and operational ownership

prompt.zh: 本演练两团队使用同一模型。甲有已授权的维修反馈、领域人员复核、流程责任人与定期结果回看；乙只有更多账号和一次发布会。选择材料目前支持的判断。
prompt.en: Exercise: two teams use the same model. Team A has authorized maintenance feedback, domain review, workflow owners and regular outcome review. Team B has more accounts and a launch event. Select judgments supported by the evidence.

reason.zh: 差别在资料使用、领域能力、流程与反馈，不在模型名称。甲有更充分的能力条件证据，但这些条件也不是永久收益保证。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: The difference concerns sources, domain skills, workflows and feedback rather than a model name. A has stronger capability evidence, but those conditions do not guarantee permanent returns. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 甲已经保证永久领先，不必再观察
text.en: A is guaranteed permanent leadership and needs no more monitoring

text.zh: 模型相同，所以两队业务能力与价值一定相同
text.en: The same model guarantees equal business capabilities and value

text.zh: 甲展示了可持续积累所需的互补条件，但仍须跟踪结果
text.en: A shows complementary conditions for sustained learning, though outcomes still need tracking

text.zh: 乙的账号数量不能单独证明持续优势
text.en: B account counts alone do not establish durable advantage

prompt.zh: 本演练当前可支配预算6点；扩展前必须补资料质量和验证小范围结果，二者分别成本2、价值2。培训支持成本2、价值1；直接全量扩展成本6、价值9，但当前准备不足，尚未获准执行。选择满足最低验证价值4且包含必要验证工作的组合；分值仅为演练设定。
prompt.en: Exercise: current budget is 6 points. Before expansion, data-quality work and limited outcome validation are mandatory, each cost 2/value 2. Training support costs 2/value 1. Full rollout costs 6/value 9 but is not authorized because readiness is incomplete. Select a package providing minimum validation value 4 and the necessary work. Scores are exercise assumptions.

reason.zh: 先投入资料与结果验证至少花4点并达到验证目标；培训可在预算内补充，未获准全量扩展不能因高分入选。外部压力不补内部条件。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Source and outcome validation cost at least 4 points and meet the validation objective. Training can be added within budget; unauthorized full rollout cannot be selected for its high score. External pressure does not repair internal conditions. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 补齐资料质量：成本2，价值2
text.en: Repair source quality: cost 2, value 2

text.zh: 验证小范围结果：成本2，价值2
text.en: Validate limited outcomes: cost 2, value 2

text.zh: 培训与支持：成本2，价值1
text.en: Training and support: cost 2, value 1

text.zh: 未获准全量扩展：成本6，价值9
text.en: Unauthorized full rollout: cost 6, value 9

prompt.zh: 本演练：同行投入千万，本企业尚未定位客户障碍。选择有证据意识的动作。
prompt.en: Exercise: a competitor spends ten million; your customer barriers are unknown. Choose an evidence-oriented action.

reason.zh: 竞争变化是调查线索，不是本企业的收益证明；需要自身业务证据。 回看「客户问题与竞争位置」。
reason.en: Competitive change prompts investigation; it does not prove your returns. Local evidence is needed. Revisit “Customer need and competitive position”.

text.zh: 调查客户期待、交付障碍与价值链影响
text.en: Investigate customer expectations, delivery barriers and value-chain effects

text.zh: 假定相同工具产生相同价值
text.en: Assume the same tool gives equal value

text.zh: 无条件投入更大金额
text.en: Spend more unconditionally

prompt.zh: 本演练持续监测服务：将方案条目归入价值、交付、收益。
prompt.en: Exercise continuous monitoring service: classify each proposal component as value, delivery or revenue.

reason.zh: 提醒说明客户所得，维护响应说明如何交付，收费说明价值获取；三者不能用标签代替。 回看「价值主张、交付与收益逻辑」。
reason.en: Alerts define value, maintenance defines delivery and charging defines capture; a label replaces none of them. Revisit “Value proposition, delivery and revenue”.

text.zh: 客户价值
text.en: Customer value

text.zh: 交付方式
text.en: Delivery

text.zh: 收益逻辑
text.en: Revenue

text.zh: 及时获得异常提醒
text.en: Timely exception alerts

text.zh: 团队持续维护与响应
text.en: Team maintains service and responds continuously

text.zh: 按约定服务期收费
text.en: Charge for an agreed service period

prompt.zh: 本演练：服务团队收到获准用于改进的客户投诉，投诉中有重复且未经核验的记录。领域人员要据此测试新的预约流程，并判断它是否真的减少失约。安排以下工作；客户同意的用途不能扩大为公开发布。
prompt.en: Exercise: a service team receives complaints authorized for improvement, including duplicates and unverified records. Domain staff will test a new booking workflow and determine whether it reduces missed appointments. Arrange the work below; the consented use does not permit public release.

reason.zh: 未经核验的重复投诉不能可靠说明问题；有实际问题才可设计相应改动，运行后才有新流程结果可比较。模型采购本身不会产生这条证据闭环。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Unverified duplicate complaints do not reliably establish the problem. A diagnosed problem guides a relevant change, whose later operation supplies comparable outcomes. Model procurement alone produces none of this evidence loop. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 按相同口径比较新流程失约结果，并把问题返回下一轮
text.en: Compare missed appointments consistently after the change and feed issues into the next round

text.zh: 去重核验获授权投诉，明确实际问题
text.en: Deduplicate and verify authorized complaints to identify the actual problem

text.zh: 领域人员依据已核验问题设计并试行预约改动
text.en: Domain staff design and try a booking change using the verified problem

prompt.zh: 本演练扩展门槛要求月成本不超过10万元。新部门测得每月固定费4万元、调用费5万元、复核费3万元。填写当前完整月成本和超过门槛的金额，单位万元。
prompt.en: Exercise expansion gate: monthly cost must not exceed 10 ten-thousand currency units. The new department has fixed cost 4, calls 5 and review 3 in that unit. Enter full monthly cost and the amount above the gate.

reason.zh: 4+5+3=12，超额12−10=2。复核费是成本，不能为了过门槛从报告删除。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 4+5+3=12; the excess is 12−10=2. Review is a cost and cannot be removed from reporting to pass the gate. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练：质量与风险审查均已达标，但上述成本尚未降到批准门槛内。选择当前有依据的承诺。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise: quality and risk review pass, but cost has not met the approved gate. Select the evidence-based commitment.

reason.zh: 多维硬门槛必须同时满足，不能用一项成功掩盖另一项失败；应验证成本改进而非事后改报告。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: All hard gates must be met together; one success cannot conceal another failure. Validate a cost improvement rather than rewrite the report. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 暂停扩大，验证成本改进后重新评估，保留既定质量要求
text.en: Pause expansion and re-evaluate after verified cost improvements while retaining quality requirements

text.zh: 质量通过即可抵消成本超额，立刻扩大
text.en: Passing quality offsets excess cost, so expand now

text.zh: 先删复核费或放宽门槛再宣布达标
text.en: Delete review costs or relax the gate before declaring success

operation.zh: 比较候选代价与条件，组合可行工作包后提交。
operation.en: Compare costs and conditions, assemble a feasible work package, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 先投入资料与结果验证至少花4点并达到验证目标；培训可在预算内补充，未获准全量扩展不能因高分入选。外部压力不补内部条件。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
incorrectFeedback.en: Source and outcome validation cost at least 4 points and meet the validation objective. Training can be added within budget; unauthorized full rollout cannot be selected for its high score. External pressure does not repair internal conditions. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练：同行投入千万，本企业尚未定位客户障碍。选择有证据意识的动作。
prompt.en: Exercise: a competitor spends ten million; your customer barriers are unknown. Choose an evidence-oriented action.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 竞争变化是调查线索，不是本企业的收益证明；需要自身业务证据。 回看「客户问题与竞争位置」。
incorrectFeedback.en: Competitive change prompts investigation; it does not prove your returns. Local evidence is needed. Revisit “Customer need and competitive position”.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练持续监测服务：将方案条目归入价值、交付、收益。
prompt.en: Exercise continuous monitoring service: classify each proposal component as value, delivery or revenue.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 提醒说明客户所得，维护响应说明如何交付，收费说明价值获取；三者不能用标签代替。 回看「价值主张、交付与收益逻辑」。
incorrectFeedback.en: Alerts define value, maintenance defines delivery and charging defines capture; a label replaces none of them. Revisit “Value proposition, delivery and revenue”.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练：服务团队收到获准用于改进的客户投诉，投诉中有重复且未经核验的记录。领域人员要据此测试新的预约流程，并判断它是否真的减少失约。安排以下工作；客户同意的用途不能扩大为公开发布。
prompt.en: Exercise: a service team receives complaints authorized for improvement, including duplicates and unverified records. Domain staff will test a new booking workflow and determine whether it reduces missed appointments. Arrange the work below; the consented use does not permit public release.

operation.zh: 阅读步骤与条件，移动步骤卡形成依赖链后提交。
operation.en: Read steps and conditions, move cards into a dependency chain, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 未经核验的重复投诉不能可靠说明问题；有实际问题才可设计相应改动，运行后才有新流程结果可比较。模型采购本身不会产生这条证据闭环。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
incorrectFeedback.en: Unverified duplicate complaints do not reliably establish the problem. A diagnosed problem guides a relevant change, whose later operation supplies comparable outcomes. Model procurement alone produces none of this evidence loop. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练扩展门槛要求月成本不超过10万元。新部门测得每月固定费4万元、调用费5万元、复核费3万元。填写当前完整月成本和超过门槛的金额，单位万元。
prompt.en: Exercise expansion gate: monthly cost must not exceed 10 ten-thousand currency units. The new department has fixed cost 4, calls 5 and review 3 in that unit. Enter full monthly cost and the amount above the gate.

operation.zh: 整理输入条件，计算并填写各数值字段后提交。
operation.en: Organize inputs, calculate and fill each numeric field, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 4+5+3=12，超额12−10=2。复核费是成本，不能为了过门槛从报告删除。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
incorrectFeedback.en: 4+5+3=12; the excess is 12−10=2. Review is a cost and cannot be removed from reporting to pass the gate. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练：质量与风险审查均已达标，但上述成本尚未降到批准门槛内。选择当前有依据的承诺。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise: quality and risk review pass, but cost has not met the approved gate. Select the evidence-based commitment.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 多维硬门槛必须同时满足，不能用一项成功掩盖另一项失败；应验证成本改进而非事后改报告。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
incorrectFeedback.en: All hard gates must be met together; one success cannot conceal another failure. Validate a cost improvement rather than rewrite the report. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

audit.reason: Replace the prior workshop with reviewed goal-linked independent tasks; move worked solutions out of the completion path.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFoundAll.zh: 本节物件已找到。可收藏想保留的物件，读完后整理入柜，再进入学习示范与练习。
afterFoundAll.en: This section’s objects are found. Favorite items you want to keep, read and file them, then enter the worked example and practice.

afterFiled.zh: 本节基础已整理。先看示范，再做引导练习，最后在新情境中独立应用。
afterFiled.en: Foundations are organized. View the worked example, try guided practice, then apply the ideas in a new situation.

sections.title: 在制订业务决策时应用负责任的 AI 原则

learnerGoals.zh: 把责任原则转为可观察的控制
learnerGoals.en: Turn responsibility principles into observable controls

learnerGoals.zh: 在收益目标下保留责任硬约束
learnerGoals.en: Preserve responsibility constraints while pursuing benefits

learnerGoals.zh: 在设计决策中提前落实治理
learnerGoals.en: Establish governance during design decisions

learnerGoals.zh: 把监督落实为有能力且获授权的接手
learnerGoals.en: Make oversight capable and authorized

learnerGoals.zh: 判断总体指标不能证明分组公平
learnerGoals.en: Recognize that aggregates cannot establish group fairness

learnerGoals.zh: 分别识别解释依据与告知限制
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish explaining reasons from disclosing limitations

learnerGoals.zh: 按风险目的区分互补控制
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish complementary controls by risk purpose

learnerGoals.zh: 用影响证据评估相称控制
learnerGoals.en: Evaluate proportionate controls using impact evidence

learnerGoals.zh: 在用途和验收中识别禁止场景
learnerGoals.en: Identify prohibited uses in scope and acceptance

learnerGoals.zh: 识别只有签字没有能力的监督
learnerGoals.en: Recognize supervision that has signatures but lacks capability

scenario.zh: 示范：设计检索工具时先明确资料用途，测试发现越权后修改保障并重新验证，而不是上线后补免责声明。
scenario.en: Demonstration: define source use during retrieval-tool design, repair access failures found in testing and re-evaluate rather than add a disclaimer after deployment.

workedReasoning.zh: 保障要进入设计与验证，发现问题可以迭代，需要有实际验证记录。
workedReasoning.en: Safeguards belong in design and evaluation with iteration supported by actual evaluation records.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：审查两条已经提供的记录，分别支持哪个问题？不要把其中一条当作全部说明。
prompt.en: Guided practice: inspect two provided records. Which question does each support? Neither record is the entire explanation.

text.zh: 系统怎样参与及有哪些限制
text.en: System involvement and limitations

text.zh: 这一建议使用了什么依据
text.en: Basis of this recommendation

text.zh: 记录甲：助手仅给候选建议，可能出错，由值班主管批准
text.en: Record A: the assistant suggests candidates, may err, and a supervisor approves

text.zh: 记录乙：此建议引用了工单内的故障时间及对应检查记录
text.en: Record B: this recommendation cites the incident time and inspection record

reason.zh: 两条记录分别说明参与方式和个案依据，两者不能相互替代。
reason.en: The records address participation and case-specific basis respectively; they provide distinct evidence for complementary questions.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

learnerDecision.zh: 判断具体界面文本解决的是知情还是理由理解
learnerDecision.en: Judge whether interface text supports informed choice or understanding reasons

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「页面列出本次建议所用资料，并说明哪些因素改变了建议」→「帮助理解本次判断依据」；「使用前提示会有AI参与，说明它不能处理的用途」→「帮助知情使用系统」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「The page identifies sources used for this recommendation and factors that changed it」→「Understand this judgment basis」；「Before use, the page discloses AI participation and excluded uses」→「Make an informed choice about system use」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 判断具体界面文本解决的是知情还是理由理解
text.en: Judge whether interface text supports informed choice or understanding reasons

text.zh: 两条记录分别说明参与方式和个案依据，两者不能相互替代。
text.en: The records address participation and case-specific basis respectively; they provide distinct evidence for complementary questions.

explanation.zh: 两条记录分别说明参与方式和个案依据，两者不能相互替代。
explanation.en: The records address participation and case-specific basis respectively; they provide distinct evidence for complementary questions.

misconceptions.zh: 披露使用AI等于解释建议为何产生
misconceptions.en: Disclosing AI use explains why a recommendation arose

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 记录甲：助手仅给候选建议，可能出错，由值班主管批准 → 系统怎样参与及有哪些限制；记录乙：此建议引用了工单内的故障时间及对应检查记录 → 这一建议使用了什么依据
workedAnswer.en: Record A: the assistant suggests candidates, may err, and a supervisor approves → System involvement and limitations; Record B: this recommendation cites the incident time and inspection record → Basis of this recommendation

title.zh: 在制订业务决策时应用负责任的 AI 原则

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 团队只有一张责任原则海报。选择所有能产生实际评估或控制证据的补充工作。
prompt.en: The team has only a principles poster. Select every addition that produces actual assessment or control evidence.

reason.zh: 分组差错评估和异常条件测试让原则进入实际验证；仅改宣传措辞不能证明控制有效。 常见错误：有原则海报就等于已治理。 回看《负责任的AI原则》。
reason.en: Subgroup error assessment and abnormal-condition tests operationalize principles; promotional wording does not demonstrate effective controls. Common error: A principles poster is treated as implemented governance. Review “Responsible AI principles”.

text.zh: 记录相关群体的差错并评审
text.en: Record and review errors for relevant groups

text.zh: 在异常输入下测试并记录结果
text.en: Test abnormal inputs and record results

text.zh: 把海报换成更醒目的颜色
text.en: Change the poster to brighter colors

prompt.zh: 演练给定：预算3；必须做影响记录和责任确认；总控制值至少3。选择满足全部约束的工作包。分值只用于本题。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 3; impact recording and owner confirmation are mandatory; total control value must reach 3. Select a feasible package. Scores apply only here.

reason.zh: 影响记录和责任确认各占1预算，风险控制占1，恰好达到3；纯加速项不满足责任硬约束。取舍需记录理由。 常见错误：以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。 回看《目标冲突与取舍》。
reason.en: Impact recording, owner confirmation and risk control each cost 1 and jointly reach 3. Acceleration alone misses mandatory responsibility constraints. Record the trade-off rationale. Common error: Maximum efficiency replaces explanation of impact and ownership. Review “Competing objectives and trade-offs”.

text.zh: 记录影响：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Record impact: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 确认决策责任：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Confirm decision owner: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 风险相称控制：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Proportionate control: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 仅提速：成本3，控制值0
text.en: Acceleration only: cost 3, control value 0

prompt.zh: 客服系统尚不清楚谁能使用哪些资料，也没有异常验收。三张工作单分别如下，请组成能支持上线决定的工作路径；题面不指定顺序。
prompt.en: A support system has no defined users/data scope or abnormal-condition acceptance. Build a work path that can support release from these work orders; the sequence is not supplied.

text.zh: 用验证证据决定是否部署
text.en: Decide deployment using validation evidence

text.zh: 围绕这些用途设计监督并验证异常处理
text.en: Design oversight for those uses and validate abnormal handling

text.zh: 界定允许用途、资料与决定责任
text.en: Define allowed uses, sources and decision ownership

reason.zh: 不知道用途和责任就不能合理设计监督；发布决定须用验证结果，不是先上线再补治理。回看“从设计时纳入治理”。
reason.en: Unknown use and ownership prevent sound oversight design; release requires validation evidence rather than later governance. Revisit Governance by Design.

prompt.zh: 本演练中，获授权的审批员已检查独立修复测试，书面批准仅在原有用途的小批量运行；值班监控和停止通道也已就绪。有人提出两种追加意见：“仍须保证永不出错才可运行”，或“既然批准就可扩大到尚未审查的新用途”。选择与现有证据和批准范围相符的行动。
prompt.en: In this exercise, an authorized approver reviewed independent repair tests and documented approval for a small batch within the existing use. Monitoring and a stop channel are ready. Two proposals are added: require a guarantee of no future error, or expand to an unreviewed use because approval exists. Select actions consistent with the evidence and approval scope.

text.zh: 已有批准可解释为对所有用途永久授权
text.en: Interpret approval as permanent authority for every use

text.zh: 在批准的用途与小批范围内运行，保留监控和停止能力
text.en: Operate within the approved use and batch, retaining monitoring and stop capability

text.zh: 若要新增用途，另核对影响和授权范围
text.en: Reassess impacts and authority before adding a new use

text.zh: 只有承诺永不出错才算人工监督有效
text.en: Effective human oversight requires a promise of no errors ever

reason.zh: 这里的授权和独立验证确已存在，不能继续按“模型自信代审批”的旧事实判断。有效监督是在有依据的范围内行动并保留停止/升级，不是保证零错或无限扩权。回看“人工监督与升级”。
reason.en: Approval and independent validation actually exist in this case. Oversight supports action within an evidenced scope with stop/escalation options, not zero-error guarantees or unlimited authority. Revisit Human Oversight and Escalation.

prompt.zh: 演练：总体错误率5%，但未按受影响群体统计。选择所有必要的下一步；本题不设普遍公平阈值。
prompt.en: Exercise: overall error rate is 5%, with no breakdown for affected groups. Select all necessary next steps; no universal fairness threshold is given.

reason.zh: 需要识别相关群体、比较差错和影响，并讨论取舍；一个总体均值不能给出群体分布。 常见错误：总体平均优秀足以证明公平。 回看《公平性与分组表现》。
reason.en: Identify relevant groups, compare errors and impacts, and discuss trade-offs; an aggregate average cannot reveal group distributions. Common error: A strong overall average proves fairness. Review “Fairness and subgroup outcomes”.

text.zh: 直接宣布不存在公平性问题
text.en: Declare no fairness issue immediately

text.zh: 结合用途识别相关群体
text.en: Identify relevant groups for the use

text.zh: 比较群体差错、机会和影响
text.en: Compare group errors, opportunities and impacts

prompt.zh: 借贷建议工具留下两份界面记录。把每份记录送到它最直接改善的目标；本题不判断该建议是否合法或准确。
prompt.en: A lending-advice tool has two interface records. Route each to the goal it most directly improves; this does not determine legality or accuracy.

text.zh: 帮助理解本次判断依据
text.en: Understand this judgment basis

text.zh: 帮助知情使用系统
text.en: Make an informed choice about system use

text.zh: 页面列出本次建议所用资料，并说明哪些因素改变了建议
text.en: The page identifies sources used for this recommendation and factors that changed it

text.zh: 使用前提示会有AI参与，说明它不能处理的用途
text.en: Before use, the page discloses AI participation and excluded uses

reason.zh: 第一份解释具体行为依据，第二份披露参与和限制；只出现AI标识仍不能解释一次判断。回看“可说明性与透明度”。
reason.en: The first explains a decision basis; the second discloses participation and limits. An AI badge alone does not explain a judgment. Revisit Explainability and Transparency.

prompt.zh: 将三个独立检查路由到最直接的目的；这里按题面关注点分类。
prompt.en: Route three checks by their most direct purpose, using the stated focus.

reason.zh: 资料用途关注隐私，阻止未授权访问关注安全，变化条件下表现关注稳健性。控制可能互补，但目的有区别。 常见错误：有访问密码就解决所有隐私和稳健性问题。 回看《隐私、安全与稳健性》。
reason.en: Appropriate data use concerns privacy, unauthorized access concerns security, and behavior under change concerns robustness. Controls can complement one another but have distinct purposes. Common error: A password resolves privacy and robustness too. Review “Privacy, security and robustness”.

text.zh: 隐私
text.en: Privacy

text.zh: 安全
text.en: Security

text.zh: 稳健性
text.en: Robustness

text.zh: 检查个人资料是否用于适当目的
text.en: Check appropriate personal-data purposes

text.zh: 阻止无权限账号进入资料库
text.en: Block unauthorized accounts from the repository

text.zh: 测试输入异常时能否适当运行
text.en: Test appropriate behavior on unusual inputs

prompt.zh: 评审已记录节省时间。选择还应补充的全部信息，以讨论相称控制。
prompt.en: The review records time savings. Select every missing input needed to discuss proportionate controls.

reason.zh: 影响对象、可能性、严重程度、可逆性和决定责任共同支持取舍；厂商品牌不提供这些影响证据。 常见错误：只记录收益，不记录损害严重性和可逆性。 回看《收益、影响与比例原则》。 不可接受风险应依据适用法律、权利保障及场景标准判断，不能仅以业务收益抵扣。
reason.en: Affected people, likelihood, severity, reversibility and decision ownership support the trade-off; a vendor brand provides none of this impact evidence. Common error: Benefits are recorded while severity and reversibility are omitted. Review “Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls”. Assess unacceptable risk against applicable law, rights protections and contextual standards; business benefits alone do not offset it.

text.zh: 只补模型品牌
text.en: Add only the model brand

text.zh: 严重程度与可逆性
text.en: Severity and reversibility

text.zh: 受影响对象及损害可能性
text.en: Affected people and likelihood of harm

text.zh: 控制取舍和决定责任
text.en: Control trade-offs and decision ownership

prompt.zh: 原来只起草内部说明的工具，现在准备自动向客户发送影响其服务资格的结论。当前只测了速度。选择所有必须补入设计与验收的工作。
prompt.en: A tool formerly drafted internal notes and will now automatically send conclusions affecting service eligibility. Only speed has been tested. Select all work missing from design and acceptance.

text.zh: 速度达标即可沿用原用途批准
text.en: Keep the original use approval because speed passed

text.zh: 确定人工介入和失败处置，并验证这些条件
text.en: Define human intervention and failure handling and validate them

text.zh: 界定允许与不允许用途，核对使用资料
text.en: Define permitted and prohibited uses and inspect data use

reason.zh: 用途变化需要在设计与验收中落实保障；速度不能说明新影响已受控制。回看“从用途定义开始设置保障”。
reason.en: Changed use needs safeguards in design and acceptance; speed does not show the new impact is controlled. Revisit Safeguards from Use-Case Definition.

prompt.zh: 演练：复核员只能看到结论，必须立即签字且无暂停权。选择所有必要补强。
prompt.en: Case: a reviewer sees only conclusions, must sign immediately, and cannot pause actions. Select all necessary improvements.

reason.zh: 监督需要证据、时间、训练、停止或修改权，并给无来源结论等触发事件指定接手人；单纯签字不提供能力。 常见错误：安排一个签字人即可构成有效监督。 回看《复核能力与升级阈值》。
reason.en: Oversight needs evidence, time, training, stop or modification authority, and owners for triggers such as unsupported conclusions. A signature alone provides no capability. Common error: Assigning a signer creates effective oversight. Review “Review capability and escalation triggers”.

text.zh: 只增加签字次数
text.en: Only require more signatures

text.zh: 授予停止或修改权限
text.en: Grant stop or modification authority

text.zh: 提供证据、复核时间和训练
text.en: Provide evidence, review time and training

text.zh: 定义无来源结论等升级条件与接手者
text.en: Define unsupported-claim escalation and takeover owners

prompt.zh: 团队只有一张责任原则海报。选择所有能产生实际评估或控制证据的补充工作。
prompt.en: The team has only a principles poster. Select every addition that produces actual assessment or control evidence.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 分组差错评估和异常条件测试让原则进入实际验证；仅改宣传措辞不能证明控制有效。 常见错误：有原则海报就等于已治理。 回看《负责任的AI原则》。
incorrectFeedback.en: Subgroup error assessment and abnormal-condition tests operationalize principles; promotional wording does not demonstrate effective controls. Common error: A principles poster is treated as implemented governance. Review “Responsible AI principles”.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 演练给定：预算3；必须做影响记录和责任确认；总控制值至少3。选择满足全部约束的工作包。分值只用于本题。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 3; impact recording and owner confirmation are mandatory; total control value must reach 3. Select a feasible package. Scores apply only here.

operation.zh: 比较候选代价与条件，组合可行工作包后提交。
operation.en: Compare costs and conditions, assemble a feasible work package, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 影响记录和责任确认各占1预算，风险控制占1，恰好达到3；纯加速项不满足责任硬约束。取舍需记录理由。 常见错误：以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。 回看《目标冲突与取舍》。
incorrectFeedback.en: Impact recording, owner confirmation and risk control each cost 1 and jointly reach 3. Acceleration alone misses mandatory responsibility constraints. Record the trade-off rationale. Common error: Maximum efficiency replaces explanation of impact and ownership. Review “Competing objectives and trade-offs”.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 客服系统尚不清楚谁能使用哪些资料，也没有异常验收。三张工作单分别如下，请组成能支持上线决定的工作路径；题面不指定顺序。
prompt.en: A support system has no defined users/data scope or abnormal-condition acceptance. Build a work path that can support release from these work orders; the sequence is not supplied.

operation.zh: 阅读步骤与条件，移动步骤卡形成依赖链后提交。
operation.en: Read steps and conditions, move cards into a dependency chain, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 不知道用途和责任就不能合理设计监督；发布决定须用验证结果，不是先上线再补治理。回看“从设计时纳入治理”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Unknown use and ownership prevent sound oversight design; release requires validation evidence rather than later governance. Revisit Governance by Design.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练中，获授权的审批员已检查独立修复测试，书面批准仅在原有用途的小批量运行；值班监控和停止通道也已就绪。有人提出两种追加意见：“仍须保证永不出错才可运行”，或“既然批准就可扩大到尚未审查的新用途”。选择与现有证据和批准范围相符的行动。
prompt.en: In this exercise, an authorized approver reviewed independent repair tests and documented approval for a small batch within the existing use. Monitoring and a stop channel are ready. Two proposals are added: require a guarantee of no future error, or expand to an unreviewed use because approval exists. Select actions consistent with the evidence and approval scope.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 这里的授权和独立验证确已存在，不能继续按“模型自信代审批”的旧事实判断。有效监督是在有依据的范围内行动并保留停止/升级，不是保证零错或无限扩权。回看“人工监督与升级”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Approval and independent validation actually exist in this case. Oversight supports action within an evidenced scope with stop/escalation options, not zero-error guarantees or unlimited authority. Revisit Human Oversight and Escalation.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 演练：总体错误率5%，但未按受影响群体统计。选择所有必要的下一步；本题不设普遍公平阈值。
prompt.en: Exercise: overall error rate is 5%, with no breakdown for affected groups. Select all necessary next steps; no universal fairness threshold is given.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 需要识别相关群体、比较差错和影响，并讨论取舍；一个总体均值不能给出群体分布。 常见错误：总体平均优秀足以证明公平。 回看《公平性与分组表现》。
incorrectFeedback.en: Identify relevant groups, compare errors and impacts, and discuss trade-offs; an aggregate average cannot reveal group distributions. Common error: A strong overall average proves fairness. Review “Fairness and subgroup outcomes”.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 借贷建议工具留下两份界面记录。把每份记录送到它最直接改善的目标；本题不判断该建议是否合法或准确。
prompt.en: A lending-advice tool has two interface records. Route each to the goal it most directly improves; this does not determine legality or accuracy.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 第一份解释具体行为依据，第二份披露参与和限制；只出现AI标识仍不能解释一次判断。回看“可说明性与透明度”。
incorrectFeedback.en: The first explains a decision basis; the second discloses participation and limits. An AI badge alone does not explain a judgment. Revisit Explainability and Transparency.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 将三个独立检查路由到最直接的目的；这里按题面关注点分类。
prompt.en: Route three checks by their most direct purpose, using the stated focus.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 资料用途关注隐私，阻止未授权访问关注安全，变化条件下表现关注稳健性。控制可能互补，但目的有区别。 常见错误：有访问密码就解决所有隐私和稳健性问题。 回看《隐私、安全与稳健性》。
incorrectFeedback.en: Appropriate data use concerns privacy, unauthorized access concerns security, and behavior under change concerns robustness. Controls can complement one another but have distinct purposes. Common error: A password resolves privacy and robustness too. Review “Privacy, security and robustness”.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 评审已记录节省时间。选择还应补充的全部信息，以讨论相称控制。
prompt.en: The review records time savings. Select every missing input needed to discuss proportionate controls.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 影响对象、可能性、严重程度、可逆性和决定责任共同支持取舍；厂商品牌不提供这些影响证据。 常见错误：只记录收益，不记录损害严重性和可逆性。 回看《收益、影响与比例原则》。 不可接受风险应依据适用法律、权利保障及场景标准判断，不能仅以业务收益抵扣。
incorrectFeedback.en: Affected people, likelihood, severity, reversibility and decision ownership support the trade-off; a vendor brand provides none of this impact evidence. Common error: Benefits are recorded while severity and reversibility are omitted. Review “Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls”. Assess unacceptable risk against applicable law, rights protections and contextual standards; business benefits alone do not offset it.

completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFoundAll.zh: 本节物件已找到。可收藏想保留的物件，读完后整理入柜，再进入学习示范与练习。
afterFoundAll.en: This section’s objects are found. Favorite items you want to keep, read and file them, then enter the worked example and practice.

sections.title: 建立 AI 监管结构并确保监管合规

learnerGoals.zh: 让多角色协作保留明确决定责任
learnerGoals.en: Keep decision ownership explicit across functions

learnerGoals.zh: 用具体上下文启动适用要求核对
learnerGoals.en: Start requirement review from concrete context

learnerGoals.zh: 按工作需要授予最小资料权限
learnerGoals.en: Grant minimum access needed for work

learnerGoals.zh: 按用途和影响比较治理优先级
learnerGoals.en: Compare governance priorities by use and impact

learnerGoals.zh: 区分完成工作与对决定负责
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish execution from decision accountability

learnerGoals.zh: 识别合规评审材料的实质缺口
learnerGoals.en: Recognize substantive gaps in a compliance brief

learnerGoals.zh: 把授权控制放在检索或行动之前
learnerGoals.en: Enforce authorization before retrieval or action

learnerGoals.zh: 识别用途改变需要重评
learnerGoals.en: Recognize when changed uses require reassessment

scenario.zh: 示范：角色需要读政策不表示可以读所有资料；执行验证的人与最终上线决定者也可能不同。
scenario.en: Demonstration: needing policy access does not authorize all sources; a validator and final deployment decision-maker may differ.

workedReasoning.zh: 先从任务和正式授权推导权限，不从模型能调用推导有权调用。
workedReasoning.en: Derive access from tasks and authority rather than infer authority from callability.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：演练客服仅需读政策、审计员仅需读受控事件记录，双方都不需删除。配置必要权限。
prompt.en: Guided practice: support needs policy read access, auditors need controlled event logs, neither needs deletion. Configure necessary access.

text.zh: 客服
text.en: Support

text.zh: 审计员
text.en: Auditor

text.zh: 读政策
text.en: Read policies

text.zh: 读事件记录
text.en: Read event logs

text.zh: 删除
text.en: Delete

reason.zh: 权限由明确任务给出，额外权限与缺权限都需修正；仅限本演练授权。
reason.en: Tasks determine the stated exercise permissions; both extra and missing access must be repaired.

operation.zh: 逐角色核对每个行动或资料格，只选允许组合后提交。
operation.en: Check each role/action or source cell and submit only permitted combinations.

learnerDecision.zh: 结合三种业务任务和资料分级修复全库开放的授权
learnerDecision.en: Repair repository-wide access using three business tasks and source classifications

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：仅保留这些授权格：接待台：公众政策答复 / 退货条款；核算台：客户多收款核对 / 姓名与金额发票；值守台：服务超时调查 / 脱敏运行事件。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Retain only these permission cells: Reception: public-policy answers / Return terms；Reconciliation: customer overcharge review / Identifiable invoices；On-call: service timeout investigation / Redacted runtime events. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 结合三种业务任务和资料分级修复全库开放的授权
text.en: Repair repository-wide access using three business tasks and source classifications

text.zh: 权限由明确任务给出，额外权限与缺权限都需修正；仅限本演练授权。
text.en: Tasks determine the stated exercise permissions; both extra and missing access must be repaired.

explanation.zh: 权限由明确任务给出，额外权限与缺权限都需修正；仅限本演练授权。
explanation.en: Tasks determine the stated exercise permissions; both extra and missing access must be repaired.

misconceptions.zh: 提示词提醒就能代替权限系统
misconceptions.en: A prompt reminder replaces access enforcement

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 客服 / 读政策；审计员 / 读事件记录
workedAnswer.en: Support / Read policies; Auditor / Read event logs

title.zh: 建立 AI 监管结构并确保监管合规

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 会议记录显示业务、技术和监督人员都讨论过项目，却写“决定责任由大家共同承担”，没有人确认最终用途，技术也不知道谁接收异常。选择修订交接表的必要项。
prompt.en: Business, technical and oversight staff discussed the project, but the handover says everyone jointly owns decisions. Nobody confirms intended use, and engineers do not know the incident receiver. Select necessary repairs.

text.zh: 把会议参与名单复制到责任栏即可
text.en: Copy the meeting attendance list into the owner field

text.zh: 明确业务、技术、监督如何交接与接收异常
text.en: Define business, technical and oversight handovers and incident ownership

text.zh: 明确各决定的负责人及授权边界
text.en: Name decision owners and their authority boundaries

reason.zh: 参与不等于决定责任。交接需要具体负责人、权责和接手关系；名单不能填补这些缺口。回看“跨职能治理与问责”。
reason.en: Participation is not decision ownership. Handover requires owners, authority and takeover arrangements; a list of names does not fill the gaps. Revisit Cross-Functional Governance and Accountability.

prompt.zh: 项目已经整理用途、受影响人群、资料类别、使用地区和组织要求，并为每项附了证据。负责人尚未作具体适用判断。产品经理因“材料齐全”准备直接标为风险审查通过。此时哪些记录状态有依据？
prompt.en: The project has documented use, affected people, data classes, regions and organizational requirements with evidence for each. The accountable reviewer has not made a contextual assessment. The product lead wants to mark risk review passed because the brief is complete. Which recorded states are supported?

text.zh: 仍应把已经有证据的全部字段改成缺失
text.en: Mark all already evidenced fields missing again

text.zh: 审查是否通过仍待有责任的专业判断，不能由材料齐全推定
text.en: Review approval awaits accountable professional judgment; completeness does not imply it

text.zh: 字段填满即证明所有合规风险已排除
text.en: Completed fields prove every compliance risk is excluded

text.zh: 上下文材料已准备，可提交相关责任人核对适用条件
text.en: The context brief is ready for accountable assessment of applicable conditions

reason.zh: 准备好上下文支持开展评估，不等于已经完成评估。既不能把材料齐全自动升级成审查通过，也不应忽略已有证据反复要求同一材料。回看“合规风险识别”。
reason.en: Complete context enables review without completing it. Do not turn a ready brief into approval, or ignore evidence and repeatedly request the same inputs. Revisit Compliance Risk Identification.

prompt.zh: 本演练系统把三个账号对四类资料全部开放。组织批准的工作只有：接待台答复公众退货政策；核算台核对客户多收款；值守台调查服务超时。资料分级为：退货条款是公开内容；含姓名与金额的发票只可用于获准财务核对；员工薪酬只可用于人事用途；脱敏运行事件只可用于获准运维调查。没有人事任务。勾选修复后应保留的读取组合，不按账号名称猜权限，也不保留与任务无关的访问。
prompt.en: The exercise system gives three accounts access to all four source classes. Approved work is limited to: a reception desk answering public return-policy questions, a reconciliation desk investigating a customer overcharge, and an on-call desk investigating service timeouts. Source classifications are: public return terms; identifiable invoices only for approved financial reconciliation; payroll only for HR purposes; and redacted runtime events only for approved operational investigation. No HR task exists. Select read combinations that should remain after repair, using purpose and source classifications rather than account names or convenience.

text.zh: 接待台：公众政策答复
text.en: Reception: public-policy answers

text.zh: 核算台：客户多收款核对
text.en: Reconciliation: customer overcharge review

text.zh: 值守台：服务超时调查
text.en: On-call: service timeout investigation

text.zh: 退货条款
text.en: Return terms

text.zh: 姓名与金额发票
text.en: Identifiable invoices

text.zh: 员工薪酬
text.en: Payroll

text.zh: 脱敏运行事件
text.en: Redacted runtime events

reason.zh: 退货条款支持公众政策答复；发票支持获准的多收款核对；运行事件支持超时调查。薪酬不服务任何已批准工作，其他交叉访问也没有任务依据；原来全库开放不能作为继续开放的理由。这里要求在资料层执行限制，提示词写“请保密”不能代替它。回看“访问控制与数据安全”。
reason.en: Return terms support public answers, invoices support the approved overcharge check, and runtime events support timeout investigation. Payroll serves no approved task, and other cross-access lacks a work basis. Existing broad access does not justify retaining it. Enforce this at the data layer; a confidentiality prompt is not a substitute. Revisit Access Control and Data Security.

prompt.zh: 为两个模型的用途排治理优先级。选择应比较的全部依据，不直接推断风险等级。
prompt.en: Prioritize governance for two model uses. Select all relevant comparison inputs without assigning an unsupported risk grade.

reason.zh: 用途、对象、损害和控制条件支持影响判断；只凭参数大小不能确定用途风险。 常见错误：模型越大风险一定越高。 回看《AI风险分类》。
reason.en: Use, affected people, harm and controls support impact assessment; parameter count alone cannot determine use-case risk. Common error: Larger models are always higher risk. Review “AI risk classification”.

text.zh: 潜在损害与现有控制
text.en: Potential harm and current controls

text.zh: 用途与受影响对象
text.en: Use and affected people

text.zh: 只按模型大小决定等级
text.en: Determine grades solely by model size

prompt.zh: 项目记录中没有写R或A代码。将两项记录分别送入“完成工作证据”或“最终决定责任”，不需要背字母。
prompt.en: Project records use no R/A codes. Route them to evidence of doing work or responsibility for the final decision; no letter recall is needed.

text.zh: 完成工作证据
text.en: Evidence of performing work

text.zh: 最终决定责任
text.en: Final decision responsibility

text.zh: 分析员完成验证并提交差错报告供批准者参考
text.en: An analyst completes validation and submits an error report to the approver

text.zh: 业务主管核对报告后决定是否投用，并对结果作出说明
text.en: A business lead reviews the report, decides whether to use the system and answers for the outcome

reason.zh: 产出验证报告是执行；作最终决定并对结果负责是问责。执行者不自动获得发布决定权。回看“负责执行与最终问责”。
reason.en: Producing a validation report is execution; deciding and answering for outcomes is accountability. Executing validation does not automatically grant release authority. Revisit Execution and Final Accountability.

prompt.zh: 原评审针对一个地区的内部草稿。新版本面向另一地区的客户并使用新的个人资料。供应商只提供“通用合规清单”。责任人作判断前应补什么？
prompt.en: The original review covered internal drafts in one region. A new version faces customers in another region and uses new personal data. The supplier provides only a generic checklist. What context does the accountable reviewer need?

text.zh: 只要供应商沿用同一模型就无需补资料
text.en: No further context if the supplier retains the same model

text.zh: 新用途及受影响人群
text.en: New use and affected people

text.zh: 新资料类别、使用地区和组织要求
text.en: New data classes, locations and organizational requirements

reason.zh: 具体用途、资料、地区和责任要求决定核对范围；通用清单或同一模型不能代替这些上下文。回看“用途、资料与适用要求”。
reason.en: Use, data, region and organizational responsibility determine review scope. A generic list or unchanged model cannot replace that context. Revisit Use, Data and Applicable Requirements.

prompt.zh: 本演练缓存保存了某用户上周获准查看的区域报告。今天该区域权限已撤销，新请求没有重新检索，服务准备直接复用缓存。组织规则要求每次资料使用都在该次请求获准范围内。选择能修复这个缺口的行动。
prompt.en: An exercise cache contains regional reports the user was authorized to see last week. That authority is revoked today. A new request performs no retrieval and will reuse the cache directly. Organizational policy limits each use to the current request scope. Select repairs for this gap.

text.zh: 在复用前核对当前身份及允许范围，排除已失去权限的缓存资料
text.en: Check current identity and scope before reuse and exclude cache entries no longer permitted

text.zh: 因为上周合法取过，缓存可以永远绕过当前授权
text.en: Past lawful retrieval lets the cache bypass current authority forever

text.zh: 不重新检索就不属于任何资料访问，无需检查
text.en: Without new retrieval there is no data access to check

text.zh: 只有仍在当前获准范围的资料可继续作为该请求证据
text.en: Only sources within the current allowed scope may support the request

reason.zh: 缓存没有消除资料使用，历史许可也不能证明当前请求获准。控制须在本次取用或行动前生效，而非把缓存当授权旁路。回看“最小权限与检索前过滤”。
reason.en: Caching does not remove data use, and historical permission does not establish current authorization. Enforce controls before present use or action instead of treating the cache as a bypass. Revisit Least Privilege and Pre-Retrieval Filtering.

prompt.zh: 本演练系统从内部草稿改为影响客户权益的建议。把观察分成“需要重评的用途/影响变化”和“本身不能维持旧结论的技术事实”。
prompt.en: Exercise: a system moves from internal drafts to advice affecting customer interests. Sort observations into use/impact changes requiring reassessment and technical facts that cannot themselves preserve the old conclusion.

reason.zh: 受影响对象和损害条件变化是重评依据；模型版本没变不能证明用途风险也没变。 回看“按影响分配治理力度：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Changed affected people and harm conditions require reassessment; an unchanged model version does not prove unchanged use risk. Revisit Risk-proportionate governance: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

text.zh: 用途与影响变化
text.en: Use and impact changes

text.zh: 不能单独维持旧结论
text.en: Cannot preserve the old conclusion alone

text.zh: 结果现在影响客户权益
text.en: Outputs now affect customer interests

text.zh: 模型版本仍相同
text.en: Model version remains unchanged

text.zh: 受影响人群由内部员工变成客户
text.en: Affected people change from internal staff to customers

prompt.zh: 会议记录显示业务、技术和监督人员都讨论过项目，却写“决定责任由大家共同承担”，没有人确认最终用途，技术也不知道谁接收异常。选择修订交接表的必要项。
prompt.en: Business, technical and oversight staff discussed the project, but the handover says everyone jointly owns decisions. Nobody confirms intended use, and engineers do not know the incident receiver. Select necessary repairs.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 参与不等于决定责任。交接需要具体负责人、权责和接手关系；名单不能填补这些缺口。回看“跨职能治理与问责”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Participation is not decision ownership. Handover requires owners, authority and takeover arrangements; a list of names does not fill the gaps. Revisit Cross-Functional Governance and Accountability.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.
