sections.title: 确定企业人工智能风险以及制定缓解策略

learnerGoals.zh: 从监测结果选择有责任的处置
learnerGoals.en: Choose accountable responses from monitoring results

learnerGoals.zh: 把偏差线索定位到生命周期
learnerGoals.en: Locate bias clues across the lifecycle

learnerGoals.zh: 分别核对权利、内容与处置机制
learnerGoals.en: Check rights, content and remediation separately

learnerGoals.zh: 识别流畅但无支持的重要结论
learnerGoals.en: Recognize fluent but unsupported consequential claims

learnerGoals.zh: 在异常中控制影响并验证恢复
learnerGoals.en: Contain incidents and validate restoration

learnerGoals.zh: 调查群体差异的多种可能来源
learnerGoals.en: Investigate multiple possible sources of group differences

learnerGoals.zh: 不以输入授权替代输出安全
learnerGoals.en: Do not substitute source rights for output safety

learnerGoals.zh: 区分原文支持、矛盾与未知
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish source support, contradiction and uncertainty

scenario.zh: 示范：出现有依据的事故信号时先按预案限制影响，再调查、验证修复与恢复；不为记录流程拖延紧急回退。
scenario.en: Demonstration: use incident plans to contain impact, then investigate and validate remediation and restoration; paperwork must not delay urgent rollback.

workedReasoning.zh: 源授权不证明内容安全，流畅也不证明回答有依据。
workedReasoning.en: Source permission does not prove content safety, and fluency does not prove grounding.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：把两个审核问题送到相应检查，不当作互相替代。
prompt.en: Guided practice: route two review questions to their distinct checks.

text.zh: 使用权核查
text.en: Use-rights review

text.zh: 回答依据核查
text.en: Answer-support check

text.zh: 输入材料允许怎样使用
text.en: Permitted use of input material

text.zh: 引用是否支持具体结论
text.en: Whether a citation supports the claim

reason.zh: 两项都是需要的独立检查，完成一个不代表另一个完成。
reason.en: These are independent checks; completing one does not complete the other.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

learnerDecision.zh: 将不同发布记录送入不能互相替代的检查
learnerDecision.en: Route publication records to checks that cannot substitute for one another

learnerDecision.zh: 在有核验记录的两份答复中保留证据支持的事实而非更流畅的夸大
learnerDecision.en: Retain verified facts rather than a more fluent overstatement when checking two responses

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「本次输入资料允许的使用范围」→「资料使用权」；「预期发布场景及有害内容检查」→「内容与用途风险」；「投诉渠道和异常接手流程」→「处置机制」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「Permitted uses of this input material」→「Source-use rights」；「Intended publication context and harmful-content checks」→「Content and use risk」；「Complaint channel and incident handover process」→「Response mechanism」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「保留23份已复核、1份待补的事实边界；可以改善乙的表达，但不能把未完成改写成已通过」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “Retain the boundary: 23 reviewed and one awaiting material；Improve B wording without converting unfinished work into approval” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 将不同发布记录送入不能互相替代的检查；在有核验记录的两份答复中保留证据支持的事实而非更流畅的夸大
text.en: Route publication records to checks that cannot substitute for one another; Retain verified facts rather than a more fluent overstatement when checking two responses

text.zh: 两项都是需要的独立检查，完成一个不代表另一个完成。
text.en: These are independent checks; completing one does not complete the other.

explanation.zh: 两项都是需要的独立检查，完成一个不代表另一个完成。
explanation.en: These are independent checks; completing one does not complete the other.

misconceptions.zh: 有授权就证明内容无害
有引用或流畅就意味着可靠
misconceptions.en: Fluency or a citation establishes reliability

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 输入材料允许怎样使用 → 使用权核查；引用是否支持具体结论 → 回答依据核查
workedAnswer.en: Permitted use of input material → Use-rights review; Whether a citation supports the claim → Answer-support check

title.zh: 确定企业人工智能风险以及制定缓解策略

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练新一小时有200次请求，18次失败。告警摘要错写失败率2%。修正失败率，填写百分数。
prompt.en: In this exercise, 18 of 200 requests failed in a new hour. The alert incorrectly shows 2%. Correct the failure-rate percentage.

reason.zh: 18÷200×100=9%，不是照抄状态名称。运行指标要按同一口径计算；数字只属于本演练。回看“生产监控与事件处理”。
reason.en: 18/200×100=9%. Computing the operating metric uses a consistent definition rather than a status label. These numbers are exercise data. Revisit Production Monitoring and Incidents.

prompt.zh: 沿用本演练：组织预案规定失败率超过5%要由值班人接手；必要日志仅保留受控事件和版本信息，不能留敏感原文。刚算出的失败率为9%。哪些处置有依据？若已触发紧急回退，立即按原预案执行，不等待本题完成。
prompt.en: In this exercise, the organizational plan requires on-call takeover above 5% failures. Necessary logs retain controlled event/version information rather than sensitive originals. The measured rate is 9%. Which responses are justified? Any triggered urgent rollback follows its existing plan immediately, without waiting for this task.

text.zh: 交值班人接手并调查异常
text.en: Transfer to on-call staff and investigate

text.zh: 维持无人接手并把全部敏感原文写日志
text.en: Leave the incident unowned and log all sensitive originals

text.zh: 保全必要受控事件标识与版本，限制敏感信息
text.en: Preserve necessary controlled identifiers and versions while limiting sensitive data

reason.zh: 9%超过本题预案门槛，需要明确接手；必要证据不等于无限日志。不能以修表、调查或本题作业拖延已触发的紧急控制。回看“生产监控与事件处理”。
reason.en: 9% exceeds the stated trigger and needs an owner; necessary evidence does not mean unlimited logging. Record repair or investigation must not delay triggered urgent controls. Revisit Production Monitoring and Incidents.

prompt.zh: 将调查线索放到最直接的阶段；分类只定位线索，不代表已证明因果。
prompt.en: Route each investigation clue to its direct stage. Classification locates a clue; it does not establish causality.

reason.zh: 遗漏群体指向采样、同例异标指向标注、新人群差异指向部署环境；仍需持续分组检查和原因调查。 常见错误：训练前检查一次就能排除部署后的偏差。 回看《生命周期中的偏差》。
reason.en: Missing groups point to sampling, inconsistent labels to labeling, and a new population to deployment context. Ongoing subgroup assessment and investigation are still needed. Common error: One pretraining check excludes deployment bias forever. Review “Bias across the lifecycle”.

text.zh: 采样
text.en: Sampling

text.zh: 标注
text.en: Labeling

text.zh: 部署环境
text.en: Deployment context

text.zh: 样本没有覆盖一个受影响群体
text.en: A relevant group is absent from samples

text.zh: 相同案例被不同人员标成相反结果
text.en: The same case receives conflicting labels

text.zh: 上线人群与评估人群发生变化
text.en: Deployed population differs from evaluation population

prompt.zh: 本演练发布生成材料前收集了三类记录。分别归入资料使用权、内容/用途风险及处置机制。完成一个柜不能替其他柜过关。
prompt.en: Before publishing generated material, this exercise collects three records. File them under source-use rights, content/use risk and response mechanisms. Completing one cabinet does not pass the others.

reason.zh: 授权证明处理资料使用条件；用途与有害内容审查处理内容风险；投诉和处置让异常可接手。不能用生成方式或过滤结果冒充授权。 回看“有害内容与知识产权：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Authorization concerns source-use conditions, use/content review addresses content risk, and complaints/response enable handling. Generation or filtering does not establish permission. Revisit Harmful content and intellectual property: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

text.zh: 资料使用权
text.en: Source-use rights

text.zh: 内容与用途风险
text.en: Content and use risk

text.zh: 处置机制
text.en: Response mechanism

text.zh: 本次输入资料允许的使用范围
text.en: Permitted uses of this input material

text.zh: 预期发布场景及有害内容检查
text.en: Intended publication context and harmful-content checks

text.zh: 投诉渠道和异常接手流程
text.en: Complaint channel and incident handover process

prompt.zh: 本演练核验记录写明：24份申请中23份已完成复核，另1份仍待补资料。答复甲写得很顺：“24份已全部复核通过”；答复乙措辞生硬：“23份复核完，1份等资料，不能说全完”。选择目前可保留的事实与改进。
prompt.en: Exercise verification records show 23 of 24 applications reviewed, with one awaiting more material. Fluent answer A says all 24 passed review. Awkward answer B says 23 are reviewed, one awaits material, so not all are done. Select facts and improvements that can be retained.

text.zh: 甲更流畅，因此将24份全通过作为事实
text.en: Use all 24 approved as fact because A is more fluent

text.zh: 保留23份已复核、1份待补的事实边界
text.en: Retain the boundary: 23 reviewed and one awaiting material

text.zh: 资料已找到，所以两种相反说法都可靠
text.en: Both contradictory statements are reliable because a source was found

text.zh: 可以改善乙的表达，但不能把未完成改写成已通过
text.en: Improve B wording without converting unfinished work into approval

reason.zh: 现在不缺资料，问题在于结论是否被记录支持。“完成复核”也不自动等于“通过”。核验事实边界后可改文风，不能用流畅程度覆盖证据。回看“幻觉与可靠性”。
reason.en: A source is present; the issue is claim support. Completed review also does not automatically mean approval. Improve style after preserving the evidence boundary, not instead of checking it. Revisit Hallucination and Reliability.

prompt.zh: 自动发送仍在产生明显错误；人工通道可接手，候选修复未经验证，调查所需的最小事件记录已经受控保全。把以下行动安排为可辩护的处置路径。
prompt.en: Automatic sending continues producing clear errors. A human channel can take over, the proposed fix is unvalidated, and necessary minimized event records are preserved under controls. Arrange a defensible response path.

text.zh: 验证恢复条件后决定是否扩大使用
text.en: Validate restoration conditions before deciding expansion

text.zh: 用受控记录调查原因并修复
text.en: Investigate and repair using controlled records

text.zh: 限制受影响自动行动并转交人工通道
text.en: Contain affected automation and route to the human channel

reason.zh: 仍在发生的损害需要先控制；未验证修复不能直接扩大。必要记录须最小化和受控，而非先暴露敏感原文再调查。回看“检测、限制、调查与恢复”。
reason.en: Continuing harm needs containment, and an unvalidated fix cannot justify expansion. Necessary records stay minimized and controlled. Revisit Detection, Containment, Investigation and Recovery.

prompt.zh: 演练发现群体差异。选择所有值得调查的可能来源；本题不把任何线索直接判为根因。
prompt.en: A case reveals subgroup disparities. Select every plausible source to investigate; none is declared the root cause here.

reason.zh: 代表性、标注一致性、优化目标和部署人群都可能影响差异，应结合持续监测调查，而不是先锁定一个根因。 常见错误：分组差异一定只来自训练样本。 回看《采样、标注、目标与部署》。 标注分歧可能反映合理的不同观点，应先明确任务与标注规则，不能把统一标签本身当作消除偏差。
reason.en: Representation, labeling consistency, optimization objectives and deployment populations can affect disparities. Investigate with ongoing monitoring rather than assuming one root cause. Common error: Subgroup disparities can only come from training samples. Review “Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment”. Label disagreement can reflect legitimate different perspectives. Clarify the task and labeling rules; uniform labels alone do not eliminate bias.

text.zh: 因总体平均稳定而停止调查
text.en: Stop investigating because the overall average is stable

text.zh: 样本代表性与标注一致性
text.en: Sample representation and label consistency

text.zh: 优化目标与部署人群变化
text.en: Optimization objectives and deployment-population changes

prompt.zh: 演练报告只记录“来源有授权，输出未审”。选择所有仍需处理的工作。
prompt.en: The case report says sources are authorized but outputs are unreviewed. Select all remaining work.

reason.zh: 来源授权只回答允许如何使用资料；输出用途、内容风险、投诉与处置仍需核对。反过来，过滤有害内容也不证明获得许可。 常见错误：资料有授权就证明生成内容安全。 回看《来源授权、输出用途与有害内容》。
reason.en: Source permission addresses allowed source use. Output use, content risk, complaints and remediation still need review. Conversely, harmful-content filtering does not prove permission. Common error: Licensed inputs prove generated outputs are safe. Review “Source rights, output uses and harmful content”.

text.zh: 设置投诉与处置流程
text.en: Establish complaints and remediation procedures

text.zh: 直接把来源授权当成输出安全证明
text.en: Treat source authorization as proof of output safety

text.zh: 按输出用途进行内容审核
text.en: Review content for intended output use

prompt.zh: 材料箱有一份旧版政策摘录：“收货后7天内可提出申请”。没有证据说明它仍是现行版本。将三条说法按摘录能支持的范围归档；知识可以回看。
prompt.en: The source chest contains an old policy excerpt: “Requests may be made within 7 days of receipt.” There is no evidence it remains current. Classify three claims by the support available from that excerpt; sources remain accessible.

text.zh: 所给摘录直接支持
text.en: Directly supported by this excerpt

text.zh: 与摘录冲突
text.en: Contradicts the excerpt

text.zh: 尚需其他证据
text.en: Needs additional evidence

text.zh: 这份摘录写的是7天
text.en: This excerpt says 7 days

text.zh: 这份摘录支持承诺30天
text.en: This excerpt supports promising 30 days

text.zh: 今天对所有客户都应承诺7天
text.en: Today all customers should be promised 7 days

reason.zh: 7与30可直接对照；旧摘录不能证明当前适用性。主题相关、有引用或写“已核验”都不能填补版本未知。重要未知应保留并升级复核。回看“证据支持与不确定性”。
reason.en: Seven versus thirty can be compared directly, but an old excerpt does not establish current applicability. Relevance, a citation or a verified label cannot fill the version gap. Preserve important uncertainty and escalate review. Revisit Evidence Support and Uncertainty.

completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

Investigate with ongoing monitoring rather than assuming one root cause. Common error: Subgroup disparities can only come from training samples. Review “Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment”. Label disagreement can reflect legitimate different perspectives. Clarify the task and labeling rules; uniform labels alone do not eliminate bias.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 演练报告只记录“来源有授权，输出未审”。选择所有仍需处理的工作。
prompt.en: The case report says sources are authorized but outputs are unreviewed. Select all remaining work.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 来源授权只回答允许如何使用资料；输出用途、内容风险、投诉与处置仍需核对。反过来，过滤有害内容也不证明获得许可。 常见错误：资料有授权就证明生成内容安全。 回看《来源授权、输出用途与有害内容》。
incorrectFeedback.en: Source permission addresses allowed source use. Output use, content risk, complaints and remediation still need review. Conversely, harmful-content filtering does not prove permission. Common error: Licensed inputs prove generated outputs are safe. Review “Source rights, output uses and harmful content”.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 材料箱有一份旧版政策摘录：“收货后7天内可提出申请”。没有证据说明它仍是现行版本。将三条说法按摘录能支持的范围归档；知识可以回看。
prompt.en: The source chest contains an old policy excerpt: “Requests may be made within 7 days of receipt.” There is no evidence it remains current. Classify three claims by the support available from that excerpt; sources remain accessible.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 7与30可直接对照；旧摘录不能证明当前适用性。主题相关、有引用或写“已核验”都不能填补版本未知。重要未知应保留并升级复核。回看“证据支持与不确定性”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Seven versus thirty can be compared directly, but an old excerpt does not establish current applicability. Relevance, a citation or a verified label cannot fill the version gap. Preserve important uncertainty and escalate review. Revisit Evidence Support and Uncertainty.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

audit.reason: Replace the prior workshop with reviewed goal-linked independent tasks; move worked solutions out of the completion path.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFoundAll.zh: 本节物件已找到。可收藏想保留的物件，读完后整理入柜，再进入学习示范与练习。
afterFoundAll.en: This section’s objects are found. Favorite items you want to keep, read and file them, then enter the worked example and practice.

afterFiled.zh: 本节基础已整理。先看示范，再做引导练习，最后在新情境中独立应用。
afterFiled.en: Foundations are organized. View the worked example, try guided practice, then apply the ideas in a new situation.

sections.title: 评估 AI 业务的准备情况和成熟度

learnerGoals.zh: 用多维证据判断组织准备度
learnerGoals.en: Assess readiness from multidimensional evidence

learnerGoals.zh: 用成熟度定位下一步能力
learnerGoals.en: Use maturity to locate the next capability need

learnerGoals.zh: 按实际阻碍诊断能力缺口
learnerGoals.en: Diagnose capability gaps from actual blockers

learnerGoals.zh: 让投入追随目标与准备证据
learnerGoals.en: Make investment follow goals and readiness evidence

learnerGoals.zh: 按准备维度组织用途证据
learnerGoals.en: Organize use-specific evidence by readiness dimension

learnerGoals.zh: 区分演示与可持续运营能力
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish demonstrations from sustainable operations

learnerGoals.zh: 给技能、流程和权限选择不同支持
learnerGoals.en: Match support to skill, workflow and authority gaps

learnerGoals.zh: 先处理阻挡成果的依赖
learnerGoals.en: Address dependencies that block outcomes

scenario.zh: 示范：买到了模型但没有资料维护责任和运营支持，不能据此宣称组织准备就绪。
scenario.en: Demonstration: a purchased model without source ownership or operating support does not establish readiness.

workedReasoning.zh: 准备度来自当前用途的多维证据，不是一个采购事实。
workedReasoning.en: Readiness requires multidimensional use-specific evidence rather than a purchase fact.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：某团队有预算和可用模型，但拿不出当前用途的数据质量记录。评估表上哪项应保留为待核验，而不是跟着采购项打勾？
prompt.en: Guided practice: a team has funding and a model but no use-specific data-quality record. What remains unverified rather than inheriting the purchase checkmark?

text.zh: 当前用途的数据准备证据
text.en: Evidence of data readiness for the use

text.zh: 预算支出是否已经发生
text.en: Whether the budget expenditure occurred

reason.zh: 已发生采购只能证明采购事实，不会自动补出数据质量证据。
reason.en: A purchase proves that purchase, not missing data-quality evidence.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 在用途条件已验证但没有新增采购时判断有限试用是否仍可推进
learnerDecision.en: Judge a bounded trial when use-specific conditions are verified without a new purchase

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「按限定用途与既定验收目标开展受控试用，继续核对实际结果；记录这些准备条件只支持当前用途，不自动证明所有用途已准备好」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “Run the bounded controlled trial against its acceptance goals and check actual outcomes；Record that these conditions support this use, without claiming readiness for every use” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 在用途条件已验证但没有新增采购时判断有限试用是否仍可推进
text.en: Judge a bounded trial when use-specific conditions are verified without a new purchase

text.zh: 已发生采购只能证明采购事实，不会自动补出数据质量证据。
text.en: A purchase proves that purchase, not missing data-quality evidence.

explanation.zh: 已发生采购只能证明采购事实，不会自动补出数据质量证据。
explanation.en: A purchase proves that purchase, not missing data-quality evidence.

misconceptions.zh: 买到模型就代表能持续使用
misconceptions.en: Buying a model establishes sustainable use

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 当前用途的数据准备证据
workedAnswer.en: Evidence of data readiness for the use

title.zh: 评估 AI 业务的准备情况和成熟度

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 团队想用现有获准工具开展一个限定用途的试用。负责人已确认目标与资源，获准资料能取得且质量已核对，员工完成岗位练习，值守与治理责任也已有记录；负责人已批准该限定试用，但尚未采购更新型号。选择对这些证据最合适的处理。
prompt.en: A team proposes a bounded trial using an existing approved tool. Goals and resources are confirmed, authorized sources are available and checked, staff completed role practice, and operating/governance ownership is documented. The accountable owner approved this bounded trial, but no newer model was purchased. Select an appropriate use of this evidence.

text.zh: 没有新采购记录就不能承认任何准备证据
text.en: Without a new purchase, none of the readiness evidence counts

text.zh: 按限定用途与既定验收目标开展受控试用，继续核对实际结果
text.en: Run the bounded controlled trial against its acceptance goals and check actual outcomes

text.zh: 记录这些准备条件只支持当前用途，不自动证明所有用途已准备好
text.en: Record that these conditions support this use, without claiming readiness for every use

text.zh: 准备条件齐全即保证试用一定产生业务收益
text.en: Complete readiness guarantees business benefits

reason.zh: 准备度检查的是开展并维持具体用途的条件；新采购既非唯一证据，也不是条件齐全后的必需装饰。试用结果仍需验证，当前证据也不证明其他用途。回看“组织准备度”。
reason.en: Readiness concerns conditions for a particular use, not a new purchase as a symbolic requirement. Trial outcomes still need validation, and this evidence does not establish readiness for other uses. Revisit Organizational Readiness.

prompt.zh: 三个团队已连续按维护手册运行，值守、问题接手和定期评估都有可核验记录。准备扩展的新岗位尚未做过任务练习。成熟度讨论仍只写“我们做过演示”，也有人要求必须先拿到一张不存在于本课程要求中的统一AI等级证书。选择有依据的更新。
prompt.en: Three teams operate continuously from maintained runbooks, with verifiable operations, incident handovers and periodic assessments. A new role has not practiced its tasks yet. The maturity discussion still says only a demo was done, and someone demands a universal AI-level certificate not required by this course. Select justified updates.

text.zh: 承认已经形成的可重复运营证据，不能退回只数演示
text.en: Recognize established repeatable-operation evidence rather than count demos only

text.zh: 把新岗位能力缺口作为下一步发展与验证重点
text.en: Use the new role capability gap to plan the next development and validation

text.zh: 没有统一证书就把现有运行记录全部视为无效
text.en: Treat all operating evidence as invalid without a universal certificate

text.zh: 有三个团队运行记录就等于所有新岗位都已胜任
text.en: Three operating teams establish competence in every new role

reason.zh: 成熟度用于定位已具备与仍需发展的能力，不应抹掉真实运行证据，也不能从局部能力推出全组织能力。具体阶段定义与证据要求须明确，不能虚构统一认证门槛。回看“AI成熟度”。
reason.en: Maturity locates existing and missing capabilities. Do not discard real operating evidence or extrapolate local capability to the whole organization. Stage definitions need explicit evidence; do not invent a universal certification gate. Revisit AI Maturity.

prompt.zh: 一名员工已取得当前任务需要的资料权限，系统读取正常，错误由谁接手也已明确。实际演练中，他总把与原文相反的回答标为正确，也说不出如何对照证据。请选择针对当前已观察阻碍的改进，不另造没有证据的权限缺口。
prompt.en: An employee has the required source authority, the system reads normally, and incident ownership is clear. In observed practice, the employee repeatedly accepts answers contradicting the source and cannot carry out evidence comparison. Select improvements for this observed blocker rather than invent an access gap.

text.zh: 安排对照原文核验的岗位练习并观察实际表现
text.en: Provide role practice in source comparison and observe performance

text.zh: 继续扩大所有资料权限作为唯一解决方案
text.en: Keep expanding all access as the sole remedy

text.zh: 直接购买另一模型而不处理已观察的核验行为
text.en: Buy another model without addressing observed verification behavior

text.zh: 用后续实际核验结果检查技能支持是否有效
text.en: Check the support using subsequent verification performance

reason.zh: 现有证据指向核验技能不足，不是没有权限或无人接手。应针对具体技能练习与验证，不能用增加权限或采购替代诊断。回看“能力差距”。
reason.en: The evidence indicates missing verification skill, not missing authority or ownership. Target and evaluate that skill rather than substitute more access or procurement for diagnosis. Revisit Capability Gaps.

prompt.zh: 部门已为更大模型预留预算，但尚未说清要改善谁的工作，也未检查数据与团队条件。选择能让投入成为可验证路线的工作。
prompt.en: A department reserved a larger-model budget but has no defined beneficiary or checked data/team conditions. Select work that turns spending into a verifiable roadmap.

text.zh: 按关键缺口安排可验证阶段成果
text.en: Plan verifiable milestones around critical gaps

text.zh: 直接按设备到货顺序宣布能力提升
text.en: Declare capability improvements from equipment delivery order

text.zh: 明确战略结果并记录当前准备证据
text.en: Define strategic outcomes and record current readiness evidence

reason.zh: 投入要连接目标与当前条件，设备交付不能证明能力或价值已形成。阶段成果需要验收依据。回看“发展路线与投入顺序”。
reason.en: Investment must connect goals with present conditions. Equipment delivery does not establish capability or value; milestones need acceptance evidence. Revisit Roadmaps and Investment Sequencing.

prompt.zh: 本演练将收集的准备度便笺归档到对应维度；这些是用途证据，不是统一认证分数。
prompt.en: File the collected exercise readiness notes under the matching dimensions; these are use-specific evidence, not universal certification scores.

reason.zh: 数据授权与可访问记录属于数据条件；值守和恢复测试属于基础设施；职责与监督记录属于治理。高自评分不能替代这些证据。 回看“领导、数据、文化、技术与治理”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Authorization/access records concern data; support coverage and recovery tests concern infrastructure; ownership and oversight records concern governance. High self-scores do not replace evidence. Revisit Leadership, data, culture, technology and governance and the stated exercise conditions.

text.zh: 数据条件
text.en: Data conditions

text.zh: 基础设施
text.en: Infrastructure

text.zh: 治理
text.en: Governance

text.zh: 所需资料获授权且可访问
text.en: Required sources are authorized and accessible

text.zh: 故障恢复测试与值守能力记录
text.en: Recovery tests and operating support records

text.zh: 监督责任与升级流程记录
text.en: Oversight ownership and escalation records

prompt.zh: 组织比较两份采用记录。按记录是否足以支持可重复运营能力归档；不得把本题分类当官方等级认证。
prompt.en: An organization compares two adoption records. Classify whether each supports repeatable operating capability; this is not official maturity certification.

text.zh: 支持可重复运营的证据
text.en: Evidence supporting repeatable operations

text.zh: 仍只证明有限实验
text.en: Evidence of limited experimentation only

text.zh: 三个团队依据维护中的手册独立运行，交接和故障处置均留有验证记录
text.en: Three teams operate independently from maintained runbooks, with verified handovers and incident records

text.zh: 五次演示均靠同一专家临时改配置才成功，没有接手机制
text.en: Five demos succeed only after one expert changes configurations ad hoc, with no handover mechanism

reason.zh: 可重复且有治理支持的运行证据不同于实验次数。专家临时救场说明存在依赖，不能由演示次数推成持续能力。回看“探索、实验与可持续运营”。
reason.en: Repeatable governed operation differs from experiment counts. Ad hoc expert rescue reveals a dependency; demonstrations alone do not establish sustainable capability. Revisit Exploration, Experiments and Sustainable Operations.

prompt.zh: 团队成员已在真实样例中证明会核验，已获所需权限，手册里的接手人也在演练中成功接过异常。但任务必需的发票字段每次导入都被当前工具丢弃，换熟练人员重试仍相同。当前最有依据的缺口和干预是什么？
prompt.en: Staff demonstrated verification on real examples, have required access, and documented owners successfully accepted exceptions in a drill. Yet every import loses invoice fields required by the task, even when another skilled operator repeats it. Which gap and intervention are most supported?

text.zh: 保留已验证的技能与接手证据，不把它们无故改成缺失
text.en: Retain demonstrated skill and handover evidence instead of relabeling it missing

text.zh: 检查工具对必需字段的技术适配，修复或评估合适替代并验证
text.en: Inspect technical fit for required fields, repair or evaluate an appropriate alternative and validate it

text.zh: 重复同一操作培训即可证明字段已经保留
text.en: Repeating the same training proves the fields are retained

text.zh: 重新写一次已有且已演练的接手人姓名就能修复导入
text.en: Rewriting the existing drilled owner name fixes the import

reason.zh: 换熟练操作者仍稳定丢字段支持技术适配调查；它不抹掉已形成的技能和流程。选择干预前要区分人员、流程、技术与权限缺口。回看“区分技能、流程、技术与权限缺口”。
reason.en: The same field loss across skilled operators supports a technical-fit investigation without erasing established skill and workflow. Distinguish people, process, technology and authority before intervening. Revisit Distinguishing Capability Gaps.

prompt.zh: 本演练下一阶段要验证回答质量，但资料无维护人且版本冲突。预算4点，必须修复资料责任；可用控制价值至少4。选择能形成阶段验收条件的工作包；分值仅限本题。
prompt.en: The next exercise milestone tests answer quality, but sources have no owner and conflicting versions. Budget 4; source ownership repair is mandatory and readiness value must reach 4. Select a package enabling milestone acceptance. Scores apply only here.

text.zh: 明确资料维护责任：成本1，价值1
text.en: Assign source maintenance: cost 1, value 1

text.zh: 核对并修复当前资料版本：成本2，价值2
text.en: Check and repair current versions: cost 2, value 2

text.zh: 定义质量验收口径：成本1，价值1
text.en: Define quality acceptance: cost 1, value 1

text.zh: 只扩大硬件：成本4，价值1
text.en: Hardware expansion only: cost 4, value 1

reason.zh: 责任、版本和验收口径合计4点，分别补齐阻碍验证的条件；硬件不解决当前资料瓶颈。这里的分值只是演练可行性约束。回看“依赖关系与阶段成果”。
reason.en: Ownership, versions and acceptance total 4 and address the conditions blocking validation. Hardware does not fix the source bottleneck. These scores are exercise constraints only. Revisit Dependencies and Staged Outcomes.

prompt.zh: 团队想用现有获准工具开展一个限定用途的试用。负责人已确认目标与资源，获准资料能取得且质量已核对，员工完成岗位练习，值守与治理责任也已有记录；负责人已批准该限定试用，但尚未采购更新型号。选择对这些证据最合适的处理。
prompt.en: A team proposes a bounded trial using an existing approved tool. Goals and resources are confirmed, authorized sources are available and checked, staff completed role practice, and operating/governance ownership is documented. The accountable owner approved this bounded trial, but no newer model was purchased. Select an appropriate use of this evidence.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 准备度检查的是开展并维持具体用途的条件；新采购既非唯一证据，也不是条件齐全后的必需装饰。试用结果仍需验证，当前证据也不证明其他用途。回看“组织准备度”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Readiness concerns conditions for a particular use, not a new purchase as a symbolic requirement. Trial outcomes still need validation, and this evidence does not establish readiness for other uses. Revisit Organizational Readiness.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 三个团队已连续按维护手册运行，值守、问题接手和定期评估都有可核验记录。准备扩展的新岗位尚未做过任务练习。成熟度讨论仍只写“我们做过演示”，也有人要求必须先拿到一张不存在于本课程要求中的统一AI等级证书。选择有依据的更新。
prompt.en: Three teams operate continuously from maintained runbooks, with verifiable operations, incident handovers and periodic assessments. A new role has not practiced its tasks yet. The maturity discussion still says only a demo was done, and someone demands a universal AI-level certificate not required by this course. Select justified updates.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 成熟度用于定位已具备与仍需发展的能力，不应抹掉真实运行证据，也不能从局部能力推出全组织能力。具体阶段定义与证据要求须明确，不能虚构统一认证门槛。回看“AI成熟度”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Maturity locates existing and missing capabilities. Do not discard real operating evidence or extrapolate local capability to the whole organization. Stage definitions need explicit evidence; do not invent a universal certification gate. Revisit AI Maturity.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 一名员工已取得当前任务需要的资料权限，系统读取正常，错误由谁接手也已明确。实际演练中，他总把与原文相反的回答标为正确，也说不出如何对照证据。请选择针对当前已观察阻碍的改进，不另造没有证据的权限缺口。
prompt.en: An employee has the required source authority, the system reads normally, and incident ownership is clear. In observed practice, the employee repeatedly accepts answers contradicting the source and cannot carry out evidence comparison. Select improvements for this observed blocker rather than invent an access gap.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 现有证据指向核验技能不足，不是没有权限或无人接手。应针对具体技能练习与验证，不能用增加权限或采购替代诊断。回看“能力差距”。
incorrectFeedback.en: The evidence indicates missing verification skill, not missing authority or ownership. Target and evaluate that skill rather than substitute more access or procurement for diagnosis. Revisit Capability Gaps.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 部门已为更大模型预留预算，但尚未说清要改善谁的工作，也未检查数据与团队条件。选择能让投入成为可验证路线的工作。
prompt.en: A department reserved a larger-model budget but has no defined beneficiary or checked data/team conditions. Select work that turns spending into a verifiable roadmap.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 投入要连接目标与当前条件，设备交付不能证明能力或价值已形成。阶段成果需要验收依据。回看“发展路线与投入顺序”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Investment must connect goals with present conditions. Equipment delivery does not establish capability or value; milestones need acceptance evidence. Revisit Roadmaps and Investment Sequencing.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。

prompt.zh: 本演练将收集的准备度便笺归档到对应维度；这些是用途证据，不是统一认证分数。
prompt.en: File the collected exercise readiness notes under the matching dimensions; these are use-specific evidence, not universal certification scores.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 数据授权与可访问记录属于数据条件；值守和恢复测试属于基础设施；职责与监督记录属于治理。高自评分不能替代这些证据。 回看“领导、数据、文化、技术与治理”和本演练条件。
incorrectFeedback.en: Authorization/access records concern data; support coverage and recovery tests concern infrastructure; ownership and oversight records concern governance. High self-scores do not replace evidence. Revisit Leadership, data, culture, technology and governance and the stated exercise conditions.

prompt.en: An organization compares two adoption records. Classify whether each supports repeatable operating capability; this is not official maturity certification.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 可重复且有治理支持的运行证据不同于实验次数。专家临时救场说明存在依赖，不能由演示次数推成持续能力。回看“探索、实验与可持续运营”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Repeatable governed operation differs from experiment counts. Ad hoc expert rescue reveals a dependency; demonstrations alone do not establish sustainable capability. Revisit Exploration, Experiments and Sustainable Operations.

prompt.en: Staff demonstrated verification on real examples, have required access, and documented owners successfully accepted exceptions in a drill. Yet every import loses invoice fields required by the task, even when another skilled operator repeats it. Which gap and intervention are most supported?

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。

incorrectFeedback.zh: 换熟练操作者仍稳定丢字段支持技术适配调查；它不抹掉已形成的技能和流程。选择干预前要区分人员、流程、技术与权限缺口。回看“区分技能、流程、技术与权限缺口”。
incorrectFeedback.en: The same field loss across skilled operators supports a technical-fit investigation without erasing established skill and workflow. Distinguish people, process, technology and authority before intervening. Revisit Distinguishing Capability Gaps.

prompt.zh: 本演练下一阶段要验证回答质量，但资料无维护人且版本冲突。预算4点，必须修复资料责任；可用控制价值至少4。选择能形成阶段验收条件的工作包；分值仅限本题。
prompt.en: The next exercise milestone tests answer quality, but sources have no owner and conflicting versions. Budget 4; source ownership repair is mandatory and readiness value must reach 4. Select a package enabling milestone acceptance. Scores apply only here.

operation.zh: 比较候选代价与条件，组合可行工作包后提交。
operation.en: Compare costs and conditions, assemble a feasible work package, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 责任、版本和验收口径合计4点，分别补齐阻碍验证的条件；硬件不解决当前资料瓶颈。这里的分值只是演练可行性约束。回看“依赖关系与阶段成果”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Ownership, versions and acceptance total 4 and address the conditions blocking validation. Hardware does not fix the source bottleneck. These scores are exercise constraints only. Revisit Dependencies and Staged Outcomes.

sections.title: 为 AI 建立数据基础和基础设施基础

learnerGoals.zh: 判断资料是否适用于当前用途
learnerGoals.en: Assess whether sources fit the current use

learnerGoals.zh: 共享资料仍保留责任与访问边界
learnerGoals.en: Retain ownership and access boundaries when sharing data

learnerGoals.zh: 以工作负载评估完整基础设施
learnerGoals.en: Assess infrastructure against the whole workload

learnerGoals.zh: 在数据契约下区分重复与缺失
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish duplication from missingness under a data contract

learnerGoals.zh: 保留来源、责任、版本和共享边界
learnerGoals.en: Retain provenance, ownership, versions and sharing boundaries

learnerGoals.zh: 验证目标负载下的运行条件
learnerGoals.en: Validate operating conditions at target workload

scenario.zh: 示范：同名字段含义不一致，直接拼接资料会放大口径错误；要先定义数据契约并按用途核验。
scenario.en: Demonstration: joining identically named fields with different meanings amplifies inconsistency; define a data contract and check fitness for use.

workedReasoning.zh: 结构和格式只是条件，还要检查内容、共享边界和使用目的。
workedReasoning.en: Structure and format are conditions, but content, sharing boundaries and purpose still need checks.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：两个系统的“客户数”一个按账号、一个按家庭统计。合并前应先做什么？
prompt.en: Guided practice: one system counts customer accounts and another households. What is needed before merging?

text.zh: 因为字段名相同直接相加
text.en: Add them because the field names match

text.zh: 明确字段含义与统计口径，再确定转换与校验
text.en: Define meanings and counting conventions before conversion and validation

reason.zh: 同名不代表同义，未经转换相加会误导。
reason.en: Identical names do not ensure identical meaning; unconverted totals can mislead.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 按主键去重并承认缺失金额不能自动补零
learnerDecision.en: Deduplicate by key and recognize that missing amounts are not automatically zero

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交判定字段：独立订单数 = 2；已知且去重的金额 = 50；然后选中「只能报告已知去重金额50，完整总额仍因B缺失而未知」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Submit the graded fields: Distinct orders = 2；Known deduplicated amount = 50; then Select “Report known deduplicated amount 50; the complete total remains unknown because B is missing” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 按主键去重并承认缺失金额不能自动补零
text.en: Deduplicate by key and recognize that missing amounts are not automatically zero

text.zh: 同名不代表同义，未经转换相加会误导。
text.en: Identical names do not ensure identical meaning; unconverted totals can mislead.

explanation.zh: 同名不代表同义，未经转换相加会误导。
explanation.en: Identical names do not ensure identical meaning; unconverted totals can mislead.

misconceptions.zh: 按行数统计订单并把缺失金额记零
misconceptions.en: Counting rows as orders and missing amounts as zero is valid

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 明确字段含义与统计口径，再确定转换与校验
workedAnswer.en: Define meanings and counting conventions before conversion and validation

title.zh: 为 AI 建立数据基础和基础设施基础

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练资料很多却分散、质量不明。选出准备工作的重点。
prompt.en: Exercise data is abundant but disconnected and of unknown quality. What should preparation prioritize?

reason.zh: 资料数量不能说明适用性，需先检查是否可适当使用；回看“数据准备与孤岛”。
reason.en: Volume does not establish fitness or appropriate access. Revisit Data readiness and silos.

text.zh: 只统计总字节数
text.en: Count only total bytes

text.zh: 核查当前用途的质量、可访问性与共享障碍
text.en: Check use-specific quality, accessibility and sharing barriers

prompt.zh: 本演练资料维护员要核对并修正获准政策文本；客服只需查阅这些政策回答问题；两个岗位均无销毁历史资料的任务。组织仅允许完成所述工作必需的操作。配置最小必要权限，不因共享而全选。
prompt.en: The exercise source maintainer must inspect and correct approved policy text. Support only looks up those policies to answer questions. Neither role has a task requiring destruction of historical records. Organizational authorization permits only operations necessary for those tasks. Configure minimum access rather than grant everything for sharing.

text.zh: 资料维护员
text.en: Source maintainer

text.zh: 客服
text.en: Support

text.zh: 查阅政策
text.en: Read policies

text.zh: 修正文本
text.en: Correct text

text.zh: 删除历史
text.en: Delete history

reason.zh: 核对并修正需要读和修正；查答只需读；删除不服务题面任何职责。共享库仍需责任和边界，不能把“可共享”当“全开放”。回看“数据策略与所有权”。
reason.en: Inspection and correction need read and update; lookup needs read only, while deletion serves neither stated task. Shared sources retain ownership and boundaries. Revisit Data Strategy and Ownership.

prompt.zh: 本演练正在选基础设施，报价只列硬件算力。还应核对什么？
prompt.en: An exercise infrastructure quote lists compute performance only. What else should be checked?

reason.zh: 基础设施服务实际负载，硬件性能不能替代运行条件；回看“基础设施要求”。
reason.en: Infrastructure serves a workload; hardware performance does not establish operating fitness. Revisit Infrastructure requirements.

text.zh: 按硬件峰值排名直接购买
text.en: Purchase directly from peak hardware rankings

text.zh: 按工作负载核对存储、网络、集成、监测、安全、运维与成本
text.en: Check storage, networks, integration, monitoring, security, operations and cost against workload

prompt.zh: 本演练数据契约规定order_id唯一。三行记录为：A订单金额50；A订单金额50（同一订单的重复导入）；B订单金额缺失且未核验。仪表盘误写“独立订单3笔，已知订单金额100”。只修正这两个可由现有证据确定的数值；金额单位元。
prompt.en: The exercise contract makes order_id unique. Three rows are: order A amount 50; order A amount 50 (a duplicate import of the same order); order B with an unverified missing amount. The dashboard incorrectly shows 3 distinct orders and a known-order amount of 100. Repair only the two numbers established by the evidence, in currency units.

reason.zh: A的两行只是一笔，B仍是一笔，所以独立订单2；已核验的去重金额只有A的50。B金额缺失不能自动填0，也不能据此宣称完整总额是50。回看“质量维度与数据契约”。
reason.en: The two A rows are one order and B is another, giving 2 orders. Only A contributes a known deduplicated amount of 50. Missing B is not automatically zero, so this is not a confirmed complete total. Revisit Quality Dimensions and Data Contracts.

prompt.zh: 沿用该记录，主管要把50元作为两笔订单的完整总额发布。当前证据允许哪种说明？
prompt.en: Using those records, a manager wants to publish 50 as the complete total for both orders. Which statement is supported?

text.zh: 缺失自然等于0，因此完整总额已确定50
text.en: Missing naturally means zero, so the complete total is confirmed as 50

text.zh: 只能报告已知去重金额50，完整总额仍因B缺失而未知
text.en: Report known deduplicated amount 50; the complete total remains unknown because B is missing

text.zh: 保留重复A就能抵消缺失B
text.en: Keeping duplicate A offsets missing B

reason.zh: 去重与完整性是不同问题；修复重复不制造缺失证据。需要核验B后才能确认完整总额。回看“质量维度与数据契约”。
reason.en: Deduplication and completeness are distinct. Removing a duplicate does not create missing evidence; verify B before claiming a complete total. Revisit Quality Dimensions and Data Contracts.

prompt.zh: 本演练资料被复制到公开目录且没有版本。应该怎样修复？
prompt.en: Exercise sources were copied publicly without versions. How should this be repaired?

reason.zh: 复制不能抹掉权限；可追踪性依赖责任、来源去向和版本；回看“所有者、血缘与版本”。
reason.en: Copies retain sharing constraints; traceability needs ownership, lineage and versions. Revisit Owners, lineage and versions.

text.zh: 恢复共享边界并登记所有者、血缘和版本
text.en: Restore sharing boundaries and record owners, lineage and versions

text.zh: 仅重命名文件，不处理边界与来源
text.en: Only rename files without addressing boundaries or provenance

prompt.zh: 本演练低并发演示可用，但要接入多人业务。下一步做什么？
prompt.en: A low-load exercise demo works but must support more users. What comes next?

reason.zh: 并发与故障恢复会改变运营需求，不能用演示推断全部负载；回看“延迟、容量、可用性与运营”。
reason.en: Concurrency and recovery change operating requirements; a demo does not prove target-load fitness. Revisit Latency, capacity, availability and operations.

text.zh: 假定演示成功就能承受所有并发
text.en: Assume demo success covers any concurrency

text.zh: 按目标负载核验容量、延迟、恢复、成本与支持责任
text.en: Validate capacity, latency, recovery, costs and support ownership at the target workload

completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练正在选基础设施，报价只列硬件算力。还应核对什么？
prompt.en: An exercise infrastructure quote lists compute performance only. What else should be checked?

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 基础设施服务实际负载，硬件性能不能替代运行条件；回看“基础设施要求”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Infrastructure serves a workload; hardware performance does not establish operating fitness. Revisit Infrastructure requirements.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练数据契约规定order_id唯一。三行记录为：A订单金额50；A订单金额50（同一订单的重复导入）；B订单金额缺失且未核验。仪表盘误写“独立订单3笔，已知订单金额100”。只修正这两个可由现有证据确定的数值；金额单位元。
prompt.en: The exercise contract makes order_id unique. Three rows are: order A amount 50; order A amount 50 (a duplicate import of the same order); order B with an unverified missing amount. The dashboard incorrectly shows 3 distinct orders and a known-order amount of 100. Repair only the two numbers established by the evidence, in currency units.

operation.zh: 对照证据与错误记录，修复字段；固定代码按题面输入。
operation.en: Compare evidence with the faulty record and repair fields, using the stated fixed codes.

incorrectFeedback.zh: A的两行只是一笔，B仍是一笔，所以独立订单2；已核验的去重金额只有A的50。B金额缺失不能自动填0，也不能据此宣称完整总额是50。回看“质量维度与数据契约”。
incorrectFeedback.en: The two A rows are one order and B is another, giving 2 orders. Only A contributes a known deduplicated amount of 50. Missing B is not automatically zero, so this is not a confirmed complete total. Revisit Quality Dimensions and Data Contracts.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 沿用该记录，主管要把50元作为两笔订单的完整总额发布。当前证据允许哪种说明？
prompt.en: Using those records, a manager wants to publish 50 as the complete total for both orders. Which statement is supported?

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 去重与完整性是不同问题；修复重复不制造缺失证据。需要核验B后才能确认完整总额。回看“质量维度与数据契约”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Deduplication and completeness are distinct. Removing a duplicate does not create missing evidence; verify B before claiming a complete total. Revisit Quality Dimensions and Data Contracts.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练资料被复制到公开目录且没有版本。应该怎样修复？
prompt.en: Exercise sources were copied publicly without versions. How should this be repaired?

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 复制不能抹掉权限；可追踪性依赖责任、来源去向和版本；回看“所有者、血缘与版本”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Copies retain sharing constraints; traceability needs ownership, lineage and versions. Revisit Owners, lineage and versions.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练低并发演示可用，但要接入多人业务。下一步做什么？
prompt.en: A low-load exercise demo works but must support more users. What comes next?

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。
operation.en: Open the scenario and evidence, select the requested items, then submit.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 并发与故障恢复会改变运营需求，不能用演示推断全部负载；回看“延迟、容量、可用性与运营”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Concurrency and recovery change operating requirements; a demo does not prove target-load fitness. Revisit Latency, capacity, availability and operations.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

audit.reason: Replace the prior workshop with reviewed goal-linked independent tasks; move worked solutions out of the completion path.

foundationMeaning.zh: 我已查看本项基础，准备练习；不是理解已通过。
foundationMeaning.en: I have reviewed this foundation and am ready to practice; understanding is not yet passed.

afterFoundAll.zh: 本节物件已找到。可收藏想保留的物件，读完后整理入柜，再进入学习示范与练习。
afterFoundAll.en: This section’s objects are found. Favorite items you want to keep, read and file them, then enter the worked example and practice.

afterFiled.zh: 本节基础已整理。先看示范，再做引导练习，最后在新情境中独立应用。
afterFiled.en: Foundations are organized. View the worked example, try guided practice, then apply the ideas in a new situation.

sections.title: 领导企业范围的变革，打造具备 AI 能力的员工队伍

learnerGoals.zh: 区分领导资源责任与倡导实践
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish leadership resourcing from practical advocacy

learnerGoals.zh: 用明确责任实现跨职能交付
learnerGoals.en: Deliver across functions with explicit responsibility

learnerGoals.zh: 沟通已知、未知、岗位影响与支持
learnerGoals.en: Communicate knowns, unknowns, role impacts and support

learnerGoals.zh: 区分合理风险与害怕失败
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish justified concern from fear of failure

learnerGoals.zh: 用岗位表现而不是签到评估培养
learnerGoals.en: Assess role performance rather than attendance

learnerGoals.zh: 让自动化后的岗位仍覆盖判断与沟通
learnerGoals.en: Preserve judgment and communication in redesigned roles

learnerGoals.zh: 为赞助者与倡导者落实不同权责
learnerGoals.en: Assign distinct sponsor and champion responsibilities

learnerGoals.zh: 把暂停权限纳入团队接手
learnerGoals.en: Include stop authority in team handover

learnerGoals.zh: 不以预期冒充已验证结果
learnerGoals.en: Do not present expectations as verified results

learnerGoals.zh: 先诊断担忧再提供安全支持
learnerGoals.en: Diagnose concerns before selecting safe support

learnerGoals.zh: 用真实岗位判断证明能力
learnerGoals.en: Demonstrate competence through real role judgment

learnerGoals.zh: 不能从重复频率推出自动决策授权
learnerGoals.en: Do not infer automatic decision authority from repetition

scenario.zh: 示范：员工指出泄露风险可能是合理担忧，不宜一概当抵触；组织应提供反馈、安全练习和监督渠道。
scenario.en: Demonstration: a worker’s leakage concern may be justified rather than resistance; provide feedback, safe practice and oversight routes.

workedReasoning.zh: 透明沟通说明已知、未知与支持，不用未经验证承诺推动采用。
workedReasoning.en: Transparent communication explains knowns, unknowns and support rather than unverified promises.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：把沟通材料按证据状态整理，而不是直接选择宣传口号。
prompt.en: Guided practice: organize communication material by evidence status rather than pick a slogan.

text.zh: 有对应验证记录
text.en: Has a verification record

text.zh: 尚无对应验证
text.en: No corresponding verification yet

text.zh: 恢复演练记录显示用了12分钟
text.en: A recovery drill records 12 minutes

text.zh: 文稿承诺所有岗位更省时，尚无岗位测量
text.en: A draft promises time saving for every role without role measurements

reason.zh: 说明哪些被验证、哪些仍未知；不能把预期写成已发生的事实。
reason.en: Identify verified claims and unknowns rather than present expectations as observed facts.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

learnerDecision.zh: 识别宣传中未验证的承诺并保留反馈渠道
learnerDecision.en: Identify unsupported promises and preserve feedback channels

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「说明时间、已知结果、岗位影响、支持与未知，并开放反馈」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “Explain timing, known outcomes, role impacts, support and uncertainty, with feedback” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 识别宣传中未验证的承诺并保留反馈渠道
text.en: Identify unsupported promises and preserve feedback channels

text.zh: 说明哪些被验证、哪些仍未知；不能把预期写成已发生的事实。
text.en: Identify verified claims and unknowns rather than present expectations as observed facts.

explanation.zh: 说明哪些被验证、哪些仍未知；不能把预期写成已发生的事实。
explanation.en: Identify verified claims and unknowns rather than present expectations as observed facts.

misconceptions.zh: 为了采用可以承诺尚未验证收益
misconceptions.en: Adoption justifies promises of unverified benefits

next.zh: 保留已正确的操作，检查标出的项目；可回看知识或主动查看本题解析。看解析后的完成记为订正。
next.en: Keep correct work and check the marked items. Revisit knowledge or explicitly reveal this solution; completion after reveal counts as correction.

completionFeedback.zh: 本次引导练习完成，但还不是独立应用通过。请对照解析检查依据；不代表整章已掌握。
completionFeedback.en: This guided practice is complete, but independent application is not yet passed. Check the reasoning; this does not establish mastery of the chapter.

label.zh: 引导练习：可以看提示，完成后还要换情境应用
label.en: Guided practice: hints are available; a new application follows

workedAnswer.zh: 恢复演练记录显示用了12分钟 → 有对应验证记录；文稿承诺所有岗位更省时，尚无岗位测量 → 尚无对应验证
workedAnswer.en: A recovery drill records 12 minutes → Has a verification record; A draft promises time saving for every role without role measurements → No corresponding verification yet

title.zh: 领导企业范围的变革，打造具备 AI 能力的员工队伍

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练将两项工作交给适合的角色。
prompt.en: Assign each exercise task to the appropriate role.

reason.zh: 倡导者推动实践，领导提供方向资源；两者不能代替正式治理；回看“高管支持与AI倡导者”。
reason.en: Champions support practice; leaders supply direction and resources. Neither removes governance. Revisit Executive support and AI champions.

text.zh: 领导层
text.en: Leadership

text.zh: 倡导者
text.en: Champions

text.zh: 提供资源并明确责任
text.en: Provide resources and accountability

text.zh: 示范实践并汇总用户反馈
text.en: Demonstrate practice and gather user feedback

prompt.zh: 业务已确认验收标准，资料维护者和风险审查者也都接受职责。上线演练却持续报接口错误，供应商合同没有覆盖故障接手，内部也没有技术人员负责该接口。记录仍写“业务批准就等于能运行”。选择需要补齐的工作。
prompt.en: Business acceptance criteria, data maintenance and risk review have accepted owners. A launch drill repeatedly reports interface errors, but neither the supplier contract nor an internal engineer covers technical takeover. The record says business approval means the system can operate. Select missing work.

text.zh: 落实接口实现与技术故障接手能力，并验证问题修复
text.en: Establish interface implementation and technical takeover capability and validate the repair

text.zh: 将技术故障自动认定为业务标准不存在
text.en: Automatically conclude that technical failure means business criteria are absent

text.zh: 因为业务已批准就忽略接口演练失败
text.en: Ignore the failed interface drill because business approved the use

text.zh: 把技术交接与现有业务、资料和监督责任连接起来
text.en: Connect technical handover with existing business, data and oversight ownership

reason.zh: 跨职能交付需要各类实际能力相互接上。业务审批不能替代技术实现与接手，技术问题也不应无故抹掉已明确的业务标准。回看“跨职能团队”。
reason.en: Cross-functional delivery requires connected practical capabilities. Business approval does not replace technical implementation or takeover, and technical defects do not erase established business criteria. Revisit Cross-Functional Teams.

prompt.zh: 本演练拟发通知：“所有岗位都会更轻松”，但未验证岗位影响。如何改写沟通？
prompt.en: An exercise notice promises all roles become easier without evidence. How should communication change?

reason.zh: 透明需要说明已知与未知，也需要双向反馈；回看“透明沟通”。
reason.en: Transparency needs knowns, unknowns and two-way feedback. Revisit Transparent communication.

text.zh: 保留未经验证承诺，只删除反馈入口
text.en: Keep unverified promises and remove feedback

text.zh: 说明时间、已知结果、岗位影响、支持与未知，并开放反馈
text.en: Explain timing, known outcomes, role impacts, support and uncertainty, with feedback

prompt.zh: 本演练按观察区分障碍，避免把所有疑问称为抵触。
prompt.en: Classify these exercise observations instead of labeling every concern resistance.

reason.zh: 泄露担忧要核查控制，害怕失败需要安全试验与支持；回看“文化障碍”。
reason.en: Investigate controls for leakage concerns; fear of failure needs safe practice and support. Revisit Cultural barriers.

text.zh: 合理风险担忧
text.en: Justified risk concern

text.zh: 害怕失败
text.en: Fear of failure

text.zh: 员工指出回复可能泄露受限资料
text.en: A worker identifies possible restricted-data leakage

text.zh: 员工因担心练习出错受罚而不敢尝试
text.en: A worker avoids practice for fear of punishment

prompt.zh: 本演练培训只有签到表。要证明岗位能力，应补什么？
prompt.en: Exercise training has only an attendance register. What would demonstrate competence?

reason.zh: 到场不代表会做；能力证据来自实际任务表现；回看“员工培养”。
reason.en: Attendance is not performance; competence needs observed role-task evidence. Revisit Workforce development.

text.zh: 把签到次数当成胜任证明
text.en: Treat attendance counts as competence

text.zh: 按岗位任务评估核验、风险判断与协作表现
text.en: Assess verification, risk judgment and collaboration on role tasks

prompt.zh: 仓库原岗位包括整理库存记录、协调突发加班、处理交货冲突。库存记录整理已通过验证可由系统辅助完成，但尚无任何人员排班或客户承诺的自动授权。将下列工作归入适合保留的职责，不因为报表自动化就删除整个岗位。
prompt.en: A warehouse role used to organize stock records, coordinate unexpected overtime and resolve delivery conflicts. Record preparation is validated as system-assisted, with no automatic authority over staffing or customer commitments. Classify the work into responsibilities that should remain, rather than remove the whole role because reporting was automated.

text.zh: 可由已验证辅助承担的资料整理
text.en: Information work covered by the validated assistance

text.zh: 仍需人进行协调、判断与负责
text.en: Coordination, judgment and accountability retained by people

text.zh: 汇总已核对库存记录并列出异常供查看
text.en: Summarize checked stock records and list anomalies for inspection

text.zh: 听取员工疲劳与安全担忧，协商如何处理紧急班次
text.en: Hear staff fatigue and safety concerns and coordinate an urgent shift

text.zh: 面对库存不足与客户交期冲突，核验条件并由获授权的人确定承诺
text.en: Verify a stock/deadline conflict and have an authorized person decide commitments

reason.zh: 验证了资料整理，只覆盖岗位中的一部分任务；人员处境、冲突取舍和承诺责任仍要被明确安排。重新设计岗位要保留这些职责，而非把它们当报表系统自然拥有。回看“角色转变与人的优势”。
reason.en: Validated information assistance covers only part of a role. Staff circumstances, conflicting priorities and commitments still need assigned responsibility. Role redesign must preserve them rather than assume a reporting system owns them. Revisit Changing Roles and Human Strengths.

prompt.zh: 一线倡导者已演示用法并收集到跨部门需求，但没有权力分配数据维护资源。高层已表达支持，却没有任何人确认预算与协调责任。选择能推进而不越权的工作。
prompt.en: A frontline champion demonstrated use and collected cross-team needs but cannot assign data-maintenance resources. Leaders voice support, yet no one owns funding or coordination. Select work that advances the project without bypassing authority.

text.zh: 倡导者继续把实际需求与试用反馈交给有权决定者
text.en: The champion brings practical needs and trial feedback to authorized decision makers

text.zh: 倡导者因积极就可自行取得其他部门全部数据权限
text.en: The enthusiastic champion grants themselves access to all departmental data

text.zh: 赞助者落实资源与跨部门协调责任
text.en: The sponsor establishes resourcing and cross-team coordination responsibility

reason.zh: 支持口号不等于资源到位；倡导者连接需求与实践，但不能以热情替代授权。两种职责互补而不互相吞并。回看“赞助者与业务倡导者”。
reason.en: Support slogans do not supply resources. Champions connect needs and practice but enthusiasm does not create authority. These roles complement rather than replace one another. Revisit Sponsors and Business Champions.

prompt.zh: 本演练技术交付完成，但没有人有权暂停不适当用途。下一步？
prompt.en: The exercise implementation is done, but nobody can pause inappropriate use. What next?

reason.zh: 角色机制必须覆盖交付和停止，不只是实现任务；回看“业务、技术与监督角色”。
reason.en: Role design must cover delivery and stopping authority, not implementation alone. Revisit Business, technical and oversight roles.

text.zh: 默认模型自动承担暂停责任
text.en: Assume the model owns stop decisions automatically

text.zh: 明确监督角色、暂停权限、交付标准和接手关系
text.en: Define oversight, stop authority, acceptance criteria and handover responsibilities

prompt.zh: 本演练已验证：一轮试用中答复差错减少，但平均处理时间变长；长期净收益尚未测得。员工还需要了解新的复核职责。宣传稿只保留差错改善并写“所有人都会更轻松”。选择可发布的修订方向。
prompt.en: The exercise verified fewer response errors but longer average handling time during one trial; long-term net benefits remain unmeasured. Staff also need to understand new review duties. A notice keeps only the error improvement and says every role becomes easier. Select defensible revisions.

text.zh: 有处理变慢就删除已经验证的质量改善
text.en: Slower handling means deleting the verified quality improvement

text.zh: 因为有一个好指标就能承诺所有岗位更轻松
text.en: One favorable metric supports an easier-work promise for every role

text.zh: 同时说明已验证的差错改善和处理变慢，不隐去不利结果
text.en: Report both verified error improvement and slower handling without hiding the drawback

text.zh: 明确长期结果未知、新复核职责与支持反馈安排
text.en: State unknown long-term outcomes, new review duties, support and feedback

reason.zh: 透明沟通既不夸大也不抹掉证据：同一轮可同时有收益与代价。已知结果、未知长期影响、岗位变化和支持都应明确。回看“事实、未知、岗位影响与反馈”。
reason.en: Transparent communication neither exaggerates nor erases evidence: a trial may have benefits and costs together. State known results, unknown long-term effects, role changes and support. Revisit Facts, Uncertainty, Role Impacts and Feedback.

prompt.zh: 同一部门三位同事解释为何不采用工具。按实际障碍选择首要支持方向；不把所有疑问归为抵触，也不收集敏感原文。
prompt.en: Three colleagues explain non-adoption. Choose the first support direction from the actual blocker; do not label every concern resistance or collect sensitive originals.

text.zh: 核查控制与风险
text.en: Inspect controls and risk

text.zh: 限定范围安全练习
text.en: Bounded safe practice

text.zh: 核对工具与流程适配
text.en: Check tool/workflow fit

text.zh: 担心真实客户资料会被送到未批准服务
text.en: Worries that real customer data will go to an unapproved service

text.zh: 获准练习也不敢试，害怕错误导致惩罚
text.en: Avoids even approved practice for fear of punishment

text.zh: 试用后发现工具无法处理本岗位必需格式
text.en: Finds the tool cannot handle a format required by the role

reason.zh: 资料风险需检查控制；怕失败需安全练习和反馈；格式障碍需检查适配。不同原因不应一律培训或强制使用。回看“安全试验与问题反馈”。
reason.en: Data risk needs control review, fear needs safe practice and feedback, and format failure needs fit assessment. Different blockers do not all call for training or mandates. Revisit Safe Experimentation and Issue Reporting.

prompt.zh: 岗位演练记录显示，员工能在两个新任务中核对来源、识别边界并正确升级给接手人。但组织尚未指定谁评估、用什么通过标准作正式岗位胜任认定。有人提议仅按出勤次数发证，也有人想套用一张通用框架作组织正式量表。如何处理已有证据与认定？这里说的是岗位认定，不改变本游戏90%测验门槛。
prompt.en: Role exercises show the employee verified sources, recognized boundaries and escalated correctly in two new tasks. The organization has not named an assessor or pass criteria for formal role competence. One proposal certifies by attendance; another adopts a generic framework as an approved organizational rubric. How should evidence and approval be handled? This concerns role approval, not the game 90% exam threshold.

text.zh: 未经组织确认的通用框架天然等于正式认定量表
text.en: An unapproved generic framework automatically is the formal competence rubric

text.zh: 保留已经展示的真实任务表现，交指定评估者按明确标准认定
text.en: Preserve demonstrated task performance for a designated assessor using explicit criteria

text.zh: 补齐评估者、证据要求、通过标准和接手责任
text.en: Define assessors, evidence requirements, pass criteria and handover ownership

text.zh: 真实表现可以忽略，出勤次数越多必然越胜任
text.en: Ignore performance because more attendance necessarily proves competence

reason.zh: 已有实际表现值得保留，但正式岗位认定还需有责任的评估与明确标准。不能退回只数签到，也不能把通用框架自动当作组织批准。回看“从会操作到能判断”。
reason.en: Demonstrated performance is evidence, while formal role approval needs accountable assessment and explicit criteria. Do not revert to attendance counts or assume a generic framework is approved. Revisit From Tool Operation to Judgment.

prompt.zh: 维修系统每天都给工单排序。新方案按历史出现频率自动承诺到场时间，却没有比较不同故障的实际后果，也未说明谁有权批准承诺。例如较少出现的故障仍可能使某位住户失去必要服务。这里没有给出具体优先级政策。选择当前证据支持的决定，不需要自行发明“哪一户必须先修”的规则。
prompt.en: A repair system ranks tickets daily. A proposal would automatically promise arrival times using historical frequency, without comparing consequences or identifying who may authorize commitments. An infrequent failure might still deprive a resident of an essential service. No priority policy is supplied. Select decisions supported by the evidence without inventing a rule for which resident must be served first.

text.zh: 排序每天重复，所以系统自动获得承诺到场时间的权限
text.en: Daily repetition automatically grants the system authority to promise arrival times

text.zh: 直接发明一条未获批准的住户优先级规则并自动执行
text.en: Invent and automatically execute an unapproved resident-priority rule

text.zh: 系统可继续整理工单作为辅助，但频率本身不构成自动承诺授权
text.en: The system may assist by organizing tickets, but frequency alone does not authorize commitments

text.zh: 先由负责人核验不同故障后果并明确承诺权限，记录取舍
text.en: Have an accountable person check consequences, establish commitment authority and record trade-offs

reason.zh: 重复性说明可能存在辅助自动化机会，不能替代后果证据、价值取舍或正式授权。当前缺少优先级政策，应明确责任与条件，而非从频率或同情心直接造一条普遍调度规则。回看“判断、同理心与责任”。
reason.en: Repetition may suggest an assistance opportunity, but it does not replace consequence evidence, value judgments or formal authority. Missing policy calls for accountable conditions, not an invented universal dispatch rule based on frequency or sympathy. Revisit Judgment, Empathy and Responsibility.

prompt.zh: 本演练将两项工作交给适合的角色。
prompt.en: Assign each exercise task to the appropriate role.

operation.zh: 收集相关资料后逐项归类，再提交全部位置。
operation.en: Collect relevant information, classify each item, then submit all placements.

incorrectFeedback.zh: 倡导者推动实践，领导提供方向资源；两者不能代替正式治理；回看“高管支持与AI倡导者”。
incorrectFeedback.en: Champions support practice; leaders supply direction and resources. Neither removes governance. Revisit Executive support and AI champions.

completionFeedback.zh: 本项应用完成，请核对依据；看过完整答案后的订正不算独立证据。
completionFeedback.en: This application is complete; check the reasoning. Correction after seeing the solution is not independent evidence.

prompt.zh: 业务已确认验收标准，资料维护者和风险审查者也都接受职责。上线演练却持续报接口错误，供应商合同没有覆盖故障接手，内部也没有技术人员负责该接口。记录仍写“业务批准就等于能运行”。选择需要补齐的工作。
prompt.en: Business acceptance criteria, data maintenance and risk review have accepted owners. A launch drill repeatedly reports interface errors, but neither the supplier contract nor an internal engineer covers technical takeover. The record says business approval means the system can operate. Select missing work.

operation.zh: 打开情境与证据，选取题面所需项，并提交选择。

incorrectFeedback.en: Cross-functional delivery requires connected practical capabilities. Business approval does not replace technical implementation or takeover, and technical defects do not erase established business criteria. Revisit Cross-Functional Teams.

incorrectFeedback.en: Investigate controls for leakage concerns; fear of failure needs safe practice and support. Revisit Cultural barriers.

prompt.zh: 仓库原岗位包括整理库存记录、协调突发加班、处理交货冲突。库存记录整理已通过验证可由系统辅助完成，但尚无任何人员排班或客户承诺的自动授权。将下列工作归入适合保留的职责，不因为报表自动化就删除整个岗位。

incorrectFeedback.en: Role design must cover delivery and stopping authority, not implementation alone. Revisit Business, technical and oversight roles.

prompt.en: The exercise verified fewer response errors but longer average handling time during one trial; long-term net benefits remain unmeasured. Staff also need to understand new review duties. incorrectFeedback.en: Transparent communication neither exaggerates nor erases evidence: a trial may have benefits and costs together. State known results, unknown long-term effects, role changes and support. Revisit Facts, Uncertainty, Role Impacts and Feedback.

sections.title: 将 AI 从试点项目扩展到全企业部署

learnerGoals.zh: 用反馈决定迭代而非一次替换
learnerGoals.en: Use feedback to iterate rather than replace everything at once

learnerGoals.zh: 验证试点成果能否迁移
learnerGoals.en: Test whether pilot results transfer

learnerGoals.zh: 共享能力不替代业务用例责任
learnerGoals.en: Do not let shared capability replace business ownership

learnerGoals.zh: 同时跟踪采用和业务结果
learnerGoals.en: Track adoption together with business outcomes

learnerGoals.zh: 以生产证据而非页面演示验收
learnerGoals.en: Accept production using evidence rather than a demo page

learnerGoals.zh: 按新团队条件控制推广节奏
learnerGoals.en: Control rollout pace using new-team conditions

learnerGoals.zh: 用阶段证据决定是否前进或返回
learnerGoals.en: Use stage evidence to progress or return

learnerGoals.zh: 比较试点与新团队的支持条件
learnerGoals.en: Compare pilot and new-team support conditions

learnerGoals.zh: 在复用平台中保留部门资料责任
learnerGoals.en: Retain departmental source ownership on a shared platform

learnerGoals.zh: 用成本与风险检验持续价值
learnerGoals.en: Test sustained value against costs and risks

learnerGoals.zh: 把告警接手与持续维护纳入交接
learnerGoals.en: Include alert takeover and ongoing maintenance in handover

learnerGoals.zh: 随规模重验性能与连续性
learnerGoals.en: Revalidate performance and continuity as scale grows

scenario.zh: 示范：试验暴露资料版本缺口，业务团队回补条件，COE提供可复用核验方法；共享支持不取代本用例责任。
scenario.en: Demonstration: an experiment exposes source-version gaps; business teams repair them while a CoE provides reusable checks without assuming use-case ownership.

workedReasoning.zh: 是否推进由验证结果决定；复用方法不等于把业务价值与资料责任全部外包。
workedReasoning.en: Evidence determines progression; reusing methods does not outsource all value and source accountability.

label.zh: 示范：看老师怎样判断，不计掌握
label.en: Worked example: inspect the reasoning; not mastery

prompt.zh: 引导练习：演练新增3个团队，每队每周需2小时支持，当前可用4小时。至少还缺多少支持小时？这不单独证明可以扩展。
prompt.en: Guided practice: three new teams each require two support hours weekly, while four are available. What is the shortfall? This alone does not establish rollout readiness.

reason.zh: 3×2−4=2小时，扩展还需核对其他条件。
reason.en: 3×2−4=2 hours; expansion still needs other conditions checked.

operation.zh: 整理输入条件，计算并填写各数值字段后提交。
operation.en: Organize inputs, calculate and fill each numeric field, then submit.

learnerDecision.zh: 遇到资料不足时保留暂停与修正空间
learnerDecision.en: Preserve pause and correction options when sources are missing

evidenceOfUnderstanding.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「暂停该用途并补条件，按证据调整推广节奏」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
evidenceOfUnderstanding.en: The captured actions are: Select “Pause that use, repair conditions and adjust rollout pace by evidence” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

text.zh: 遇到资料不足时保留暂停与修正空间
text.en: Preserve pause and correction options when sources are missing

text.zh: 3×2−4=2小时，扩展还需核对其他条件。
text.en: 3×2−4=2 hours; expansion still needs other conditions checked.
